dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib la jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib la jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib la jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib la jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur nyi dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1428yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgya la dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar :thos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad gar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin ske legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhus//spung lha'i bod rig pa dpe sgrun khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha spel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khrag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nos te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las gar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khrag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser ba khog nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bas phyog sgrig khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba 6pa'i tshes 7la/

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog cesabyar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / g.yin yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'byungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'khrungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsisadang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhedas/ chos gnyis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser ga khuganang bstan dpe rnying 'tshes bsdu phyogs ga khang nas/0

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (pa)ra༅༅/ /zab pa dang rgya che'i ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi thob yig gaṅgā'i chu thre/na las glegs bam bzhi pa bzhugs rbesna/ /༄༅/ /de yang ma ṇi dgon par sprul sku pad+ma gling pa la phyon chen pos dngos su kha byang stsal bar brten gsol 'debs las/ dus bzang khyad 'phags zla ba nya yi nub/ /zab dgu'i gter gnas sna ring brag logs nas/ /rdzogs chen bla med a ti grong gsal skor/ /kun bzang thugs bcud gsang ba'i yang bcud rnyed/ /ces pa ltar zab gter gyi thog mar bum thang phyal gyi mda' stang chu rgya mdung 'khyil ba'i sa seng ge sna ring brag gam me 'bar mtshor grags pa'i gter gnas nas spyan drangs pa'i zab gter kun tu bzang mo slong gsal gsang ba snying bcud kyi rgyud la brten nas slob dpon chen pos phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i slong gsal gyi skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi'i spyi chings khyung chen lding ba nas rnam 'joms kyi khrus dbang / rta mgrin gyi gtor dbang / so shing /dpung skud/ ku sha dang bcas pa'i sta gon sngon du 'gro ba'i thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i dbang ngam theg mchog rin po che zhes (2na to| ba'i dbang chog gi steng nas phyi spros bcas bum pa'i dbang la/sngon 'gro le'u brgyad pa ltar dkyil 'khor du zhugs te/ dngos gzhi bum pa/ mda' dar me long /ral gri me long / rma bya'i mdongs/ khang bzang gtor ma rnams kyi dbang / spyan 'byed kyi smon lam dang bcas ngo sprod pa/ khro bo'i dbang chog rin po che'i them skas kyi le'u brgyad pa nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar ltar gyi 'jug pa sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi mda'/ phur ba/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ mar me/gtor ma/ phur pa/ thod pa/ tshil chen/ me long / rma bya'i mdongs/ rgyal srid bdun/ khro bo/ bum pa/—1 —

skas zhes pa khro bo'i dbang chog le'u zhe drug pa rjes kyi le'u gnyis dang zhe brgyad pa'o'i mtha' can/ spros med nang gi gsang dbang rin cen theg mchog ces pa spros med gsang dbang bskur thabs le'u bcu bzhi pa/ pad+ma 'bar ba ye shes brtsegs pa zhes pa shin tu spros med sher dbang bskur tshul le'u bcu gnyis pa/ 'gor thig le nyag gcig mtha' dbus bral zhes yod pa'i rab tu spros med tshig dbang rin po che bskur thabs rig pa'i rtsal dbang sa ni bcu gcig kun tu 'od ces pa'i mtha' can/ dbang gi cha lag dbang bzhi'i sngon du 'gro ba zhi ba byang chub sems kyi las byang rin po che'i 'phreng ba sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum so sor las rim bdun gyis ston pa/'gor dpal ldan pad+ma dbang gi sku zhes yod pa'i khro bo rang bzhin 'phrin gzhung sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum so sor (4na〉pas rim bdun gyis ston pa 'phrin las chog gzhung rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rnams/ gnyis pa smin zin grol byed 'khrid kyi skor la/ mngon sum rang thog tu dbab pa'i man ngag sems kyi sna khrid pa'i sngon 'gro don 'khrid lam rim brtsegs pa rnal du phab pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dngos gzhi'i don 'khrid lam gyi sgron ma rtsa ba lag 'khrid ces pa gsang ba'i snying bcud rgyal ba'i bka' la brten nas pad+mas phyi rabs don du bkod pa/ 'gor sgo'i gnad kyi dus su rig pa ye shes ngos gzung ba zhes yod pa'i mngon sum tshod phebs rtags tshad kyi yi ge gsang ba zangs yig can dang 'brel ba rab tu btus nas bstan po'o'i mtha' can rnams/ gsum pa bar dor gsal btab pas grol ba ngo sprod kyi skor la/ glong gsal gsang ba'i snying bcud ngo sprod rig pa gsal byed kyi rgyud sangs rgyas lag bcangs tshig gsum pa bar do dmar 'khrid kyi gdams pa/ bar do rnam bzhi'i 'char tshul ngo sprod yang dag pa a ti bkod pa chen po rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa dga' rab rdo rje tshig yig shrī sidha'i zhal gdams pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis don bsdus pa bar do bzhi sbyor ngo sprod pa dang yos pa'o/ /—4

po che bskur thabs rig pa'i rtsal dbang sa ni bcu gcig kun tu 'od ces pa'i mtha' can/ dbang gi cha lag dbang bzhi'i sngon du 'gro ba zhi ba byang chub sems kyi las byang rin po che'i 'phreng ba sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum so sor las rim bdun gyis ston pa/'gor dpal ldan pad+ma dbang gi sku zhes yod pa'i khro bo rang bzhin 'phrin gzhung sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum so sor (4na〉pas rim bdun gyis ston pa 'phrin las chog gzhung rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rnams/ gnyis pa smin zin grol byed 'khrid kyi skor la/ mngon sum rang thog tu dbab pa'i man ngag sems kyi sna khrid pa'i sngon 'gro don 'khrid lam rim brtsegs pa rnal du phab pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ dngos gzhi'i don 'khrid lam gyi sgron ma rtsa ba lag 'khrid ces pa gsang ba'i snying bcud rgyal ba'i bka' la brten nas pad+mas phyi rabs don du bkod pa/ 'gor sgo'i gnad kyi dus su rig pa ye shes ngos gzung ba zhes yod pa'i mngon sum tshod phebs rtags tshad kyi yi ge gsang ba zangs yig can dang 'brel ba rab tu btus nas bstan po'o'i mtha' can rnams/ gsum pa bar dor gsal btab pas grol ba ngo sprod kyi skor la/ glong gsal gsang ba'i snying bcud ngo sprod rig pa gsal byed kyi rgyud sangs rgyas lag bcangs tshig gsum pa bar do dmar 'khrid kyi gdams pa/ bar do rnam bzhi'i 'char tshul ngo sprod yang dag pa a ti bkod pa chen po rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa dga' rab rdo rje tshig yig shrī sidha'i zhal gdams pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis don bsdus pa bar do bzhi sbyor ngo sprod pa dang yos pa'o/ /—4

zab pa yod ri skan gyi mtha' can/ khyi smyon 'chos thabs rgya nag hā shang pe ta na tse'i man ngag mkho mthing gi gter ma/ sgrib shing zab pa'i mthar thug zab tig gser zho gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal dang mkho dbang la/ 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pa/ thod pa/ me long / lha dbang /rdzas dbang / tshig dbang (9ba)dang bcas pa/ phyag rdor yang gsang bla med kyi dbang la/ 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pa/ thod pa/ gtor ma/ me long / lha dbang / chos dbang / tshig dbang rnams/ tshe dpag yang gsang bla med kyi dbang la/ 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i cod pan/ bum pa/ thod pa/ shel/me long / tshig dbang / gtor dbang / rgyas gdab dang bcas pa/ sku lnga yang gsang bla med kyi dbang la/ 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i ming dbang / bum pa/ bdud rtsi/ lha dbang / gsang dbang / tshig dbang /gtor dbang rnams/ dbang chog yid bzhin gter mdzod kyi steng nas rnam sras yang gsang bla med kyi dbang la/ zhu 'bul/ gtor dbang / phyag mtshan ral gri/ bla rdo/ dam bsre/ tshe gtor/ tshogs rdzas dang bcas pa'i dbang rnams legs par nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ dkar chag lung bstan/ rnam thar lo rgyus/ snying po zab 'khrid zhal gdams/ gol sa gcad pa gegs sel/ tshogs gsog pa sgrub chen/ bsnyen sgrub las byang mchod 'phrin kha skong / smin byed dbang / gang 'dul gyi las thabs cho ga /bla ma sku gsum gyi sgrub pa/ mtshan brgyad rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs las tshogs/ yi dam bye brag sger sgrub/'gro don mtha' rgyas myong grol/ tshe 'das 'dren pa gshin don/ 'gro phan gyis las phran/ nor sgrub rnam sras/ nyer mkho zin bris dang bcu drug dang po la/ thems byang dkar chag gsal ba'i me long 'tsho rgyal dang lha sras dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nga)bcu bzhi pa 'gro phan las phran la/ 'gor skyon pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes yod pa'i bla gnas brtsib 'ja' 'byug gza' 'dzin sa g.yos skar ma sogs kyi legs nyes brtag pa/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka lugs kyi char 'bebs kyi gdams pa zhan byung rlung gnon char 'bebs yid bzhin nor bu zhal shes dang bcas pa thugs kyi me long nang bzhin khyung gi dbang bskur ro'i mtha' can/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rgya nag chu'i 'khor lo zhan byung rlung gnon dang bcas pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can rnams/bco lnga pa nor sgrub rnam sras la (16na)rgyal chen rnam sras kyi dbang chog yid bzhin gter mdzod/ rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi las byang bkang gso'i rim pa pad+ma'i ming can dang phrad par 'gyur gyi mtha' can/ gtor mar brten pa'i nor bdag rnam sras kyi sgrub pa bsam pa 'grub par 'gyur ro'i mtha' can/ sgab 'dre shes pa dkar po gnon thabs mtshams dam pa bcad la bsnyen sgrub bya'o'i mtha' can/ rgyal chen rnam sras kyi gsang ba rtsa ba'i sgrub skor ye shes 'tsho rgyal dang pad+ma gsal la gnang ba snying dang 'dra ba'i sgrub pa spel na bka'i chad pa yod pa'i mtha' can/ nor sgrub gter gyi bum pa'i 'bor lo yid bzhin nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung me ris bskor bar bya'i mtha' can rnams/bcu drug pa nyer mkho zin bris la/ rgyug ging gri ging rnga ging rnams kyi rtsa tshig nyi shu rtsa gcig pa ma khri bsgral chog ging 'cham pad+mas sbyar ba/ gter ston gyis mdzad pa'i rtsa ba gsum gyi las byang gi rnga brdung tshul tshogs nas bskul gyi bar gcig go'i mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i 'gor ā+oṃ su bhā wa shu blo zhes yod pa'i gza' tshogs 'khor 'das srid gsum rnams kyi zhal du ā+oṃ āḥ& gi mtha' can/des mdzad pa'i 'gor chos sku kun bzang zhes yod pa'i bod lung bka' gtad sde dpon chen por gyur cig gi mtha' can/ des mdzad pa'i bkra shis rigs 'dzin chu bo ma rnams kyi dbang lung yongs su rdzogs par nos pa'i spyi rgyud ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku spyan ras gzigs dbang /sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ rgyal yum ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lha sras mu tig btsan po/ lha lcam pad+ma gsal/—23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)sprul sku pad+ma gling pa/ mtshungs med chos rje rnam gnyis/ de gnyis ka la bstan 'dzin (16ba)grags pa/ de nas sprul sku mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ sna tshogs rang grol kyi sprul sku/ gnubs dang dran pa nam mkha'i rnam sprul 'phrin las lhun grub/ rig 'dzin gter ston chen po 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ /yang na bstan 'dzin grags pa nas/ rje pad+ma 'phrin las/ mang thos tshul khrims rdo rje/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na dbu mdzad grub pa kun 'dus nas/ rje pad+ma 'phrin las man gong ltar ro/ /yang na sprul sku tshul khrims rdo rje nas/ bon lung tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ dar sdings 'phrin las lhun grub man 'dra/ yang sta gon gyi dbang / rdzogos chen dbang 'phreng gi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogos/zur gyi rtags yod pa'i lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ gter ston pad+ma gling pa nas/ de la sprul sku mchog ldan mgon po/ sngags 'chang shākya bzang po/ mthu chen gsang sngags rdo rje gsum gyis gsan/ de gsum ga la rigs 'dzin mchog gi sprul sku legs ldan rdo rje/ de nas chos rgyal 'bri gung pa gnam lcags me 'bar/ drin can bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rigs 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog /mtshungs med ye shes grub pa/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na gter ston nas/ mi 'gyur kun dga' dpal bzang / snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho man 'dra/ seng ge sgra sgrog gi sgo nas khang sel dang / rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas spyo bog gtong ba'i lung phyag bzhes dmar 'khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ gter ston nas/ rgod phrug 'phrin las rol pa/ pha jo lhun grub rdo rje/ zur gzhon nu don grub/ de sras chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na gter ston nas (17na)rim par/ yug pa nor bu dbang rgyal/ de sras rab brtan dbang po/ gung ru dbyangs dpon pa/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /bye brag rta mgrin gyi brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ dga' rab rdo rje/ shrī sidha skyon chen po man 'dra/

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nganamakha' 'gro dmar nag gi brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang mo/ rdo rje phag mo/ phyon chen po man 'dra/gshin rje'i brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ che mchog he ru ku rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje chos/ mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang chen/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkhar chen bza'/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ rgyal sras man 'dra/ phyag rdor gyi brgyud pa ni/ kun bzang / rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ lag na rdo rje/ dga' rab rdo rje/ pad+ma thod 'phreng man 'dra/ tshe dpag med kyi brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ tshe dpag med rigs lnga/ gu ru pad+ma man 'dra/ sku lnga yang gsang bla med kyi brgyud pa ni/ spyi brgyud bzhin no/ /phur pa'i brgyud pa sku lnga las logs su dgos don mi 'dug kyang gsan yig ltar na/ kun bzang / rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ dga' rab rdo rje/ shrī sidha/ pra bha hasti/ slob dpon chen po man gcig /nor lha'i brgyud pa ni/ kun bzang / rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ skyon chen po man 'dra'o/ /gter ston pad+ma gling pas spyan drangs pa'i rgyas pa drag po dmar chen gyi skor/thems byang las/ khyad par drag po thugs sgrub mchog kha tshang don 'dril yang zab 'di:'di nas lho mon bum thang gi rdo rje brtsegs pa'i brag logs la gter du sbas shing rgya yis btab:ces pa ltar sprul sku pad+ma gling pas lto mon bum thang rdo rje brtsegs pa'i brag nas spyan drangs pa'i rgyas pa drag (17ba)po dmar chen skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du/ dbang chog nor bu'i 'phreng ba reg pa don ldan gyi steng nas 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i rang grol cod pan gyi dbang / bum pa/ bdud rtsi/ rdor dril gyis phyi nang gsang gsum sgrub pa'i dbang / so so'i sku 'bag rdzas dang bcas pas go cha'i lha dbang / khyung dbang / 'chi med tshe dbang / sngags dbang / drag po gtor ma'i dbang rnams —25

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nge/mkha' 'gro dmar nag gi brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang mo/ rdo rje phag mo/ phyon chen po man 'dra/gshin rje'i brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ che mchog he ru ku rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje chos/ mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang chen/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkhar chen bza'/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ rgyal sras man 'dra/ phyag rdor gyi brgyud pa ni/ kun bzang / rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ lag na rdo rje/ dga' rab rdo rje/ pad+ma thod 'phreng man 'dra/ tshe dpag med kyi brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ tshe dpag med rigs lnga/ gu ru pad+ma man 'dra/ sku lnga yang gsang bla med kyi brgyud pa ni/ spyi brgyud bzhin no/ /phur pa'i brgyud pa sku lnga las logs su dgos don mi 'dug kyang gsan yig ltar na/ kun bzang / rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ dga' rab rdo rje/ shrī sidha/ pra bha hasti/ slob dpon chen po man gcig /nor lha'i brgyud pa ni/ kun bzang / rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ skyon chen po man 'dra'o/ /gter ston pad+ma gling pas spyan drangs pa'i rgyas pa drag po dmar chen gyi skor/thems byang las/ khyad par drag po thugs sgrub mchog kha tshang don 'dril yang zab 'di:'di nas lho mon bum thang gi rdo rje brtsegs pa'i brag logs la gter du sbas shing rgya yis btab:ces pa ltar sprul sku pad+ma gling pas lto mon bum thang rdo rje brtsegs pa'i brag nas spyan drangs pa'i rgyas pa drag (17ba)po dmar chen skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du/ dbang chog nor bu'i 'phreng ba reg pa don ldan gyi steng nas 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i rang grol cod pan gyi dbang / bum pa/ bdud rtsi/ rdor dril gyis phyi nang gsang gsum sgrub pa'i dbang / so so'i sku 'bag rdzas dang bcas pas go cha'i lha dbang / khyung dbang / 'chi med tshe dbang / sngags dbang / drag po gtor ma'i dbang rnams —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khrinaganas bzhin bskur ba'i bum gsang shes rab ye shes tshig dbang dang bcas pa/ thems med lha dbang chen mo gter ston gyis chog sgrigs mdzad pa'i steng nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa byin 'bebs sogs gong ma las rgyas shing tshe dpag med kyi dbang yan phyogs 'dra phyag len rgyas pa la/ de nas sras mchog rigs bzhi/ khro bo bcu/ gī la ya mched bzhi/ sgo ma rnams kyi lha dbang / sngags dbang gtor dbang gnyis phyogs 'dra dang bcas pa smin rgyas su nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ thems can dngos bstan/ thems nas shugs las thon pa'i yig chung / thems med dang gsum/ dang po ni/ chosabaka' rnams mi 'chal bar bya ba'i thems byang dkar chag gshin rje dkar pos bka' 'di srungs zhes pa'i mtha' can/ de las bstan pa'i chos sde la yid ches bskyed pa'i lo rgyus/ spyi bye brag gi sgrub pa/ smin byed dbang chog kun 'gebs las tshogs dang bzhi/dang po ni/ lo rgyus rgyas pa'i glang lo sprel zla'i nya la yi ger bris nas rdo rje brtsegs pa'i gur du sbas pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/gnyis pa spyi bye brag gi sgrub pa la/ phyi sgrub yon tan kun 'byung rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/nang sgrub rdo rje'i 'phreng ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gsang ba dril sgrub spu gri 'bar ba skal ldana'aga' re ma gtogs (18na)kun la mi spel ba/ de'i yig chung drag po reg chod kyi spu gri kha tshang don 'dril gyi gdams pa rdo rje'i brag la gter du sbas pa/ thems med/ yang gsang bla ma drag po rtsal gyi sku rkyang gcig gi sgrub pa/ bcu thub brgya ru bsring nus tshe dpag med kyi sgos sgrub skal ldan gcig dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ zhi bar bsnyen cing khro bor sgrub pa 'jam dpal sgos sgrub las can gcig dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ pe har dam sri dregs pa brgyal zhing 'bros pa rta mgrin dbang chen sgosasgrub ldan gcig dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ zla ba gcig gis zhal mthong bar 'gyur ba phyag rdor sgos sgrub tshig nyung don che'i khyad chos las can gcig la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ mchog thun dngos grub ster ba mkha' 'gro'i sgos sgrub snying gi bu dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ tshangs pa yin yang tshar —26

la ya mched bzhi/ sgo ma rnams kyi lha dbang / sngags dbang gtor dbang gnyis phyogs 'dra dang bcas pa smin rgyas su nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ thems can dngos bstan/ thems nas shugs las thon pa'i yig chung / thems med dang gsum/ dang po ni/ chosabaka' rnams mi 'chal bar bya ba'i thems byang dkar chag gshin rje dkar pos bka' 'di srungs zhes pa'i mtha' can/ de las bstan pa'i chos sde la yid ches bskyed pa'i lo rgyus/ spyi bye brag gi sgrub pa/ smin byed dbang chog kun 'gebs las tshogs dang bzhi/dang po ni/ lo rgyus rgyas pa'i glang lo sprel zla'i nya la yi ger bris nas rdo rje brtsegs pa'i gur du sbas pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/gnyis pa spyi bye brag gi sgrub pa la/ phyi sgrub yon tan kun 'byung rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/nang sgrub rdo rje'i 'phreng ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ gsang ba dril sgrub spu gri 'bar ba skal ldana'aga' re ma gtogs (18na)kun la mi spel ba/ de'i yig chung drag po reg chod kyi spu gri kha tshang don 'dril gyi gdams pa rdo rje'i brag la gter du sbas pa/ thems med/ yang gsang bla ma drag po rtsal gyi sku rkyang gcig gi sgrub pa/ bcu thub brgya ru bsring nus tshe dpag med kyi sgos sgrub skal ldan gcig dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ zhi bar bsnyen cing khro bor sgrub pa 'jam dpal sgos sgrub las can gcig dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ pe har dam sri dregs pa brgyal zhing 'bros pa rta mgrin dbang chen sgosasgrub ldan gcig dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ zla ba gcig gis zhal mthong bar 'gyur ba phyag rdor sgos sgrub tshig nyung don che'i khyad chos las can gcig la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ mchog thun dngos grub ster ba mkha' 'gro'i sgos sgrub snying gi bu dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ tshangs pa yin yang tshar —26

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nge/gcod pa ya ka me dbal gyi sgos sgrub dam tshig tu lus dang ma bral gal che ba'i mtha' can/ mdzes tho lum du song yang sos pa khyung gi sgos sgrub las can gcig dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ gzugs med lha 'dre skad ngan 'don pa sdig pa'i sgos sgrub pad ma'i ming can dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las rnams sgrub pa dpa' bo rigs bzhi'i sgrub pa pad ma'i ming can de dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ rtsa ba gsum gyi sgrub pa gang byed kyang yid ches grub rtags ston pa brda rtags gsal ba'i sgron me rnams/gsum pa smin byed dbang chog la/ dbang bshad kyi lo rgyus bsdus pa ye shes 'tsho rgyal gyis pad+ma'i bka' bzhin yi ger bris nas gter du sbas pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ dbang chog nor bu'i 'phreng ba reg pa don ldan drag po thod 'phreng dbang chog rdzogs (18ba)byang gi mtha' can/ drag po'i las byang me lce'i 'phreng ba rnams/bzhi pa kun 'gebs las tshogs la/ dgra bgegs 'byung po zhi ba'i spyin sreg dang po'o'i mtha' can/ pu sna ku ru'i sngags yod pa'i tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gnyis pa'o'i mtha' can/ khams gsum dbang sdud pa'i sbyin sreg las rim rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ dregs pa tshar gcod drag po'i sbyin sreg me mchod las rim mo'i mtha' can/ drag po'i me hom rang 'bar las rim rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ mi rgod jag pa 'ching ba las 'phro can gyis spyod pa shog gi mtha' can/ gzung ma dbang du sdud pa/ phan cha bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 'dzam gling na dkon pa/ rgyal bsen srog 'khor bris nas gcun pa/ bgegs chen gtum po shi sa bstan pa/ sde brgyad spyi bsrung ba bgegs bsrung 'khor lo/ ban sngags nag po glang snying gi rbad 'dre rbod gtong zlog pa/ drag po'i gtor mas 'ge dgra bgegs gsad pa/ thems med/ bgegs chen gtum po gong gi bzlas pas ma shi na drag po'i las kyi dam sri rgyal bsen gsad pa/ chung sri mnan cing ril bu dang 'khor los byis pa sri'u gso ba/ rdzas sngags kyis srid pa'i (dar)rigs brgyud spel bas rigs brgyud sprul sku 'byung bar 'gyur ba/ mdze —27

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (snga/gcod pa ya ka me dbal gyi sgos sgrub dam tshig tu lus dang ma bral gal che ba'i mtha' can/ mdzes tho lum du song yang sos pa khyung gi sgos sgrub las can gcig dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ gzugs med lha 'dre skad ngan 'don pa sdig pa'i sgos sgrub pad ma'i ming can dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las rnams sgrub pa dpa' bo rigs bzhi'i sgrub pa pad ma'i ming can de dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ rtsa ba gsum gyi sgrub pa gang byed kyang yid ches grub rtags ston pa brda rtags gsal ba'i sgron me rnams/gsum pa smin byed dbang chog la/ dbang bshad kyi lo rgyus bsdus pa ye shes 'tsho rgyal gyis pad+ma'i bka' bzhin yi ger bris nas gter du sbas pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ dbang chog nor bu'i 'phreng ba reg pa don ldan drag po thod 'phreng dbang chog rdzogs (18ba)byang gi mtha' can/ drag po'i las byang me lce'i 'phreng ba rnams/bzhi pa kun 'gebs las tshogs la/ dgra bgegs 'byung po zhi ba'i spyin sreg dang po'o'i mtha' can/ pu sna ku ru'i sngags yod pa'i tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gnyis pa'o'i mtha' can/ khams gsum dbang sdud pa'i sbyin sreg las rim rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ dregs pa tshar gcod drag po'i sbyin sreg me mchod las rim mo'i mtha' can/ drag po'i me hom rang 'bar las rim rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ mi rgod jag pa 'ching ba las 'phro can gyis spyod pa shog gi mtha' can/ gzung ma dbang du sdud pa/ phan cha bsrung ba'i 'bor lo 'dzam gling na dkon pa/ rgyal bsen srog 'bor bris nas gcun pa/ bgegs chen gtum po shi sa bstan pa/ sde brgyad spyi bsrung ba bgegs bsrung 'khor lo/ ban sngags nag po glang snying gi rbad 'dre rbod gtong zlog pa/ drag po'i gtor mas 'ge dgra bgegs gsad pa/ thems med/ bgegs chen gtum po gong gi bzlas pas ma shi na drag po'i las kyi dam sri rgyal bsen gsad pa/ chung sri mnan cing ril bu dang 'khor los byis pa sri'u gso ba/ rdzas sngags kyis srid pa'i lta de re)rigs brgyud spel bas rigs brgyud sprul sku 'byung bar 'gyur ba/ mdze —27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)nad tsi tsi dz+wa la gso thabs gzungs chog mdze gso 'khor lo/ kun gyi sngon 'gro chab gtor nad sel/byab gtor mdze nad gso ba/ des kyang bsos par ma gyur na drag po'i mtha' 'dul bya ba/ chu 'khyagasaser ba bsrung ba/ drag sgrub char 'bebs las mtha' ya ka me dbal la brten nas zas nor sgrub pa dngos grub tshogs bdag /'gal byed klu la gtad pa/ chu 'khyags ser ba dbab pa/ drag po thog gis bsad pa/ (19na)rig 'dzin tshe'i sgrub thabs/ 'di bum pa gtor ma so gos la brten pa'i dbang yin 'dug kyang deng sang bskur rgyun ho 'dra/ rang dang yi dam dgra grogs brtsi ba sngags kyi de nyid kun la 'gebs pa/ zho chang bsrung ba/ bka' bsrung drag po sde gsum gyi gsang sgrub bstan pa bsrung ba'i lcags ri/ drag po sde gsum gyi bkang gso gsol kha bstod bskul rbad pa dang bcas pa rnams/ /thems byang du/ dum bu bzhi bcu zhe lnga yis drag po sgrub pa'i skor rnams tshang : zhes pa dngos bstan gyi steng du lkog yig thems su mi gsal ba kha yar dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa thems nas shugs bstan yig chung la/ go cha'i yig chung rin cen 'dus pa dang las tshogs kyi yig chung ste gnyis/ dang po la/ tshe dpag med kyi yig chung gzhung ltar ma nor bar shes par mdzod kyi mtha' can/ 'jam dpal yig chung gzhung na yod pa ltar bya'o'i mtha' can/ rta mgrin yig chung gzhung dang mthun par bris kyi mtha' can/ phyag rdor yig chung gzhung gi sgrub thabs ltar bya'o'i mtha' can/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i yig chung bsdu chog la sogs pa gzhung ltar bya'i mtha' can/ me dbal yig chung gzhan rnams bya thabs gzhung ltar ro'i mtha' can/ khyung gi yig chung rjes kyi bya ba gzhung ltar byed las can bu yis nyams su long zhig gi mtha' can/ sdig pa'i yig chung mthug gi bya ba gzhung dang mthun zhes dang drag po go cha'i lha rnams kyi zhes sogs phrad shog gi mtha' can rnams/gnyis pa las tshogs yig chung la/ cho ga gzhung ltar legs par mdzod cig pa zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi yig chung / tshe dang longs spyod rgyas par 'gyur ba rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi yig chung / rjes kyi —28

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (pebasdu chog gzhung na gsal ba (19ba)dbang gi sbyin sreg gi yig chung / de nas bsdu chog gzhung/ ltar bya ba drag po'i sbyin sreg gi yig chung / gzhung na yod pa ltar shes par bya ba me hom rang 'bar gyi yig chung / lag len ma nor ba gnad du che ba jag 'ching yig chung / gzhung dang bstan nas nyams su long zhig pa rig ma 'gugs pa'i yig chung / 'di las zab pa pad+ma bdag gis bsgyur ba med pa phan cha bsrung ba'i yig chung / rgyal bsen srog 'khor gyi yig chung sde brgyad bran du 'bol ba'i mtha' can/snying 'gas par 'gyur ba gtum po'i shi sa bstan pa'i yig chung / bus nyams su long zhig pa bgegasabasrung 'khor lo'i yig chung sde brgyad spyi bsrung du grags pa/ rbad 'dre rbod gtong zlog pa'i yig chung snying gi bu la phrad shog can/ phyag len 'dzom pa'i gdams ngag gces pa gtor mas dgra bgegs bsad pa'i yig chung / gzhan rnams bya thabs gzhung na gsal ba drag po gsad pa'i las mtha'/gtang rag mnga' gsol gzhung ltar bya ba byis pa sri'u gso ba'i yig chung / lte bsgyur zla mtshan chad dus bzang ba srid phur 'bebs pa'i yig chung / bsdu chog gzhung ltar bya ba chab gtor yig chung /sangs te 'bud par the tshom med pa bya ba gtor nad pa gso ba'i yig chung gzhung ltar shes par bya ba drag po mtha' 'dul gyi yig chung / thun bcas phur pa bcing ba ser ba bsrung ba'i yig chung / bya thabs gzhung na gsal ba char dbab pa'i yig chung / rjes kyi bya ba gzhung ltar byed pa nor sgrub yig chung / gzhung na yod pa lta bur bya zhes pa'i klu gtad yig chung / shin tu gnyan pas gsang bar bya ba ser 'bebs yig chung / gzhung ltar byas pas 'grub pa thog 'bebs yig chung rdo rje'i gur rim/(20na)thog 'bebs 'ar)gdams pa'i yang yig go'i mtha' can/ mchod bstod gzhung ltar bya ba tshe sgrub yig chung rnams/ tsi tsi dz+wa la'i gzungs choge /dgra grogs brtsi ba/ zho chang bsrung ba gsum la yig chung mi snang ngo / /gnyis pa thems med la rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub kyis lta de re)bsgrigs pa'i thems byang / gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas phyi ltar sgrub pa'i yig chung the tshom med bzhin du gyis kyi mtha' can/—29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 8)nang sgrub kyi yig chung nyi zla'i ga'u lha lcam dang 'tsho rgyal gyis yang yang nan gyis zhus pa/ 'gor bla ma drag po'i lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo g.yin ma thams cad gzhung na gsal zhes yod pa'i gsang sgrub shog dril smin grol thob par shog gi mtha' can/ bzlas brjod sngags kyi 'phro 'du dang snying po'i sgom thabs gsal ba'i shog dril 'di med khog pa'i snying dang 'dra ba/ phyi nang gsang gsum gcig tu dril ba'i shog dril phyi rabs rnal 'byor dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ dbang sdud kyi shog dril rnal 'byor rigs brgyud 'phel zhing sku tshe ring bar bya thabs/ 'tsho rgyal gyis phyi rabs don du sirnyi bshad pa'i nor sgrub phrad shog gi mtha' can/ bsrung bzlog gsang gsum gyi man ngag khro bcu'i sgom bzlas bka' bzhin nyan pa'i mtha' can/ khro bcu'i bsrung ba'i yig chung rdo rje'i go khrab bam theg chen zil gnon cung zad 'dri zhing bsgom par bya'o'i mtha' can/ khro bcu rgyan gyi shog dril zlog gsad kyi man ngag gud du sbas pa log lta bskur 'debs can la gsongs shig gi mtha' can/ bsrung ba dang zlog pa'i go bgo ba'i phyir khro bcu rgyan gyi shog dril bstod pa dang bcas pa bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod kyi mtha' can/ klu 'dul khyung (20ba)gi shog dril nga ni dbang drag pad+ma'i sku sogs 'phrin las bcol pa dang bcas pa/ sde brgyad 'khu ldog gcun pa'i sngags rtags thun sreg mnan bstan pa'i shog dril/ ye shes 'tsho rgyal dang pad+ma gsal gyi mchims phur zhus pa'i bkang gso 'ar)dngos grub kun 'byung nub phyogs bde chen ma/ drag po lcags sdig gi gsang sgrub 'ge bstod bskul chos sku skye med ma dang bcas pa 'di 'gro ba kun 'dul gyi de dang zhus dag pher ba 'dug kyang so sor 'god pa gsan yig gi rgyun la snang / liṅga 'dri pa'i yig chung gso byed gri gug gi rgya can/ gtor mas dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i yig chung 9re/zhes pa bcom ldan rdo rje drag rtsal ma/ 'di'i 'gor phur pa dar gyi cod pan ༅ zhos pa'i rdzo 'dug pa de gas smo nas lkor ba 'dra/ rdo gtor zab mo gnam lcags 6gre/kyi thog dang ri dbye/—30

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)'phreng gnyis ma/ byad ma gnad 'bebs 'gor bra dang mtha' ba yod pa'i 'phreng bzhi ma/ kho rang gi pho nya kho rang la dbab pa 'gor ā+oṃ dang mtha' na yod pa'i (21ba)'phreng bdun ma/ srung ma'i yi ge 'gor tshom dang mthar na yod pa'i 'phreng bdun ma/ gshin rje gnad bskul 'gor sra dang mthar ba yod pa'i 'phreng bdun ma/ klu bdud gshed dbab 'gor ra dang mthar ba yod pa'i 'phreng bdun ma/gnyan srin za yig gya gya ma gza' rigs brgya rtsa gcig la phan pa tshu kro ma/ nam langs kyi za yig da za 'phreng gsum ma/ nyi shar za yig bha ha 'phreng gsum ma/ nyin byed za yig ta na 'phreng gsum ma/mun rub za yig te za 'phreng gsum ma/ srod kyi za yig hūṃ ṇa 'phreng gsum ma/ nam phyed za yig kho 'phreng gcig ma/ tho rengs za yig e 'phreng gcig ma/ gza' brgyad dam btags thi sha 'phreng brgyad ma/ nam yin za ba ā+oṃ sri 'bru dgu ma/ nyin phyed za ba ā+oṃ ma 'bru bcu ma/ phyed yol za ba ā+oṃ pa 'bru bdun ma/ gdong mo bzhi'i za yig ku tra 'bru bcu drug ma/ bsrung ba btags chog ya nas yu'i 'phreng bdun 'bru bzhi zur btags ma dang bcas pa/ spyo 'dre 'dul thabs sde brgyad gcun pa (dar/thub pa rtags byung na gzer sngags shog gi mtha' can/ chung 'dre 'dul ba lto 'khor rtsibs brgyad ma 9re/le'u sa mā ya'i mtha' can/ gzhan gyi sri'u gso bar 'dod na gso thabs ( da re/ma gcig mkha' 'gro 'tsho rgyal gyis mdzad pa 'gro don byed shog gi mtha' can/ chung 'dre bsrung ba'i 9 re/'khor lo sri'u bsrung ba'i gdams pa rgya'i mtha' can/ bgegs chen gtum po bsrung ba'i ltad re/ling 'khor rtsibs brgyad pa yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdam mo'i mtha' can/ dam can sde gsum gyi sgrub pa'i yig chung dus gnas rdzas sbyor bzhis bstan pa dgra 'joms tho ba/ de'i sgrub thabs yang yig cho 'phrul sprel thod ma/ drag po gsum dril gyi sku (22na)gzugs dang dgra ling 'dri lugs kyi gnad byang dza raṃ gyis bskor ro'i mtha' can/ bod rbad cho 'phrul srog las gnad 'bebs rnams kyi sngags dang 'ar)sku gzugs gso ba sogs ston pa gnad byang rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ lho phyogs shel khang ma/rgya gar dur khrod ma/ gtsang gi 'u yug ma gsum bsdoms par drag po sde gsum gyi bskul dug mda' —32

so'i mtha' can/ lho phyogs shel khang ma/rgya gar dur khrod ma/ gtsang gi 'u yug ma gsum bsdoms par drag po sde gsum gyi bskul dug mda' —32

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (penag por grags pa rnams rdzogs par nos pa las/ dang gyi rtags med pa'i thems can dngos bstan gyi lung dang / dbang chog reg pa don ldan gyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ rgyal yum ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lha lcam pad+ma gsal/ gter ston pad+ma gling pa/ mi 'gyur kun dga' dpal bzang / chos rgyal 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs/ ā tsarla pa la'i sprul pa bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rigs 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog /drung pa dkon cog rin chen/ kun 'chang shākya bzang po/ rig 'dzin chen po legs ldan rdo rje/ 'bri gung zur ba man 'dra/ yang na gter ston nas/ chos lung mkhan chen tshul khrims dpal 'byor/ la yag nang so rgyal ba don grub/nya ri ban pa'i dar gyi rtags can rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ sprul sku gsung sprul nas/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub/ rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na bstan 'dzin grags pa nas/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ de sras 'phrin las lhun grub man 'dra/ thems can gyi go cha'i lha rnams kyi yig chung rin cen 'dus pa/ las tshogs kyi yig chung rin cen gsal sgron/ dar gyi rtags med pa'i thems med dang bcas pa'i lung brgyud ni/ mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po nas sgrub chen tshe 'phel bzang 21/ 'dis drag sgrub mthar phyin cing legs ldan rjes tsi dmar ba ar la gtad dus sngags bzla ba sogs kyi phyag —33—

kun dga' lhun grub/ gdung brgyud pad+ma 'phrin las/ sprul sku tshul khrims rdo rje/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub man gong bzhin no/ /bum thang smad kyi skyir tshogs seng ge khyi tsog brag nas gdan drangs pa'i 'bring po 'gro ba kun 'dul skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du/ dbang chog gsang ba 'dus pa'i steng nas/ 'jug (23na)pa sngon du 'gro ba'i cod pan/ bum pa/ thod pa/ shel dang me long / rdor dril/ kyi rgyun la dmar chen thems med kyi khongs su 'dren zhing lho brgyud phyogs kyi gsan yig tshor yang the tshom du mdzad kyang / gter gnas lho mon bum thang phyogs: rdo rje brag gi lho phyogs na rtse cig sbas par gsal lo/ /'gor bla ma drag po'i rnal 'byor pas drag po'i lo rgyus bshad par bya zhes yod pa'i lo rgyus dbang bshad phrad shog gi mtha' can/ 'gor bla ma drag po'i rnal 'byor pas dbang gi las tshogs byed pa'i phyir zhes yod pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i lag len phrad shog gi mtha' can/ bla ma drag po gsang 'dus kyi dbang chog rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ drag po bsgrub pa'i las byang 'gro ba kun 'dul rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ drag po rtsa ba'i sgrub bskor sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi bstan pa bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas gdab kyi mtha' can 'phros pas pad 'byung lho nub srin yul dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (pe/bzhud khar lho brag lcags phur can du thugs sgrub yang khol 'di nyid gnang tshul yod pa/ gu ru phyi ltar sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu don gsum gyis bstan pa skal ldan snying gi bu dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ bla ma nang ltar bsgrub pa nyi zla'i ga'u skyes bu las can gcig (23ba)gi dpal du shog gi mtha' can/ rig 'dzin tshe'i sgrub pa brgya thub stong thub du 'phel ba las can gcig dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub pa ma bslabs chos sgo kun la mkhas pa snying gi bu dang 'di phrad shog gi mtha' can/ rta mgrin dbang chen gyi sgrub pa pe har dam sri dregs pa brgyal 'bros dngangs shing bka' nyan pa phyi rabs rnams la phan thogs sna/ga gi mtha' can/ phyag rdor thugs kyi sgrub pa tshig nyung go sla don 'dril bdag gis yi ger btab nas gter du sbas pa las can gcig dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sgrub pa go sla 'khyer bde tshig nyung yang zab las can snying stobs can dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ drag po khyung gi sgrub pa 'di med go mtshon med pa'i dpa' bo dang 'dra ba skal ldan gcig dang phrad 3|ga gi mtha' can/ 'phrin las me dbal bsgrub pa/ dmigs ltasango mtshar du ma 'ong zhes pa'i mjug tu de dus mtshams dgrol byin rlabs bya zhes sogs blo ka gcig 'dir mi 'dug de phyin dmar chen dang zhus dag pher bar snang / thugs sgrub sdig pa'i sgrub pa 'gro ba rnams la phan thogs rbe|ga gi mtha' can/zhar byung tsakra dri ba bstod pa chos nyid skye med ma dang bcas pa/ 'gor bdag 'dra ye shes 'tsho rgyal gyis zhes yod pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rin cen sa la gter du sbas pa'i mtha' can/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dmar chen dang 'dra ba las pu lja ku ru'i sngags med pa/ dbang gi sbyin sreg ye shes 'tsho rgyal gyis yi ger btab pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ drag po'i sbyin sreg rin cen sa la gter du sbas pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ me hom rang 'bar log rtog mos gus tshud par 'gyur ba/ mi rgod jag pa 'ching ba dgra rnams (24na)rengs shing gum par 'gyur ba 'di 'dra'i man ngag rgya bod gnyis na med pa/ gtor bzlog 'phrin las dur khrod 'jigs (zur)rung ma snang gsal phyogs su dmar 'a gyi chos sder 'dren par snang / rnams kyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen —35

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (ngo/bzhud khar lho brag lcags phur can du thugs sgrub yang khol 'di nyid gnang tshul yod pa/ gu ru phyi ltar sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu don gsum gyis bstan pa skal ldan snying gi bu dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ bla ma nang ltar bsgrub pa nyi zla'i ga'u skyes bu las can gcig (23ba)gi dpal du shog gi mtha' can/ rig 'dzin tshe'i sgrub pa brgya thub stong thub du 'phel ba las can gcig dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub pa ma bslabs chos sgo kun la mkhas pa snying gi bu dang 'di phrad shog gi mtha' can/ rta mgrin dbang chen gyi sgrub pa pe har dam sri dregs pa brgyal 'bros dngangs shing bka' nyan pa phyi rabs rnams la phan thogs lha rdzog gi mtha' can/ phyag rdor thugs kyi sgrub pa tshig nyung go sla don 'dril bdag gis yi ger btab nas gter du sbas pa las can gcig dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sgrub pa go sla 'khyer bde tshig nyung yang zab las can snying stobs can dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ drag po khyung gi sgrub pa 'di med go mtshon med pa'i dpa' bo dang 'dra ba skal ldan gcig dang phrad shog gi mtha' can/ 'phrin las me dbal bsgrub pa/ dmigs ltasango mtshar du ma 'ong zhes pa'i mjug tu de dus mtshams dgrol byin rlabs bya zhes sogs blo ka gcig 'dir mi 'dug de phyin dmar chen dang zhus dag pher bar snang / thugs sgrub sdig pa'i sgrub pa 'gro ba rnams la phan thogs lha/ga gi mtha' can/zhar byung tsakra dri ba bstod pa chos nyid skye med ma dang bcas pa/ 'gor bdag 'dra ye shes 'tsho rgyal gyis zhes yod pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rin cen sa la gter du sbas pa'i mtha' can/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dmar chen dang 'dra ba las pu lja ku ru'i sngags med pa/ dbang gi sbyin sreg ye shes 'tsho rgyal gyis yi ger btab pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ drag po'i sbyin sreg rin cen sa la gter du sbas pa phrad shog gi mtha' can/ me hom rang 'bar log rtog mos gus tshud par 'gyur ba/ mi rgod jag pa 'ching ba dgra rnams (24na)rengs shing gum par 'gyur ba 'di 'dra'i man ngag rgya bod gnyis na med pa/ gtor bzlog 'phrin las dur khrod 'jigs ri zur)rung ma snang gas pa phyogs su dmar 'a gyi chos sder 'dren par snang / rnams kyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen —35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)po/ o rgyan yab yum/ pad+ma gsal/ pad+ma gling pa/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ bstan 'dzin grags pa/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub/ drin chen gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na grub pa kun 'dus dang bstan 'dzin grags pa gnyis ka la pad+ma 'phrin las/ de nas rig 'dzin gsung sprul/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na gsung sprul nas/ bon lung gar dbang / 'phrin las lhun grub man gong ltar ro/ /yang na grub pa kun 'dus nas/ rgyal sras bstan pa'i 'byung gnas/ pad+ma 'phrin las man 'dra/ zur gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ gter ston nas/ kun dga' dpal bzang / bkra shis rgya mtsho/ du ma rang grol/ kun dga' bkra shis/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /bshad ma thag pa'i gter gnas nas gdan drangs pa'i drag po chung ba me rlung 'khril ba'i skor la/ lung bstan kun gsal me 31nga zhes pa dben gnas thar pa gling gi sa nags spang 'dres pa seng ge'i brag: lho nub kha bstan phug pa phu dag po'i sku gsung 'di nyid ni la bse smug po'i sgrom la gdams: zhes chos skor 'di dang bye ma a krong gi drag po'i sku gnyis gter du sbas tshul sogs bstan pa yin pas lung bstan chen mo dang don mi gcig (24ba)go /'tsho rgyal gyis ma 'ongs don du drag po'i lo rgyus byung tshul bshad pa dpal du gyur shog gi mtha' can/ yar klungs shel brag tu gu rus pe har rgyal po btul ba'i tshe zhus lan gyi skor las 'phros pa'i drag po sku'i dkar chag lo rgyus dgongs pa lon pa'i mtha' can/ gu ru'i phyi sgrub nor bu rgya mtsho/ 'phrin las nang sgrub bgegs thams cad rab tu zhi ba'i cho ga /pad+ma thod 'phreng gsang sgrub ḍā ki ma'i snying tig /drag sgrub kyi bcud ku su lu'i nyams len zhes pa drag po rtsa ba'i sgrub pa las tshogs dkyus bzhin sbyor ro'i mtha' can/ phyi nang gsang gsum gcig dril sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo gcig tu sgrub pa yon tan gter mdzod drag po bla med kyi sgrub par grags pa/ 'jam dpal sku sgrub pa'i le'u sa mā ya'i mtha' can/ rta mgrin gsung —36

/lus dang rtsa sogs —38—

sngags bstan 'dzin bzang po/ de sras 'phrin las lhun grub/ rtsa ba'i bla ma 'gyur med rdo rje/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na bstan 'dzin grags pa dang grub pa kun 'dus gnyis ka la pad+ma 'phrin las/ de nas gsung sprul tshul rdor/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub man 'dra/'di'i mtshan la mun sel sgron me/ yang shing 'dus pa/ ye shes 'od mchog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogasamang bar 'dug pa gter kha gzhan dang 'khrul par mi bya'o/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la gtad pa'i rta mgrin dmar po'i skor lho brag sman mdo'i brag la sbas pa sprul sku pad+ma gling pas gdan drangs pa la/ smin byed ni rta mgrin yang gsang bla med dam rta nag lha lnga gang rung gi dbang bya ba las 'dir logs su med cing spros pa la mi dga' na bar chad med pa gtor ma'i dbang gis kyang go chod/ lung la/ rta mgrin (29ba)dpa' bo gcig pa yab yum gyi sgrub thabs man ngag gnang ba'o'i mtha' can/ phyi rta thod lha zhal la brten nas dregs pa can thams cad dbang du bsdu zhing srog 'phrog pa/ drangs pa la/ smin byed ni rta mgrin yang gsang bla med dam rta nag lha lnga gang rung gi dbang bya ba las 'dir logs su med cing spros pa la mi dga' na bar chad med pa gtor ma'i dbang gis kyang go dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ kho nge/gcod pa/ rbod gtong / rmi ltas ngan pa/ 'chi ba bzlog pa/ tshe bsring ba/ longs spyod dang / rigs brgyud spel ba/ rbod gtong bzlog pa lugs gcig /ngag mnan/ ngag 'grol/ gtad/ shug sgrol/jag 'ching / lha dbye/ dgra nang 'gras par bya ba/ dgra bgegs dbang sdud/ sel byed pa rnams las rmi lam ngan pa 'bebs pa yan gcig tu byas na rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)snying gtam yang dag pa/ slob dpon rnam gsum gyi dgongs pa phur pa'i lde mig nyer gcig ces pa ngo bo nges tshig sogs zhib par ston pa/ phur pa 'phrin las kyi don bkrol ba spyi khog yang dag pa 'brasabu'i 'phyong rnams/gsum pa smin byed dbang la/ rdo rje phur pa'i dbang chog chen mo bskur ba'i man ngag gsang ba don gsum gyis bstan pa/ phur pa dbang gi ti ka sbas tig gsang ba rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/ sdig bshags tshogs gsog skyabs sems rnams ston pa dbang gi sngon 'gro yan lag bdun par (34ba)grags pa rnams/bzhi pa sgrub thabs khog 'bub la/ phyi snying thig yang gsang spu gri 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs rang don byang chub nar mar sgrub pa dbang gi mdo byang / nang dbang sdud khro bo nye bar sgrub pa dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad pa'i sgrub thabs/ gsang ba rdo rje phur pa'i snying stag yang gsang spu gri 'bar ba'i sgrub thab bang rtsa ba thugs kyi phur gcig ma ki la la 'bru bcu bdun gyis lus byin gyis brlabs nas bsnyen cing dha ti rnam gsum drag sngags chig chod kyi las thams cad 'grub par bya ba drag sngags chen mo la brten nas mngon spyod kyis las sgrub pa spu gri'i bu yig tu grags pa'i 'di'i nang du mtha' mi mgon brtson bzo bo khyad par 'phags sogs kyang yod do/ /skyon la ḍā gis lung bstan pa'i mdo las byung ba'i gong gi bu yig ling ga'i lus la sngags 'god tshul ston pa/ 'khor tshogs bur bcas pa sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs sngon 'gro'i las rim dgu bsnyen pa la bcu bzhi sgrub par bcu sgrub chen la bco lngas bstan pa'i sgrub bum chen mo/ 'gor mos pa dbang gi dngos grub stsol zhes yod pa'i dngos grub len chog drag po mthu'i sirnyi stsol gyi mtha' can/ tshe 'gugs pa'i cho ga sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyis bstan pa cho ga'i lag len rna'i mtha' can/ bzheng bskul/ spyan 'dren/ brtan bzhugs byin rlabs/ byug bdug brdeg pa/ gzi brjid bskyed pa/ bstod pa/ 'god pa/ snyan gso me te las dgu bkol ba zhes rab tu gnas pa rnams/—52

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)'brul 'khor gnubs lugs/ sde brgyad yongs dril gyi te ta bse sgom nag po sngags bzlas pa tsam gyis lha srid sde brgyad snying 'byin pa tsam byed pa shrī pad+ma'i gdams pa/ 'jig rten rlung dmar gyi drag sngags srog gi jag pa zhes pa gong ma'i zhal gdams glang sgrom sgo nga phug gi gter ma/ rno ba'i spu gri thams cad kyi mde thung la nang gses kyi ngan sngags gdug pa'i lag cha drang srong khros pa'i dmod mo hal khyi nag po'i gtad khram rgya nag gting nas zhug te bsgyur ba/ drang srong khros pa'i dmod mo khyi nag po phang pas btab pa/ 'jigs pa'i ngan sngags btsan dug lta bu hal khyi nag po la 'phrin las bcol ba/ sa bdag phung byed nag po'i 'debs kha bskul dug lnga 'dus pa dang bcas pa/ lcags phur khong stong la brten pa'i hal khyi nag po'i ngan sngags/ hal khyi'i bskul sa bdag hal khyi ma/ gsad pa'i mtshon cha drang srong srog gi sngags rgod bskul ser skya ma dang bcas pa/ hal khyi nag po'i ngan sngagasagadug pa'i lag cha gong dang 'dra min rnams/ nag po yod 'ded/ srog gi bshan pa/ mchan pa nag po bze ma nye 'byed dang nag po bzlog med sogs gzhi gcig la ming du mar btags pa'i rlung 'khor mu stegs kyi gtsug lag khang ru pa ta mo'i dbang phyug gi rten las phyon chen pos bton te pra dun rtser gtan la phab/ bum thang lha khang sgo srung rta mgrin gyi mtshan mar sbas pa'i bum thang srog 'khor dgra bo'i srog gi mchan pa nag po 'byung ba rlung gi 'khor lo zhes sbur bu bye'u mgon gyis spyan drangs nas shog ser yang gter du bzhugs pa pad+ma gling pas spyan drangs pa'i skor la/ gleng gzhi rnam grangs/bca' thabs/ 'grub rtags (42bskond 'bebs/ mjug sdud de don drug gis bstan pa/ 'brub khung / ling ga bdud nyi rwa hu'i thebs bzlog /nag rtsis kyi gnad/ lha dbye/ tshul la ldog pa'i skyon bstan man rtog ter dngag shog dril drug pa zhes pa'i drag sngags/ de'i lag len drag sngags bcud bor la/ rdzas/ sngags/ ting nge 'dzin/ brtag pa/ gnad 'bor dang bcas pa'i snying dang 'dra ba bum thang rin cen dge gnas kyi rta mgrin gyi shangs nas gdan drangs pa/ tshe 'phel ba'i 'khor lo mu khyud lnga pa/ sri bsrung mu khyud lnga pa/ skeg bsrung mu khyud bzhi pa/ sa bdag bsrung ba mu khyud bzhi pa/ slob —64

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 8)yab yum/ lha sras ltam sring / gter ston pad+ma gling pa/ cho so rje rnam gnyis/ rje bstan 'dzin gragasapa/ yongs 'dzin pad+ma 'phrin las/ gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ dar sdings wen las lhun grub/kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /zur gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud lugs gcig dang kong gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gter ston la kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan dang legs pa'i shes rab gnyis gas gsan/ de nas nam mkha' rnam rgyal/ lhun grub rdo rje/ (43ba〉gzhen nu don grub/ rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na gter ston la rin po che sman rtse ba dang zur rnam rgyal grags pa gnyis gas gsan/ de nas lhun grub rdo rje man gong bzhin no/ /byang gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gter ston nas/ sngags 'chang gsang sngags sdong po/ mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /gter gyi rtags yod pa ni gong du ma nos pas 'phrin las lhun grub nas/ gter bdag gling pa la brgyud pa kho na'o/ /gter ston chen po ga me gling pas spyan drangs pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/da rma gling pa ni/ rang gter spyi don lung bstan gsal byed 'od kyi dra ba las/ zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol 'di spel bar 'phangs pas rin cen gter du sbas 'di nyid 'don pa'i skal ldan rigs kyi bu mdog dkar gzugs ring smra med khro bo'i dbyibs res dga' dmas na ga glen pa lta bu la res dga' gtad med byis pa'i rnam pa can ma dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba rigs kyi bu dad pa stobs chen shes rab dbang po sna mi sems mi 'dzin dpa' bo'i tshul 'dzin pa 'brug sprul lo pa dpal gyi ming can 'byung : 'di nyid lo tsā klu yi rgyal mas no: 'di dang phrad kyis chos la zong —66

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 8)'dzin gu ru nyi zla 'od zer gyis mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i nyams 'khrid gud du bkol ba bde ba rang grol rnams/ lnga pa bka' srung skor la/ dam can sde bdud gyi las byang dgra bgegs gdug pa rang grol/ chos skyong kun 'dus kyi mdangs bkang gdug pa rang grol/ sngon 'gro'i gser skyems gsum nam mkha' chos kyi rgya mtshos mdzad pa bcas rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ drug pa rdo rje la4 chen/ ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje/ mkhas pa shrī sidha/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lo tsā ba cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ gter ston ga rma gling pa/ yab nyi zla sangs rgyas/ thugs sras nyi zla cho me rje/ deng sang brgyud yig phal cher la gter ston gyis sras la gnang ba 'dra zhig 'dug kyang / gter ston sku tshe thung bas gnang long ma (46na)byung / yab kyi dgung lo brgya nyi shu bzhugs pas des gnang ba yin/ gter ston dam sel gyis gshegs zer ba'i sel can de nas brgyud pa ni min no/ /de nas rtsi dkar ba drung pa nyi zla 'od zer/ bla ma sangs rgyas dri med/ mtshungs med bkra shis bzang po/ rig 'dzin 'od gsal klong yangs/ grub chen bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog /ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ khyab bdag cho medabyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de gang shar rang grol la'o/ /yang na rtsi dkar drung pa nas/ sman mo ba rgya btsun nam mkha' cho ge kyi rgya mtsho/gu ru kun dga' lhun grub/ snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho man gong bzhin no/ /gter ston las 'phro gling pas gter nas bzhes pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/thang yig tu/ rgya gar su ta wa dang bhi na sa paṇ+ḍi ta ni gnyis gsum bod du 'ong : lha sa'i jo shāka 'di la mchod pa byed: lho kong byang kong sbas pa'i gter kha 'di mi gzhag 'don pa'i rtags de —70

gsang sgrub man ngag gnad thems dregs pa zil gnon dbang chog las tshogs dang bcas pa dpe tshan gcig tu bzhugs pa/ gsum pa zab 'khrid la/ ldang lha phra mo brag nas spyan drangs pa'i rdzogs pa chen po snying po'i rgyud drug /rdzogs pa chen po/ btags grol thams cad kyi yang snying gcig tu dril ba rdo rje yi ge'i 'khor lo/ lha ri zil phug nas rang byung shel gyi rdo rje sems dpa' dang mnyam du spyan drangs pa'i rdzogs pa chen po bskyed rdzogs thams cad kyi snying po'i bcud du dril ba rdo rje sems dpa' thugs kyi sgrub pa rnams/lnga pa snyan brgyud la/ sems 'khrid bla ma sku gsum sgrub pa'i sngags 'brel/ 'di'i sngon du semasa'akhrid gsal ba'i me long yod 'dug pa dpe ma 'byor bsam thob/ bla ma sku gsum sgrub pa'i mchod bstod bsdus pa'i lag len zhal shes dang bcas pa rnams (48na〉spegs par thob rang byung lta ba'i zab 'khrid snod dang bstun par bya'o'i mtha' can/ lhun grub sgom pa'i zab 'khrid chos 'di de la gtod kyi mtha' can/ spyod pa'i zab 'khrid nyams len gnad thems gtod cig sa mā ya'i mtha' can rnams/ bzhi pa bcud dril la/ bsam yas mchod rten dkar po nas spyan drangs pa'i rdzogs pa chen po btags grol thams cad kyi snying po bcud du dril ba bla ma ye shes lha'i sku gsung thugs kyi snying po'i rgyud drug /rdzogs pa chen po/ btags grol thams cad kyi yang snying gcig tu dril ba rdo rje yi ge'i 'khor lo/ lha ri zil phug nas rang byung shel gyi rdo rje sems dpa' dang mnyam du spyan drangs pa'i rdzogs pa chen po bskyed rdzogs thams cad kyi snying po'i bcud du dril ba rdo rje sems dpa' thugs kyi sgrub pa rnams/lnga pa snyan brgyud la/ sems 'khrid bla ma sku gsum sgrub pa'i sngags 'brel/ 'di'i sngon du semasa'akhrid gsal ba'i me long yod 'dug pa dpe ma 'byor bsam thob/ bla ma sku gsum sgrub pa'i mchod bstod bsdus pa'i lag len zhal shes dang bcas pa rnams (48na〉legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku tshe dpag med/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ 'gro 'dul las 'phro gling pa/ sprul sku 'od gsal rgya mtsho/ thugs sras lung rigs rgya mtsho/ rgyas sras gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ drin can gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na gter ston nas/ grub chen o rgyan bstan 'dzin/ gsang sngags bstan 'dzin man 'dra/'gro 'dul las 'phro gling pas spa gro stag tshang rdzong nang mtsho dkyil brag nas spyan drangs pa'i rdzogs chen kun bzang thugs tig gi cha lag khams gsum dbang sdud 'dod rgyal/skor la/ tshom bu'i —73—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khridarin cen phun tshogs/ bkra shis rgya mtsho/ kun dga' tshe mchog /pha jo gzhen nu don grub/ drin can chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /gar dbang las 'phro gling pa'i gter chos ma thob/ /nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po'i skye ba 'ja' tshon snying po'am las 'phro gling par grags pas nyam 'phrang rdo rje gnam klong gi brag nas spyan drangs pa'i sprul sku bla ma'i thugs sgrub bla ma'i sgrub pa la rdzogs chen du ming 'dogs pa 'di la rtse la sprul sku sogs khrel khrel mdzad bog zer ba thugs mad par snang / rdzogs pa chen po dkon cog spyi 'dus kyi skor la/ bla ma pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi dbang tshe dbang dang bcas pa nos nas/ lung la/ rnam thar kha byang / dngos gzhi'i gdamasapa/ lhan thabs sham bu dang gsum/dang po la/ sgam po pa mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i gter ston gyi rnam thar/yang zab nor bu'i lde mig /pad+ma'i zhal lung 'od 'phro/ chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan 'od kyi me long rnams/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i gdams pa la/ rgyud kyi snying po yang zab le'u brgyad pa/ dka' 'grel ri rgyal lhun po/ lo rgyus bla ma'i rnam thar/ las byang 'phrin las kyi rim pa/ smin byed dbang gi cho ga /sbyin sreg 'phrin las bzhi sgrub me mchod las mtha'/ dug brag sgrub pa dbang drag 'bar ba'i las mtha'/ yo ga gsum gyi sgrub thabs las mtha'/ ma hā yo ga'i bskyed rim/ a nu yo ga'i rdzogs rim/ pad+ma'i srog phur lta sgom spyod 'bras zhes pa a ti'i 'khrid yig /gtum mo bde drod 'od 'bar/ 'pho ba skar khung mda' 'phang / (50na long ban ting 'dzin bzang po'i zhus lan/ 'dzom yig nam mkha'i 'od klong rnams/gsum pa lhan thabs sham bu la/ yang 'grel snying po gsal byed/ rgya nag sprul sku gar dbang bstan 'dzin gyi dri lan gter ston gyis mdzad pa/ zhi khro bka' brgyad las khol du phyung ba'i rgyal ba spyi bkang / gdab las gdug pa kun sgrol/ drag po'i zor las/ gtor bsngo/ gter bdag mchod pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku kha rla pā ṇi/ sprul sku pad ma 'byung —76

mkha' 'jigs med/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /mi mos pa'i log rtog med na'ang gter gsar 'di skor zhu 'dun cher med par gong du 'degs gdong lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med kyis 'di rgya nag brag sgo'i bar du dar zer ba yod pas phyag dpe ma lus pa'i snyan 'bul zhu dgos zhes zur kun mkhyen chen por gsungs par brten 'di skor gyi dbang lung rnams 'bul phebs par 'di la mi shis pa'i grags pa che bas 'tshub cha yong mi yong gi thugs dam brtag pa gnang nas dngos grub ma byung rung ltasang na mi yong tshe bka' dang bstun zhus pas thugs dam gsal snang la legs nyes gnyis ka ma byung 'dug pas zhus pa yin no/ /thang yig las/ yar 'brog mtsho gling dgu la dmag sgar 'cha': stag thabs nang du gtsang pa sum gnyis 'chi rtsibs kyi lha khang sbas pa'i gter kha 'di mi gzhag 'don pa'i rtags de bstan nas 'byung ཿ skyon bstan (50ba tshe gnyis gling pa zhes bya 'byung : zhes pa ltar lha lcam nus 'byin sa le'i skye mtha' sprul sku bstan gnyis gling pa pad+ma tshe dbang rgyal pos gter kha mang du bzhes pa'i nang nas/rang gter las/ ri bo po ta'i lho phyogs rtsis kyi khang gi byang : gter gnas rdo rje phag mo'i bha ga 'dra ba ru gter du sbed gter ston ni khyed kyi sprul pa mdo sngags gling pa zhes bya bas 'don: gal te mdo sngags gling pas gter 'di ma thon na da lta'i lha lcam nus 'byin sa le'i skye ba gcig gis thon par 'gyur ro: zhes dang / 'on kyang 'du 'dzis rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)skor/ nang rtsa gnas kyi skor/ gsang ba rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi rnam gzhag /thun mong du dbang gi rnam gzhag gi smin par byed pa/ bskyed rim rta phag yab yum gsang sgrub kyis lus lhar sgrub pa ceX5 sogs gsungs pa'i rtsis dang rtsa gnyis 'dor mi gsal ba zab rgya rnying par gsungs/ rgya mtsho lta bu rlung gi rgya zhes pa zab rgya rnying par bstan par ma zad gsar ma'i bde chen gsang sgrub tu bstan/ nam mkha' lta bu lta ba'i rgya zhes pa gsar ma'i ye shes klong grol du bstan/ nor bu lta bu'i man ngag rgya zhes pa gsar ma'i zhal gdams nor bu'i 'phreng bar bstan la/ gter ston gyis gter gsar skor me ston nam mkha'i mtshan can sogs la gnang dus thugs sras rin po che'i gsung las/ mi tshe ring tsa na chos ma bu phrad nas thob pa'i dus kyang byung zhes dgyes pa chen po mdzad pa'i lo rgyus 'dug pa yid ches kyi gnas so/ /sprul sku bstan gnyis gling pas gtor khung brag nas gdan drangs pa'i khyab 'jug skor la/ rā hu la gnad du gcun pa'i 'khor lo/ rkun ma byung na khol po nor snyeg gi sgrub pa/ phung byed gza'i srog sgrub gnyid ma log na dgra 'chi zhing gnyid log na rang 'chi ba rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ skyon chos kyi rgyal po/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal lha lcam nus 'byin sa le/gter ston tshe dbang rgyal po/ nyi pa ba tshe bdag rdo rje/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rig gza' rgod mig dmar du grags pa'i yang khol gza'i sgrub thabs kyi brgyud pa yang gong bzhin no/ /dpal o rgyan chen pos gter ston tshe dbang rgyal po la mnal lam du dag snang gi tshul du gnang ba'i rta glud gtong thabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ phyon sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ sprul sku tshe dbang rgyal po/ nyi pa ba tshe bdag rdo rje/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ pha jo lhun grub rdo rje/ de sras gzhen nu don grub/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag za hor gyi ban+de la'o/ rdo rje 'am pa mgon po —82—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)skor/ nang rtsa gnas kyi skor/ gsang ba rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi rnam gzhag /thun mong du dbang gi rnam gzhag gi smin par byed pa/ bskyed rim rta phag yab yum gsang sgrub kyis lus lhar sgrub pa zhes sogs gsungs pa'i rtsis dang rtsa gnyis 'dor mi gsal ba zab rgya rnying par gsungs/ rgya mtsho lta bu rlung gi rgya zhes pa zab rgya rnying par bstan par ma zad gsar ma'i bde chen gsang sgrub tu bstan/ nam mkha' lta bu lta ba'i rgya zhes pa gsar ma'i ye shes klong grol du bstan/ nor bu lta bu'i man ngag rgya zhes pa gsar ma'i zhal gdams nor bu'i 'phreng bar bstan la/ gter ston gyis gter gsar skor me ston nam mkha'i mtshan can sogs la gnang dus thugs sras rin po che'i gsung las/ mi tshe ring tsa na chos ma bu phrad nas thob pa'i dus kyang byung zhes dgyes pa chen po mdzad pa'i lo rgyus 'dug pa yid ches kyi gnas so/ /sprul sku bstan gnyis gling pas gtor khung brag nas gdan drangs pa'i khyab 'jug skor la/ rā hu la gnad du gcun pa'i 'khor lo/ rkun ma byung na khol po nor snyeg gi sgrub pa/ phung byed gza'i srog sgrub gnyid ma log na dgra 'chi zhing gnyid log na rang 'chi ba rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ skyon chos kyi rgyal po/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal lha lcam nus 'byin sa le/gter ston tshe dbang rgyal po/ nyi pa ba tshe bdag rdo rje/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /sprul sku bstan gnyis gling pas brag (54na)dmar gtor khung nas gdan drangs pa'i gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar po'i gza' rgod mig dmar du grags pa'i yang khol gza'i sgrub thabs kyi brgyud pa yang gong bzhin no/ /dpal o rgyan chen pos gter ston tshe dbang rgyal po la mnal lam du dag snang gi tshul du gnang ba'i rta glud gtong thabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ phyon sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ sprul sku tshe dbang rgyal po/ nyi pa ba tshe bdag rdo rje/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ pha jo lhun grub rdo rje/ de sras gzhen nu don grub/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag za hor gyi ban+de la'o/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po —82—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ khonganabasod nams mchog ldan gyi drung du yang lan cig mnos so/ /gter ston bde chen gling pas gter nas bzhes pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/gsol 'debs su 'khrul med gling pa bcu gcig gsung pa ni/ chos rgyal dbang po'i sde rang nyid kyis gsan pa'i dbang du smu/dzad pa yin la/ gzhan ma thang yig las/ rta rgod thang la dbus pa'i tshong 'dus 'byung : hal po'i brgyud la me 'bar rdzong zhes 'byung : kha reg phug tu sbas pa'i gter kha 'di mi gzhag 'don pa'i rtags de bstan nas 'byung : phyon bde chen gling pa zhes bya 'byung : zhes pa'i gter ston bde chen gling pa ni/ rang gter las/ da lta'i lo tsā dpal ye shes 'di nas tshe 'phos lha yul du: gab/la rgyal zhes byar skye ba len: zhes sogs kyi skye brgyud lung bstan dang /thems byang gsal sgron las/ lan gcig dus kyi mtha' mar gyur pa'i tshe: 'gro zhig gling pa me khams me khyi lo: sku gsum sme ba phyon thugs kyis sras las can de dang phrad par shog: ces pa'i 'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes kyi skye mthar lung gis zin pa 'di nyid kyis mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus pa sogs kyi gter chos spyan (54ba)drangs pa'i nang tshan 'phying nga bang so dmar po nas bton pa'i tshe 'khrid yid bzhin me long gi skor la/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor du sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i dam pa rigs brgya tshe ltar bzhengs pa'i tshom bu'i tshul du bskur ba/ yongs rdzogs dbang bskur/rdzas dbang / gang zag sgos dbang / bka' gtad/ bdud rtsi sman dbang / mar me'i dbang dang bcas pa mnos nas/ lung la/ thems byang gsal ba'i sgron me/ de las byung ba'i chos skor la/ dbang gi sngon 'gro/ sgrub pa/ dbang dngos/ 'khrid dang bzhi/ dang po la/ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus rnam pa drug pa dang chos kyi kha byang bstan pa/ lung bstan dam tshig bka' rgya ma le'u gnyis pa nas byung ba/ thems med/ dag —83—

kun sel zhes pa khog phub bstan pa'i rim pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa rnams/gnyis pa sgrub pa la/ phyi sgrub tshe lha zhi bar sgrub pa pad+ma nga yi snying khrag /nang sgrub tshe lha khro bor sgrub pa pad+ma'i thugs bcud/ gsang sgrub tshe lha mkha' 'gro sgrub pa 'brog mi dpal ye'i skye ba lho phyogs su 'byung ba la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ tshe'i las byang dpag bsam ljon shing / tshe'i pho nyas 'gugs pa bud med 'tsho rgyal gyis sbyar ba/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi rim pa/ tshe 'khrid kyi cha lag gzu dpang zor 'phen bsgral las/ thems med/ 'chi ba brtag pa phyi nang gsang gsum/ rdo rje dra ba (55na)pa pad+ma bdag la yod ri skan gyi mtha' can/ 'chi med rdo rje rgya sdom/ tshe gta' sdom pa'i man ngag /phra brtag nyes pa kun sel lam gsal ba'i me 61nga du grags pa rnams/gsum pa dbang dngos ni/ thigs pa/ chos longs sprul sku'i ngo sprod thugs kyi thig pa'am gsang ba'i thigs pa/ 'chi med tshe'i btags grol 'dri thabs phan yon dang bcas pa/ mig gi nad sel nor bu'i sgron me/ 'pho ba mkha' spyod rang grol pad+ma'i snying bcud/ bar do mun sel sgron me/ tshe lha zhi khro'i ngo sprod mthong ba rang grol/ phyag rgya mtshan ldan la brten pa'i rtsa rlung gi gdams pa zab lam bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ rtsa rlung la brten nas tshe sgrub pa zab lam 'phrul gyi me long / mu dra dbang du sdud pa lcags kyu dmar po/ bde ba rgyas byed sha sbyor rdo rje'i 'phreng ba/ phyag rgya mtshan ldan la brten nas tshe sgrub pa mkha' 'gro lam khyer dang bcas pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas longs sku tshe lha rigs lnga yab yum/ sprul sku pad+ma thod 'phreng / mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ 'brog mi —84

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ rtonganadapal gyi ye shes/ gter ston bde chen gling pa/ bla ma sna chogs rang grol/ sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje/mnyam med chen pa rang grol/ sprul sku ga rma chos dbang rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag za hor gyi ban+de la'o/ /gter ston dri med 'od zer ram kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas gter nas bzhes pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/gsol 'debs las/ dri med 'od zer kun mkhyen thugs gter mdzod/ /sgo 'phar 'byed la gzhan gyis 'gran zla bral/ /dri med (55ba)kun dga'i mtshan dang lhun po zhes/ /rnam dag tshad ldan rnam gsul la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i gter ston dri med 'od zer ni/ thang yig las/ za hor dur sa dbus gtsang kun la 'debs: mchod rten 'og nas thod pa khyi yis g.yeng : bsam yas mchims phur sbas pa'i gter kha 'di mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags de bstan nas 'byung : gter ston dri med 'od zer zhes bya 'byung : zhes lung gis zin pa'i gter ston dri med 'od zer ram kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po klong chen rab 'byams par grags pas bsam yas mchims phu nas zab gter gyi shog dril 'ga' zhig spyan 'dren par mdzad na'ang / gtso bor bi mā la'i snying tig ces zab pa pod bzhi/ man ngag brgya bcu dgu sogs bstan bcos rgya shin tu che ba'i gdul bya rnams kyi blor shong dka' ba dag tshig nyung ngur bsdu ba dang mkha' 'gro snying tig tshig nyung zhing brling bas rtogs dka' ba dag rgyas par spros te gdul bya'i blo dang 'tsham par mdzad pa sogs zab mo yang tig /mdzod bdun ngal gso skor gsum/ rang grol skor gsum gyis mtshon te kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa'i klong du zab mo'i phyag rgyas btab pa'i gter kha rnam dpyod kyi mthu phul du byung bas spyan drangs pa las/ bla ma yang tig yid bzhin nor bu'i skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khar du spros bcas dbang chog tshangs —856
