rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)la 'jug pa'i rkang stegs sngon 'gro sems sbyangs bdun gyi don 'khrid/ bde gshegs snying po don la dngos su sbyor ba dngos gzhi 'od gsal snying po'i don 'khrid/ gshis kyi dang der mthar 'dzin sgro 'dogs gcod pa khregs chod ye babs sor bzhag don 'khrid rnams/lnga pa rgyab yig ni/ rgyab yig skor gsum nyams len yid ches skyed/ /ces rtsa bral gnyis med re dogs bral bar byed pa khregs chod rgyab yig nam mkha' dri med/ 'od gsal rang snang gong 'phel btsan 'dzin pa thod rgal rgyab yig nyi zla gza' skar/ mngon sum gong 'phel bar dor grol ba'i grogs btags grol rgyab yig yid bzhin lhun sdi/ba/ ma byas ye zin cen la bral nyag gcig bstan pa khregs chod yang yig nam mkha' glong yangs/ thems med/ mngon sum nyams len (57ba〉steng po'i don rnams ston pa thod rgal yang yig nam mkha'i glong gsal/ thems med/ mngon sum yid ches lung don mthun par bshad pa gnyis ga'i yang yig nam mkha' glong chen rnams/ drug pa sprin phung ni/ sprin phung skor gsum sems sbyangs rgyab yig ste/ /dbang po dman rnams gong mar drangs pa'i thabs/ /zhes bde chen dang dngas 'od gsal chen por sbyor ba rang byung bde stong bdud rtsi sprin phung / gsal stong gnyis med 'od gsal ngang la sbyor ba rlung sbyor ye shes sprin phung / chos nyid 'od gsal blo 'das chen por sbyor ba rnam par mi rtog nam mkha' sprin phung rnams/ bdun pa sgron me ni/ sgron me skor gsum yang zab gsal bar byed/ /ces thog ma'i gnas lugs gsal bar ston pa gzhi snang gsal byed ye shes sgron me/gzhi lam 'bras bu'i nyams len snying po ston pa dpe don gsal byed 'od gsal sgron me/ snying po ye shes gnad du bsnun thabs nyams len gsal byed gnad kyi sgron me/ 'di phyi'i don grub dngos grub sprin tshogs sdud pa bla ma'i sgrub thabs 'od gsal byin rlabs kyi gnad yig bdud rtsi'i ljon shing /thems med/ dus bzhi'i rim pa gnad du bsnun thabs khregs chod thod rgal 'od gsal bsgom pa'i gnad yig bdud rtsi dri med/ thems med/ brtul zhugs lam slong 'od gsal spyod pa'i gnad yig bdud rtsi rgyal po rnams/ thems med/ brgyad pa 'khor lo ni/ 'khor lo skor gsum rtag tu 'od gsal sbyor/ /—88

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ khong)zhes /lta stangs gzigs stangs gnad kyi snying po ston pa gnad gsum chos nyid 'khor lo dngos dang rmi lam bag chags 'brel rgyun gcod pa'i nyin mtshan gnyid med 'od gsal 'khor lo/ nyin mtshan ting 'dzin go rim gsal bar ston (58na)pa yang zab gnad bsdus ye shes 'khor lo rnams/ dgu pa gegs sel ni/ gegs sel skor gsum nyams len mthar phyin byed/ /ces pa 'byung ba'i nad sel rtsa khams mnyam sbyor byed pa rten gzhi lus kyi gegs sel/ 'od gsal 'char sgo'i mig gi gsal thabs bstan pa brten pa sgo'i shegs sel sgron ma snang byed/ ting 'dzin rkyen sel rig pa'i ye shes ston pa rig pa sems kyi gegs sel ye shes dri med rnams/ bcu pa nor bu ni/ nor bu skor gsum mchog dang thun mong sgrub/ /ces lta sgom rtogs pa byin rlabs dngos grub ster ba bi mā la'i thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par byed pa yi dam 'od dpag med kyi thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu/ las bzhi'i 'phrin las don gnyis 'grub byed mkha' 'gro phag nag gi thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu/ yud tsam nyid la ting 'dzin 'od gsal 'char ba nges don mchog gyur byang chub snying po/ thems med/ rkyen ngan lam bsgyur yang zab mthar thug yin bzhin snying po/ bar do'i 'jigs bral gdod ma'i gnas su sbyor byed 'pho ba 'od gsal snying po rnams/ thems med/ bcu gcig pa me long ni/ me long skor gsum 'di phyi'i don gnyis 'grub/ /ces tshe 'dir yid ches bar dor grol bar byed pa ngo sprod gnad kyi gdams pa dran pa'i me long / rnal 'byor phung po 'dor ba'i dus tshigs 'dzin pa 'chi ltas gsal byed dran pa'i me long / dal 'byor ring gnas tshe 'di'i snang ba ston pa 'chi blu yang zab dran pa'i me long rnams/bcu gnyis pa snyan brgyud ni/ snyan brgyud skor gsum bar de'i gdams pa ston/ /zhes tshe 'di'i nyams len gtso bor gsal bar byed pa (58ba)snyan brgyud chung ngu da lta ye shes rang snang /bar do'i ngo sprod gdams pa gsal bar byed pa snyan brgyud 'bring po bar do 'od gsal rang snang / de dag kun gyi rgyab chos gsal bar byed pa snyan brgyud chen mo nges don mngon sum rang snang rnams/—89

dpag gi mi lang yang / /gtso bo'i bka' srung sgrub thabs skor gsum la/ /zhes pa ltar rang dang dam chos legs par bsrung zhing 'gal byed dgra dpung cham la 'bebs pa dpal sngags kyi bdag mo'i gsang khyab par spa bkong ba dam can skyes bu chen po'i gsang sgrub snying gi dum bu'am srog gi spu gri rnams/ de yang / gong ma'i skor rnams dpe brgyud gdams pa ste/ /gtso bor tshe 'dir grol ba'i man ngag bsten/ /me long skor gsum yan snyan brgyud yi ge can tshe 'dir grol bar byed pa'i man ngag yin la/ snyan brgyud 'di gsum don brgyud gdams pa ste/ /gtso bor bar do'i grol ba'i gdams ngag bstan/ /zhes snyan brgyud skor gsum po gsang skor sgron ma drug pa'i man ngag bar do gtso bor ston pa yin zhing / yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud 'di nyid 'brel/ /zhes zur du bstan na'ang dung yig can na snying tig dang 'brel bar gsungs shing / 'di gnyis gcig gi grogs su gcig dgos la/ /zhes pas don du 'dir grol ba dang bar do'i grol (59na)ba'i gdams pa phan tshun gcig gi grogs su gcig 'gro ba'i 'phrul shes pa do'i phyir/ /nyung ngus don 'grub rin cen snying po'i chos/ /yang zab yid bzhin nor bu'i snying po 'di/ /bdag ni rjes la jug skal ldan don ched du/ /klong chen rab 'byams bzang po'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgur du bkod pa yin/ /zhes thems byang du chos sde sum cu rtsa lngar gsungs pa —90

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nge)ni dbang chog bzhi po gcig tu bsdoms pa yin zhing / sprin tshogs gsum/ gnad yig bzhi/ yang yig gsum/ bdud rtsi gsum/ snying po skor gsum ste nye snying gi thems med rnams dang kha byang gnyis the ba'i yongs bsdoms chos sde lnga bcu rtsa drug gi dbang lung rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum/ longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams/ sprul sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje/ gu ru 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/mkhas mchog shrī sidha/ rgyal ba dz+nyā na su tra/ paṇa chen bi mā la mi tra/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/ gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyan/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug /sprul sku rgyal ba zhang ston/ gu ru mkhas pa nyi 'bum/ chos bdag gu ru (59ba)jo 'ber/ 'khrul zhig seng ge brgya pa/ grub chen zla ba mun sel/ me long rdo rje'i mas gyi rnam grangs/ rig 'dzin ku mā rā dza/ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer/ mkhas grub thar pa gling pa/ stag mgo bya bral chos rje/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas dbon po/ stag mgo yon tan dpal ba/gu ru sangs rgyas ye shes/ rtag mgo sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ mi 'gyur las 'phro gling pa kun dga' dpal bzang / 'bri gung pa chos rgyal rin cen phun tshogs/ drin can bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog /rje ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ zur rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na stag mgo sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan nas/ sman rtse ba ma ti dh+wa dza/ sprul sku sna tsho gis rang grol/ 'khrul zhig bstan 'dzin grags pa/ thugs sras pad+ma 'phrin las/ gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer nas/ mkhas grub khyab gdal lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangasagrags pa 'od zer/ 'khrul zhig sangs rgyas dbon po/ kun mkhyen zla ba grags pa mtshungs med kun bzang rdo rje/ sprul sku rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / mkhas grub sna tshogs rang grol man gong ltar ro/ /yang na kun mkhyen klong chen pa nas/ pha rgod rtogs ldan rgyal po/ drin can thugs sras chos rje/ sprul sku rdo rje seng ge /mtshungs med kun bzang rdo rje man gong dang 'dra/ yang na 'jam dbyangs grags pa —91 —

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nge/ni dbang chog bzhi po gcig tu bsdoms pa yin zhing / sprin tshogs gsum/ gnad yig bzhi/ yang yig gsum/ bdud rtsi gsum/ snying po skor gsum ste nye snying gi thems med rnams dang kha byang gnyis the ba'i yongs bsdoms chos sde lnga bcu rtsa drug gi dbang lung rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum/ longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams/ sprul sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje/ gu ru 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/mkhas mchog shrī sidha/ rgyal ba dz+nyā na su tra/ paṇa chen bi mā la mi tra/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/ gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyan/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug /sprul sku rgyal ba 'ad ston/ gu ru mkhas pa nyi 'bum/ chos bdag gu ru (59ba)jo 'ber/ 'khrul zhig seng ge brgya pa/ grub chen zla ba mun sel/ me long rdo rje'i mas gyi rnam grangs/ rig 'dzin ku mā rā dza/ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer/ mkhas grub thar pa gling pa/ stag mgo bya bral chos rje/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas dbon po/ stag mgo yon tan dpal ba/gu ru sangs rgyas ye shes/ rtag mgo sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ mi 'gyur las 'phro gling pa kun dga' dpal bzang / 'bri gung pa chos rgyal rin cen phun tshogs/ drin can bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog /rje ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ zur rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang na stag mgo sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan nas/ sman rtse ba ma ti dh+wa dza/ sprul sku sna tshogs rang grol/ 'khrul zhig bstan 'dzin grags pa/ thugs sras pad+ma 'phrin las/ gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer nas/ mkhas grub khyab gdal lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangasagrags pa 'od zer/ 'khrul zhig sangs rgyas dbon po/ kun mkhyen zla ba grags pa mtshungs med kun bzang rdo rje/ sprul sku rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / mkhas grub sna tshogs rang grol man gong ltar ro/ /yang na kun mkhyen klong chen pa nas/ pha rgod rtogs ldan rgyal po/ drin can thugs sras chos rje/ sprul sku rdo rje seng ge /mtshungs med kun bzang rdo rje man gong dang 'dra/ yang na 'jam dbyangs grags pa —91 —

byang dpag bsam ljon shing las/ 'di ni mthar thug 'bras bu'i gter kha ste/ /dgongs gter snying po snying tig mngon sum sam/ /tshe gcig 'bras bu 'od lus 'grub par byed/ /de phyir 'di 'dra'i zab gter ba'i yi ge rnams/ /rgyal sras bla ma nyid dang mtshungs pas na/ /yi ge 'di ga gces pas snying la phur/ /zhes pa star/ mthong snang (60ba tshe(da kyi dra bar/ dbang gi ye shes phab pa'i tshe rnal 'byor ma zhig la sngags srung dngos su babs pa'i dus/ rnal 'byor pa 'od zer go mas sprul sku rin cen tshul rdor gyi skor dris pa'i lan du slob dpon rin rdor gyis gter thon nas re zhig gsangs te sgrub pa mdzad na 'od gsal mngon du 'gyur zhing sku tshe mthar phyin rgyu la ma —92

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ khonganagasangs pas sku tshe mthar ma 'byol/ skye ba de'i 'og tu longs sku'i zhing dang gcig myur na bum thang du skye bar bshad pa kun mkhyen klong chen pa da ltar gyi dus su 'od gsal 'ja' tshon gyi snang ba bsgom zhing nyams su len pa la longs sku'i zhing dar gcig myul bar btags pa yin tshul sogs gsal bar lung bstan 'dug pa bzhin/ skye ba sngon ma sprul sku rin cen tshul rdor gyis dgas lung phra mo'i brag nas chu mo glang la mkha' 'gro snying tig gi shog ser rnams spyan drangs pas rjod byed tshig tsam la dbang / de'i bag chags kyi mthus g.yo ru grar zhabrungs pa'i kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer ni 'od gsal khor yug longs sku'i zhing dang mi 'bral ba'i skabs bsam yas mchims phur dgongs gter gyi bka' babs te brjod bya'i don 'gro'i byin rlabs glo bur bas/ /yang zad gdams pa'i gnad rnams dus gcig shar/ /phyi rabs yi ger bkod pa'i lung bstan byung / /zhes rtsoms shig pa'i gnang ba byung bar brten nas gter gzhung brling zhing go dka' ba'i don rnams gsal zhing rgyas par (61na)bshad pa mkha' 'gro yang tig zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rin po che dbang gi 'phreng ba'i steng nas sdig sgrib dag byed skong gi spyi khrus sngon du 'gro ba'i dngos grub kun 'byung mkha' 'gro'i brda dbang / lus sgrib sbyong zhing sprul skur grol byed bum dbang / ngag sgrib sbyong zhing longs skur grol byed gsang dbang / yid sgrib sbyong zhing bde ba chen por grol ba sher dbang / sgrib kun sbyong zhing chos sku rdzogs pa chen po mngon du gyur pa tshig dbang / srid zhi'i don kun 'grub byed bla ma'i dbang / cir snang chos skur 'char ba rig pa'i rtsal dbang / byin rlabs mthar phyin pa mkha' 'gro'i dbang / rjes kyi bya ba gzhan don gnang ba sbyin pa/ bstan pa gtad pa/ bar gcod bsrung ba bka' srung bka' sgo'i dbang dang bcas pa legs par mnos nas/ lung la/ mkha' 'gro yang tig gi kha byang rin cen ljon shing / thems byang dpag bsam ljon shing/ de gnyis las byung ba'i —93

lcags kyi 'khor lo bskor ba lta bu/ bstod pa khyab 'jug chen po ma sgrub pa'i gnas dang bcas pa/ thems las byung ba'i gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar nag gza' rgod mig dmar gyi sgrub thabs me rlung 'khyil ba dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (peman ngag brgya bcu dgu /zab pa pod bzhi/ mkha' 'gro snying tig gsang ba'i dems dang bcas pa rnams kyi nges don gnad du bsdus nas mdzad pa zab mo yang tig gi skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang chog dngos grub chu bo'i steng nas spros bcas bum pa'i dbang la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i ye shes lnga'i gnas lugs rtogs par byed pa bum pa'i dbang / bde gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes ngo sprod pa gsang ba'i dbang / gnyug ma don gyi ye shes mchog dbang bde ba chen por ngo sprod pa sher dbang / 'od gsal snang bzhi zad sar 'byol ba ka dag btsan sa zin par ngo sprod pa tshig dbang / dbang bzhi'i nges don rdo rje'i glus bskul ba mjug gzengs bstod dang bcas pa/dbang chog glong gsal chu bo'i steng nas spros med kyi dbang la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i yi ge 'khor lo'i dbang / chos nyid don gyi dbang / mjug gzengs bstod dang bcas pa/ dbang chog byin rlabs chu bo'i steng nas shin tu spros med kyi dbang la spyod pa dang bshags pa sngon du 'gro ba'i gsol gdab/ maṇ+ḍal/ phyogs kyi zhing khams su 'jug pa/ dngos dbang brda sprod pa/ mjug gzengs bstod dang bcas pa/ dbang chog byin rlabs chu bo'i steng nas rab tu spros pa med pa'i dbang la/ 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing ngo sprod pa/ 'jug gzengs bstod dang bcas pa rnams smin rgyas su nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ zab (slob〉smo yang tig gi dkar chag nyi zla gza' skar/ de la bstan pa'i chos skor la/ sngon 'gro nges pa'i chos drug /smin byed dbang gi chos bdun/ grol byed gdams 'khrid nges pa'i chos bzhi/ kun gyi rgyab chos ngesapa'i chos bco brgyad dang bzhi/dang po ni/ dkar chag las/ gdams 'khrid nyams len bdun gyi sngon 'gro'i chos/ /thog mar lo rgyus 'od kyi 'phreng ba yis zab mo'i chos la ngo mtshar yid ches ston/ /brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /rang rgyud rnam dag snod du rung bar byed/ /gsol 'debs rim pa bdud rtsi char rgyun gyis/ /brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dngos su 'pho bar bstan/ /maṇ+ḍal rim pa gling bzhi rgyan gyur — 101 —

rlabs gsang sgo 'byed/ /snying po ye shes bla ma'i sgrub pa yis/ /smin grol zab mo'i de nyid mngon du byed/ /de ltar sngon 'gro nges pa'i chos drug gis/ /nyams len mthar phyin dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs/ /med du mi rung shin tu gces par bstan/ /zhes pa ltar yid ches shing ngo mtshar bar ston pa lo rgyus rin po che 'od kyi 'phreng ba/ rang rgyud dag par byed pa bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal thabs med pas/ /de yi gnad du 'di kun tshang bar bstan/ /zhes pa ltar rdos bcas kyi lus sbyong bar byed pa spros bcas bum pa'i dbang dngos grub kyi chu bo/ so so'i rigs gang yin mngon du byed pa dkyil rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)bu bstan/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa rtsal sbyong bogs 'byin bstan/ /dus kyi gsal byed 'chi ba brtag bslu bstan/ /'da' kha don gyi 'chi dus 'byer so bstan/ /gtags grol snying po ma bsgoms sangs rgyas bstan/ /zab don snying po gdams pa'i yang zhun bstan/ /tshig don snying po man ngag gnad rnams bstan/ /gdams 'khrid mdo chings ji ltar gdams tshul bstan/ /de ltar rgyab chos rnam grangs bco brgyad kyis/ /nyams len gnad rnams 'phyug med gtan la phab/ /ces pa ltar don gyi dgongs pa ston par byed pa khyung chen gshog rdzogs/ de'i bsdus don/ gdams pa'i spyi chings ston par byed pa bla med theg pa rim dgur son pa'i spyi babs/ dgongs pa'i yin tshul ston par byed pa zab mo bcud bsdus/ theg pa'i mdo chings ston par byed pa snying po'i don bsdus/ gdangs gsum nyams len ston par byed pa 'od gsal snying po/ dgongs pa'i la bzla ston pa nges don gyi snying po/ dgongs pa'i 'phyong chen ston pa mthar thug don gyi snying po/ gdams pa'i yin tshul ston pa gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnad gsal/ nyams len snying po ston pa rnal 'byor bzhi rim/ gdams pa'i gnad 'gag ston pa zab mo spra 'khrid/ 'phyug pa med pa'i gzer ston pa snying (68ba)po'i yang bcud/ rtsal sbyong bogs 'byin ston pa rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa/ 'chi ba brtag blu'i rim pa dus kyi gsal byed/ 'chi dus kyi lam 'khyer ston pa 'da' kha don gyi man ngag /ma bsgoms sangs rgyas ston pa gser yig can gyi yang snying btags grol snying po/ gdams pa'i yang zhun ston pa zab don snying po/ man ngag gi gnad ston pa tshig don snying po/ ji ltar gdams pa'i tshul ston pa gdams 'khrid don gyi mdo chings rnams kyi dbang lung rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams/sprul sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ gsang bdag ston pa gser yig can gyi yang snying btags grol snying po/ gdams pa'i yang zhun ston pa zab don snying po/ man ngag gi gnad ston pa tshig don snying po/ ji ltar gdams pa'i tshul ston pa gdams 'khrid snying po'i don 'khrid/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang bcas pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum/ longs sku snang mtha' yab yum/ sprul sku o rgyan yab yum/ rgyal sras dri med 'od zer/ rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i dbang du byas (73ba)so/ /sems sde man ngag gi don 'grel rang grol skor gsum du grags pa la rang rang gi gzhung ṭīka 'khrid yig dang bcas pa'i dpe rgyun snang yang lung rgyun yod pa ni gzhung tsam ste de yang rdzogs pa r+ṣa po sems nyid rang grol/ rdzogs pa chen po chos nyid rang grol/ rdzogs pa r+sā po mnyam nyid rang grol/ sems nyid rang grol gyi lam rim snying po'i don 'khrid/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang bcas pa'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum/ longs sku snang mtha' yab yum/ sprul sku o rgyan yab yum/ rgyal sras dri med 'od zer/ rje bde legs rgya mtsho/ bya btang blo gros bkra shis/ byang sems yon tan dpal/ sprul sku bsam grub rgyal po/ 'khrul zhig nam mkha' gzhen nu/ sras chosadabyings rdo rje/ rje blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med sna tsho gos rang grol/ grub mchog yan pa blo bde/gdung brgyud pad+ma 'phrin las/ gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ drin can gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /sna tshogs 'khor ba'i spros pas dub pa rnams gnas lugs chos sku bde ba chen po'i khams su ngal gso bar byed pa'i bstan bcos ngal gso skor gsum la/ mdo sngags kyi chos kun thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba'i lam 'khrul med tshang bar bstan pa rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso le'u bcu gsum pa/ de'i bsdus don kun da'i 'phreng ba mthong ba tsam gyis phyi nang gi gnad rtogs par byed pa'i lde mig /tshig don 'byams klas par ston pa'i rgya cher 'grel ba nges don shing rta chen — 112

par nang (76ba)gses kyi rten bzheng ba/ bla rdo/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum dang bcas pa/ dam shing bca' thabasagaza'o bdud srog gi spu gri gter chen bzhi'i nying khu gcig tu dril ba/ glo bur than 'gyed rā hu la'i gcig sgrub be+e ro'i snying khrag byang bu me 'bar ma zab khyad can/ me chu'i gza' gang gtong yang kha bsgyur chog pa'i las btsan thabs su bya ba'i gza' 'byed drag po dgra bgegs kha phung du gtong ba/zhag gcig gnyid log na rang 'chi zhing ma log na dgra 'chi ba'i gdams pa/ bkang bshags lhug — 116

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (pegasol dang bcas pa/ gza'i bkang gso khrag mtsho 'khyil pa'am dgra las rnam rgyal/ gtor 'bum bde legs kun 'byung / nad pa'i don du dgu'i nang du rgyas btab pa slob dpon bdud 'dul nag pos spyan drangs te grub thob me long rdo rjer bka' babs pa'i than 'gyed dar nag ma'am srid pa'i mes po dgu bskor gyi gzhung 'brin drag po cho 'phrul gu ru pad+mas mdzad pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/bca' gzhi mngon rtogs bzlas pa bya tshul mdor bsdus pa o rgyan pad+ma'i rgya'i mtha' can/ zhal gdams zhag gsum so sor sngags bzla tshul mjug tu ku 'byin 'jug zhag re re'i sngags kyi kha bsgyur/(77na)rdzas kyi khyad par/ thun sogs bstan pa dar nag ma'i zhal (3brin shes zur pa shin tu gsang bar nang gses kyi ling ga /tsaka li/ than gzugs/ than gtor ma/ bskam gsher gyi thun/ mda' dang bcas pa'i dpe ris rnams kyi lung phyag len dmar 'khrid zhal shes thob pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje semasadapa'/ phyag na rdo rje/ dga' rab rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ shrī sidha/ dz+nyā na su tra/ bi mā la mi tra/ pad+ma thod 'phreng / jo mo 'tsho rgyal/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/ gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyal/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug /sprul sku rgyal ba zhang ston/ gu ru mkhas pa nyi 'bum/ chos bdag gu ru jo 'ber/ 'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab pa/ grub thob me long rdo rje/ rig 'dzin ku ma rā dza/ mkhas grub klong chen rab 'byams pa/ yang na lha lcam pad+ma gsal/ pad+ma las 'brel rtsal/ rega'i rgyal sras legs ldan/— 1/7—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khridakun mkhyen dri med 'od zer/ 'od gsal rang grol/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa 'od zer/ sras zla ba grags pa/ byams ldings pa grags pa rgya mtsho/ rdzogs chen pa sna tshogs rang grol/ 'phan yul sman rtse ba blo gros rgyal ma' yin/ bsod nams rin cen/ lha grol chos rje ga me gu sa rje bshes gnyen phun tshogs/sngags 'chang rin cen dar rgyas/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /'bri'i (77ba)rtags can ma gtogs pa'i lung dang phyag len gyi brgyud pa ni klong chen pa nas/mkhas grub thar pa gling pa/ stag mgo bya bral chos rje/ rje sangs rgyas dbon po/ stag mgo yon tan dpal/ gu ru sangs rgyas ye shes/ stag mgo sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ mi 'gyur las 'phro gling pa/ 'bri gung gnam lcags me 'bar/ snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho/ sras du ma rang grol/ zur lhun grub rdo rje/ de sras gzhon nu don grub/ drin can bla ma chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na thar pa gling pa nas/ gter ston pad+ma gling pa/ de la zab phu sprul sku pad+ma dkar po dang / sprul sku chu bzang pa gnyis kyis zhus/ de gnyis ka la sngags 'chang gsang sngags rdo rje/ de nas rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ de sras rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po thugs rje dbang grub rtsal/ khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na klong chen pa nas/sprul sku dpal 'byor rgyal mtshan/ drin can mthu chen rgyal po/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang / thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje man gong bzhin no/ /'bri'i rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud ni/ chos rgyal rin cen phun tsho gos nas/ bla ma rin cen dpal/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin cen/ rat+na gnyis pa chos kyi grags pa/ sngags 'chang dkon cog lhun grub/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /rgyags brngan chen mo lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ rgyags brngan gyi phyag len gnad kyi lde mig gnyis sogs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ o rgyan chen po/ ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ dri med 'od zer/ bde — 118—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (pelegs rgya mtsho/ ma ti me ga la/ yon tan (78na tshe dpal/ sprul sku bsam rgyal/ nam mkha' g.yin nu/mkha' slong yangs pa/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ sna tshogs rang grol/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po/ pad+ma 'phrin las/ rje tshul khrims rdo rje/ bon lung gar gyi dbang po/ rje 'phrin las lhun grub/ drin can gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na kun mkhyen pa nas/ mdo khams pa dharmā kirti/ bsod nams dpal ldan/ bka' brgyad pa man 'dra/ yang na dri med 'od zer nas/ rgyal sras bzod pa/ bde gshegs pa/ dka' thub pa/ bka' brgyad pa man 'dra/bsangs kyi cho ga bde legs kun 'byung gi brgyud pa ni/ klong chen pa nas/ bde legs rgya mtsho/ bya bral chos rje/ sangs rgyas dbon po/ skal ldan ye shes/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ mi 'gyur kun dga' dpal bzang / 'bri gung chos rgyal rin cen phun tshogs/ 'od gsal sna tshogs rang grol/gong 'gog ter ston yin/ ga rma rgyal sras kun bzang / mtshungs med rin cen dar rgyas/ rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub kyis bsangs dang rgyags brngan chog bsgrigs su mdzad pa'i brgyud pa'ang bshad ma thag pa bzhin no/ /rdzogs chen don gyi gsol 'debs yan lag bdun ma sku gsum rnam dag ma/ bar do 'phrang sgrol gyi gdams pa dal 'byor rnyed dka' ma gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/dri med 'od zer yan snying tig spyi ltar la/ de nas ldan sgom chos kyi grags pa/ ngam ston nyi ma 'od zer / sprul sku chos dbyings grags pa/ bsod nams dpal 'byor/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ sna tshogasarang grol/ bstan 'dzin grags (78ba)pa/ pad+ma 'phrin las/ gsung sprul/ tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/'phrin las lhun grub/ gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na kun mkhyen nas/ bde legs rgya mtsho/ ma ti me ga la yon tan dpal/ bsam rgyal ba/ nam mkha' gzhon nu/ mkha' slong yangs pa/blo gros rgyal mtshan man 'dra/bla ma dam pa ku ma rā dza la rtogs pa phul pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sman rtse ba blo gros rgyal mtshan yan — 119

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (gernam thar sogs nas khungs ma chod pa 'ol tshod kyi rdzun bris ma nus so/ /gter ston chen po dri med kun dgas spyan drangs pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/rang gter las/ rig 'dzin pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru: 'tsho rgyal nga yi snying gi bu dri med kun dga' zhes pa gcig pad+ma mngal du sprul nas 'byung : zhes o rgyan chen po'i thugs kyi pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru las sprul nas zab gter gyi bdag por lung gis zin cing / gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi skye mtha' sprul pa'i gter ston dri med kun dga' ni/ kha byang las/ ye shes 'od mchog zab chos khyad 'phags 'di skal ldan las can rnams la phan phyir gsungs snod (79ba〉rdon nyung bas spel du ma btub ste ye shes 'tsho rgyal bsam yas mchims phu yi dge gong phug sbas gter srung rnams la gtad:pad 'byung sprul pa dri med kun dga' la gter lung bstan nas rgya yis btab nas bzhag: ces pa ltar/ bsam yas mchims phu dge'u gong nas spyan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po ye shes 'od mchog gi skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'bor du dbang mchog r+ṣa mo nas/ sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi bum pa'i dbang / nang lha dbang yongs rdzogs/ bka' gsang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang /tshig dbang rin cen rtsa dbang dang bcas pa/ sgrub thabs rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i steng nas rta mgrin gyi dbang la gsol gdab/ skyabs sems/ byin 'bebs sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pas dbang bzhi/ bdud rtsis sku gsum dbyer med kyi dbang / me long gis lta sgom spyod gsum dbyer med kyi dbang / gtor mas gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dbang / sku 'bag gi yongs su 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ po ti glegs bam rig pa rtsal/ bla med mchog gi dbang rnams legs par nos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/'jam yig las/ gzhi drug lam drug 'bras bu drug yi ge drug ma chos min yang : yin pa'i chos la — 12/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)yid ma shor: zhes pa ltar/ gzhi drug /lam drug /'bras bu drug /bu drug dang ni bzhi/ dang po gzhi drug ni/ sangs rgyas bka'i lo rgyus/ byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje'i brgyud/ gang zag snyan khung brgyud/ dgos chen don gyi brgyud/ lung bstan gtad rgya brgyud pa dang lnga'i sgo nas ston pa spyi khyab stong thun lo rgyus/ ma 'ongs las ldan gyi don du bla mas slob ma dang slob (80na)mas bla ma brtag pa dbang chog dngos te gsum gyis bstan pa'i ye shes 'od mchog gi dbang bskur smin byed/ lam mchog 'bras bu'i rgyud dam thugs rje ye shes 'od mchog ces bya ba'i rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa/ thugs rje chen po phyi sgrub kyi mngon rtogs mun sel sgron me sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su len pa/thugs rje chen po nang sgrub sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis snang rig sems su gtan la 'bebs pa ye shes 'od mchog gsang sgrub mchog thun dngos grub gdan thogs gcig la thob par 'gyur ba rnams/gnyis pa lam drug ni/ mdo byang sgom rim mdor bsdus bkra shis brjod kyi mtha' can/ pad+ma thugasarje chen po'i sgrub thabs 'dod chags lam 'byer bde chen rtsal sbyong / badz+ra thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs zhe sdang lam 'khyer rlung 'khrid rtsal sbyong / burnya thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs gti mug lam 'byer sku gsum rtsal sbyong / rat+na thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs nga rgyal lam 'khyer bsod nams rtsal sbyong / dmi thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs phrag dog lam 'byer 'pho ba rtsal sbyong rnams/gsum pa 'bras bu drug ni/ rta mgrin nag po rtsal gsum 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs dbang chog las sbyor dang bcas pa/ rdzogs rim sku gsum rtsal sbyong gnad kyi lam 'khrid dkar po drug sbyor/ yi ge drug pa'i btags grol zhes pa rgyu/ 'dri thabs/ rab gnas/ 'dogs yul/ dam tshig man ngag /phan yon bcas bstan pa/ lam rin po che 'od kyi phung po/ rje 'bangs rnams kyis slob dpon la zhus pa'i lan drag sngags rgya gad ma/ 'dzom yig mthong smon rgya mtsho rnams/bzhi pa bu (80ba)drug ni/ 'di las lung bstan phyi nang gsang gsum dpe ma 'byor bas mthob/cho tre u sku zhi ba'i 'phrin las phyi nang gsum la phyi ru gdon zhi ba zhes pa/ rgyal bsen/ rbod gtong / dus min 'chi ba/— 122

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nga)gza' skar ngan pa/ ltas ngan/ rmi lam ngan pa/ ngag mnan/ rgyal po'i chad pa/ pha rol dmag tshogs/chu/ rlung / sa bdag gi gnod pa rnams zhi ba/ nang du nad zhi ba/ mkhris pa/ rlung / skya rbab/ khrag /rims nad/ lhog bskrangs/ glang thabs/ 'brum nad/ chu 'gags/ mig nad/ sna nad/ so srin/ snying rlung/ cham nad/ chu nad/ srin nad/ gag nad/ 'dus nad/ phyugs/ ra lug /rta/ bya khyi'i nad zhi ba dang bcas pa/ gsang ba rnam rtog zhi ba/ thugs rje chen po'i 'phrin las gzhung srong skabs drug gis bstan pa/ longs sku rgyas pa'i 'phrin las phyi nang gsang gsum zhes pa phyi ltar longs spyod/ nang ltar tshe/ gsang ba ye shes kyi 'khor lo rgyas pa/ spyi khyab kun 'gebs gtor ma cha gsum gtong thabs/sprul sku dbang gi 'phrin las phyi nang gsang gsum las/ phyi zhing la srin 'bu/ ri bong / btsa'i gnod pa bsrung ba/ dgra la sa bdag gi dmag drang pa/ ltas ༅ dang rims gtang ba/ nang du 'dod pa dgug cing gsang sgo'i sbyor ba dang skye sgo gcod pa/ gsang ba 'dod mas bsgyur ba/ 'di'i rjes su rab gnas/ bdun rdzo /gta0sngo/ byu gon 'a lnga dpe ma 'byor bas mthob/ rtsa gsum bu dzi zhes pa thod 'phreng rtsal dang rta mgrin nag pos pa phyi nang gsang gsum ni/ phyi rbod gtong / nang rmi lam ngan pa/ gsang ba ltas ngan bzlog pa/ bdud rtsi sgrub pa phyi nang gsang gsum ni/ phyi lag mchod/ nang sman/ gsang ba thig le grub pa/ bam sgrub phyi nang gsang gsum la phyi bam dngos/ nang ltar sha sna/ gsang ba skye bdun sgrub pa/ bsrung ba phyi nang gsang gsum la phyi ser ba/ nang shwa 'od/ gsang ba rlung dmar bsrung ba/ dbab — 123

bsrung ba/ me'i gnod pa bsrung ba/ mi shis pa bsrung ba/ za thang dbang thang bskyed pa/ gshin 'dre — /24

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nganapho mo'i gnod pa bsrung ba/ sa bdag dang lha'i gnod pa bsrung ba/ dam nyams skyu gnod pa bsrung ba/bdun zur bsrung ba/ sde brgyad bsrung ba/ steng gdon bsrung ba/ rgyal po bsrung ba/ rgyal bsen bsrung ba/ (82na)chu'i gnod pa bsrung ba/ mna'i nyes pa bsrung ba/ bsen mo bsrung ba/ 'og gdon bsrung ba/ mi mthun pa thams cad bsrung ba/ gshin dur dang skeg bsrung ba/ chags che ba srung ba/ gdon dang god kha bsrung ba/ khyim bsrung ba rnams gyi lung phyag len dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston dri med kun dga' nas rim par/ pha jo gzhen nu don grub/ de sras chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /dri med lhun po ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu steng phyogs lhun grub yon tan dpag tu med pa'i zhing khams na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs/ rgyas dri med lhun grub dpal brtsegs rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar dbugs dbyung zhing / rang gter byin rlabs brgyud pa'i lo rgyus lung bstan las/ de 'dra'i dus su chos byed mi rnams ni: lho rong yul mtha' zad pa'i nags su bros: zab chos don tig long la rtse gcig sgrubs tshe la long med rkyen dang slo bur mang : longs spyod dbul zhing sgrub pa mi nus tshe myur mgyogs gsegs lam don tig 'di nyid dgos spel ba'i gnas mchog shar phyogs kong po rong : tsa ri yab yum gnyis kyi shar sgo la pad+mas byin brlabs skal ldan 'du ba'i gnas don gyi ti ka spel zhig snying gi bu 'di nyid ston pa pad+ma nga yi sprul sbas pa'i tshul 'dzin dad pa dam tshig can spyod lam (82ba)dal yang don gyi brtson 'grus can shes rab snying rje ldan pa'i skyes bu de pad+ma nga nyid dngos las gzhan ma yin dri med dkyil 'khor gtso bo ming dang ldan che 'brel chung 'brel thar pa'i lam mchog ston zhes slob dpon chen po'i dngos slob ā tsarla sa la'i skye ba sprul pa'i gter ston chos rgyal dri med lhun po thugs rje rang byung rtsal gyis bod yul gyi — 125

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nganapho mo'i gnod pa bsrung ba/ sa bdag dang lha'i gnod pa bsrung ba/ dam nyams skyu gnod pa bsrung ba/bdun zur bsrung ba/ sde brgyad bsrung ba/ steng gdon bsrung ba/ rgyal po bsrung ba/ rgyal bsen bsrung ba/ (82na)chu'i gnod pa bsrung ba/ mna'i nyes pa bsrung ba/ bsen mo bsrung ba/ 'og gdon bsrung ba/ mi mthun pa thams cad bsrung ba/ gshin dur dang skeg bsrung ba/ chags che ba srung ba/ gdon dang god kha bsrung ba/ khyim bsrung ba rnams gyi lung phyag len dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po/ jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ gter ston dri med kun dga' nas rim par/ pha jo gzhen nu don grub/ de sras chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /dri med lhun po ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu steng phyogs lhun grub yon tan dpag tu med pa'i zhing khams na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs/ rgyas dri med lhun grub dpal brtsegs rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar dbugs dbyung zhing / rang gter byin rlabs brgyud pa'i lo rgyus lung bstan las/ de 'dra'i dus su chos byed mi rnams ni: lho rong yul mtha' zad pa'i nags su bros: zab chos don tig long la rtse gcig sgrubs tshe la long med rkyen dang slo bur mang : longs spyod dbul zhing sgrub pa mi nus tshe myur mgyogs gsegs lam don tig 'di nyid dgos spel ba'i gnas mchog shar phyogs kong po rong : tsa ri yab yum gnyis kyi shar sgo la pad+mas byin brlabs skal ldan 'du ba'i gnas don gyi ti ka spel zhig snying gi bu 'di nyid ston pa pad+ma nga yi sprul sbas pa'i tshul 'dzin dad pa dam tshig can spyod lam (82ba)dal yang don gyi brtson 'grus can shes rab snying rje ldan pa'i skyes bu de pad+ma nga nyid dngos las gzhan ma yin dri med dkyil 'khor gtso bo ming dang ldan che 'brel chung 'brel thar pa'i lam mchog ston zhes slob dpon chen po'i dngos slob ā tsarla sa la'i skye ba sprul pa'i gter ston chos rgyal dri med lhun po thugs rje rang byung rtsal gyis bod yul gyi — 125

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 8)rdo rje gdan ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang ka ba pad+ma can nas tshad gzhal te gtsang khang byang gi dpal rta mgrin gyi phyag g.yon gyi 'og nas spyan drangs pa'i rdzogs pa chen po don tig 'gro ba kun grol gyi skor thog mar lung bstan bzhi shar phyogs kong rong tsa ri sprul 'bor gyi shar sgo rdo rje sgom phug tu zhal phye nas spel bar gsungs pa ltar bka' babs chos bdag nyi shu rtsa lnga spel nas rim gyi phyogs kun tu khyab par gyur pas/ pad+ma'i sprul pa zla ba shar ba 'dra skal ldan nyer brgyad rgyu skar bkram pa 'dra las can pho mo skar phran bkram pa 'dra zab chos bstan pa dgu tshigs brkyangs pa 'dra 'gro don 'phel 'grib zla stod zla smad 'dra bar gcod bdud ni sgra gcan 'dzin dang 'dra log lta can ni lho sprin 'thibs pa 'dra: o rgyan bstan pa'i 'tsho skyong shes pa na 'gro ba mang po thar pa'i zhing du 'gro phyi rabs skyes bu pho mo chos 'dis 'tshengs: zhes pa ltar gzhan phan rgya cher byung ba zab chos 'di nyid kyi skor la/ glegs bam/ yi ge drug pa'i 'khor lo/ sku gzugs/ thugs rten bum pa dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'dul ba'i bstan par 'jug pa nyan thos kyi dbang / mdo sde'i bstan par 'jug pa rang rgyal gyi dbang / (83na)mngon pa'i bstan par 'jug pa byang chub sems dpa'i dbang / kṛ ya'i rig pa gtad pa thun mong rig pa'i dbang lngas lus byin gyis brlabs pa/ u pa'i rig pa gtad pa 'dzab kyis ngag byin gyis brlab pa/ yo ga'i rig pa gtad pa bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis yid byin gyis brlab pa/ nyin mo dkyil 'khor gyi shar du gsang sngags bla med kyi spros bcas chos sgo bum dbang / srod la lhor byang chub kyi sems la brten nas spros med chos sgo gsang dbang / nam byed la nub tu phyag rgya mtshan ldan la brten nas shin tu spros med kyi chos sgo sher dbang / tho rengs byang du brda dang tshig gi ngo sprod kyis rab tu spros med kyi chos sgo rig pa'i rtsal dbang rnams smin rgyas su mnos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ lo rgyus kyi nang du thems byang tshig lhug tu 'dug pa'i go rim bzhin bkod par/ smin lam dbang gi chos drug /chos kyi phyag rgya bskyed rim gyi chos drug /dam tshig phyag rgya steng sgo rnam grol gyi chos drug /las kyi phyag rgya 'og sgo bde chen gyi chos— 126

mdzod (83bskoms/ gnyis pa chos kyi phyag rgya bskyed rim gyi chos drug la/ sngon 'gro'i chos drug /dngos gzhi'i chos drug /rjes kyi chos drug dang gsum/ dang po la/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma la srid pa bar do khams gsum du ldog pa'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i skyel ma rnyed pa lta bu'i gdams pa rnams/ drug pa kun gyi snying po rgyud kyi skor drug la/ bstan pa thams cad kyi dgongs don 'gro ba kun grol gyi rgyud chen po le'u bdun pa/ rgyud kyi bsdus don rin cen 'phrul gyi sgo/ rgyud kyi bka' 'grel nor bu'i phung po/ rgyud kyi 'bru 'grel yid bzhin bang mdzod/ rgyud kyi don 'grel rdo rje'i tha ram/ rgyud kyi gsang 'grel grub mtha' 'phrul gyi lde mig rnams/ bdun pa ma bsgoms 'tshang rgya ba'i gnad drug la/ ye shes mthong grol gyi gdams pa/chos nyid thos grol gyi gdams pa/ rig pa btags grol gyi gdams pa/ 'dod yon tshor grol gyi gdams pa/ thugs rje myong grol gyi gdams pa/ dgongs pa reg grol gyi gdams pa rnams/ brgyad pa yongs su gtad pa'i rgya drug la/ zhal gdams gab pa mngon phyung / ma tshang kha skong ba dgos pa kun 'byung / dam tshig gsal ba'i me long / dpal mgon dmag gi rgyal po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs bod — /29

dri med lhun po thugs rje rang byung rtsal/ rgyal sras o rgyan pa/ rje sangs rgyas 'od zer/ dran mchog sangs rgyas brtson 'grus/ 'khrul zhig pad+ma sangs rgyas/rig 'dzin nyi zla sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog thugs rje rang byung rtsal gyi mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang kong po bu chu bsam grub tshal lam gser gyi lha khang gi byang shar gyi mchod rten nag po bkra shis 'od mdzes ldan zhig gsos mdzad tshe srog shing gi lte ba nas spyan drangs pa'i khams gsum 'khrug byed las kyi rlung dmar ni/ rang gter las/ mtsho skyes rdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas rgya gar yul nasang na sngags du ma bsgyur ngan sems gdug pa'i bsam pa ma yin te: snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro dus cig kyang bzlog par mi nus pa'i rno myur drag rtsal thog dang 'dra ba nyid khams gsum 'khrug byed las kyi rlung dmar 'di: nga sprul bstan pa 'dzin pa'i khyad 'don yin: zhes mngon spyod drag po'i las sbyor shin tu rno myur can zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i skor la/ 'khor lo nag po zhakhrug byed las kyi rlung — 130

byin brlabs rdo rje'i ming :be+e ros byin brlabs gter bdag gling : zhes mnga' ris glo bo ge gar gyi yul dang sngags 'chang — /33

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nganagater ston chen po sprul sku mnga' ris rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rjes spyan drangs pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/gsol 'debs las/ gcen dang lhan cig nyid la khyad par du/ 'on bu stag tshang drag po dbu dgu yi skor/ spyan drangs gsang mtshan rdo rje gro lod ces/ mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes sprul sku mnga' ris rig 'dzin legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje ni thun mong gi lung bstan rig 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi skabs smos zin pa ltar dang / sgos kyi lung bstan ni o rgyan gling pa'i thang yig tshig sna ring ba las/ mtha' dmag dbus 'thib 'bri dang phag pa 'thab/ /dbus gtsang sil bu phag khyu tshal par gas 'on phu stag tshang sbas pa'i gter kha 'di: mi gzhag 'don pa'i rtags de bstan nas 'byung : gter ston rdo rje gro lod ces bya 'byung : zhes dang / thugs rje chen po dbyings grol gyi lo rgyus rin cen 'phreng bar/ bdag gi smon lam dbang btsan pas: rdo rje bdud 'joms skye ba'i mtha' byang sems spre'u'i lo pa gcig las ldan thog babs tshul du 'byung : de yis 'di 'byin 'gro 'dren 'gyur zhes dang / tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i lo rgyus don bsdus gsal ba'i sgron mer/de dus bdag gi thugs rje dang : khyed kyi smon tshur ma mtha' btsan pas: bdud 'joms skye ba nyi zla'i ming : drag spyod hur 'grogs brtul zhugs can dug lnga rags la yun thung ba pad+ma'i gnas chen sgo 'byed byed de dus zab gter 'di dang 'phrad: de yis bod khams lo skor bde: zhes pa ltar sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi skye ba gter ston rdo rje gro lod dam nyi zla'i mtshan can dang pad+ma rgyal po ye shes rol pa rtsal sogs sku gcig la mtshan du mar grags pa'i mchog (100na〉gral legs ldan rdo rjes bod kyi tshe brag dpal gyi chu bo ri'i tshe chu gsang ba'i phug pa nas spyan drangs pa'i bla ma sku gsum gyi grol byed la/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong / dngos gzhi bla ma'i rnal 'byor la — 151 —

gsum pa phyag rgya la brten nas sher dbang zhar byung bzhi pa tshig gi dbang dang bcas pa mnos nas/ rgyab rten lung la/ rtsa ba rgyud/ lung bstan lo rgyus/ sgrub pa dbang / bskyed rdzogs 'phrin las kha bsgyur/ hūṃ sgrub/ bka' srung dang drug /dang po ni/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod 'phreng rdo rje drag po khrag 'thung rol pa'i deng sang snang rtse ba phyogs rnams 'di la rgyud med sangs pa/— 153—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)gnyis pa lung bstan lo rgyus la/ gang zag mchog gi lung bstan 'khrul spong dang po zhes pa khri srong lde'u btsan gyi thugs (101ba)kyi klong nas grub chen dgu shar tshul sogs bstan pa/ bka' babs lung bstan gnyis pa zhes 'tsho rgyal gyi dpe rgyud thugs rgyud rnams kyi bcud yongs rdzogs 'dus pa gnam skas mkhar chu zang lha brag gsum sbas tshul sogs dang gter ston gyi lung bstan/bde gshegs yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i lung bstan gsum pa zhes bstan pa dar nub/ bde sdug /mtha' dmag 'byung tshul/ gter ston o rgyan chen po dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i ye shes las smin tshul sogs bstan pa/ cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i dka' gsang zab mo lung bstan bzhi pa gzugs dang chos kyi sku'i sgrub thabs mthar thug bstan pa'i skabs/ mar me la brten nas gdams pa spel lugs zhan byung gter ston la 'brel pa thogs tshad 'tshengs tshul bstan pa'i gsang ba'i lkog yig ma bu'i thems su bstan pa rnams/ gsum pa grub dbang la/ gu ru'i mthar thug gsang ba ye shes rang gsal gyi las khrigs gsang ba don gyi nor bu zhes pa las byang gi rim pa/ gu ru gsang ba ye shes rang gsal gyi sgrub thabs gyi skal ldan snying la bcang ba/ gsang ba ye shes rang gsal gyi dbang chog kun gyi thun mong ma yin pa yang gsang dgongs pa gter bcud/ kun bzang don gyi snying po mthar thug pad+ma rdo rje drag po sgrub pa'i rtsa dbang bde chen rol pa/ bde gshegs yongs rdzogs rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor chen por smin byed rgyu'i dbang bskur cho 'phrul ye shes gsang rdzogs spyi don rnam pa gsum gyis bstan/ lha dbang ye shes 'jig rten yang tig ces pa nang gi bum dbang lha dbang bskur thabs/ sde brgyad kyi srog dbang / bum dbang (102na)mtha' rten phan pa'i dbang bskur cho 'phrul chen po rin cen bang mdzod rdo rje slob dpon du mnga' gsol nas gzhan don nus pa'i dbang rim/ rnam pa brgyad dam theg pa'i rkan sgras brgyad pa/ nus pa mchog bskyed rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang gi cho 'phrul nor bu'i 'od zer ram zab mo snang ba'i 'od/ rigs brgyud rgyus byed gsang ba rdo rje 'phreng thag gi dbang chog /dbang bskur mchog gyur gsang ba byang chub sems kyi phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang — 154

(101ba)kyi klong nas grub chen dgu shar tshul sogs bstan pa/ bka' babs lung bstan gnyis pa zhes 'tsho rgyal gyi dpe rgyud thugs rgyud rnams kyi bcud yongs rdzogs 'dus pa gnam skas mkhar chu zang lha brag gsum sbas tshul sogs dang gter ston gyi lung bstan/bde gshegs yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i lung bstan gsum pa zhes bstan pa dar nub/ bde sdug /mtha' dmag 'byung tshul/ gter ston o rgyan chen po dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i ye shes las smin tshul sogs bstan pa/ cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i dka' gsang zab mo lung bstan bzhi pa gzugs dang chos kyi sku'i sgrub thabs mthar thug bstan pa'i skabs/ mar me la brten nas gdams pa spel lugs zhan byung gter ston la 'brel pa thogs tshad 'tshengs tshul bstan pa'i gsang ba'i lkog yig ma bu'i thems su bstan pa rnams/ gsum pa grub dbang la/ gu ru'i mthar thug gsang ba ye shes rang gsal gyi las khrigs gsang ba don gyi nor bu zhes pa las byang gi rim pa/ gu ru gsang ba ye shes rang gsal gyi sgrub thabs gyi skal ldan snying la bcang ba/ gsang ba ye shes rang gsal gyi dbang chog kun gyi thun mong ma yin pa yang gsang dgongs pa gter bcud/ kun bzang don gyi snying po mthar thug pad+ma rdo rje drag po sgrub pa'i rtsa dbang bde chen rol pa/ bde gshegs yongs rdzogs rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor chen por smin byed rgyu'i dbang bskur cho 'phrul ye shes gsang rdzogs spyi don rnam pa gsum gyis bstan/ lha dbang ye shes 'jig rten yang tig ces pa nang gi bum dbang lha dbang bskur thabs/ sde brgyad kyi srog dbang / bum dbang (102na)mtha' rten phan pa'i dbang bskur cho 'phrul chen po rin cen bang mdzod rdo rje slob dpon du mnga' gsol nas gzhan don nus pa'i dbang rim/ rnam pa brgyad dam theg pa'i rkan sgras brgyad pa/ nus pa mchog bskyed rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang gi cho 'phrul nor bu'i 'od zer ram zab mo snang ba'i 'od/ rigs brgyud rgyus byed gsang ba rdo rje 'phreng thag gi dbang chog /dbang bskur mchog gyur gsang ba byang chub sems kyi phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang — 154

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 8)mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /lo rgyus rin cen 'phrong ba las/ e ma dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs mi 'gyur dgongs pa'i yang gter 'di ma 'ongs 'gro ba'i don phyir du rin cen sa yi gter du sba: da lta dam tshig 'dresapa yi las ldan bu yi dpal du 'gyur zhes dang / rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ de ltar rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa'i bcud: 'phags mchog rdo rje'i gsung gis bdag la gnang : pad+ma bdag gis man ngag kha bskangs te dngas ma'i 'khor lnga ma 'ongs las ldan don: rnam snang thugs kyi sgrom bur a tham rgya: ma 'ongs lnga bcu kha ral yang mtha'i tshe gab sbas man ngag kun gyi bdag po gcig bdag gis byin brlabs thogs med bdud 'dul rtsal mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin byung ba'i dus: chos 'di'i bstan pa phyogs mthar khyab par 'gyur khyad par thugs kyi dam 'dres las can lnga dgongs pa dbyer med yang zab bstan pa skyong : zhes pa ltar sprul pa'i gter ston nyi zla 'od zer gyis slob dpon chen po'i lung bstan bzhin spa gro stag tshang nas kha byang gdan drangs te dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i bar khang gi bcom ldan 'das rnam pa snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas spyan drangs na pa 'dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi sa sna rdo sna la gar bu byas pa'i za ma tog tu gtams pa'i thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings grol gyi chos skor la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang chog bde chen dbyings sbyor gyi steng nas sta gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i thun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga/ thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje rgyal po'i dbang / lha dbang / rigs kyi bdag po'i dbang / byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang / bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / me long / man shel/ dar sna lnga/ nyi zer/ a mṛ ta la brten nas rig pa'i rtsal dbang rnams legs par mnos nas/ (109na)rgyab rten lung la/ yid ches bskyed pa lo rgyus/ dbang sgrub 'phrin las/ grol byed rdzogs rim/ gzhan phan 'phrin las/ bka' srung dang lnga/ dang po ni/ skal ldan yid ches bskyed phyir gdams pa'i lo rgyus (3ge rin chen 'phreng ba/— 164—

gon dang 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i thun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga/ thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje rgyal po'i dbang / lha dbang / rigs kyi bdag po'i dbang / byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang / bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / me long / man shel/ dar sna lnga/ nyi zer/ a mṛ ta la brten nas rig pa'i rtsal dbang rnams legs par mnos nas/ (109na)rgyab rten lung la/ yid ches lus pa yin min brtag /lung bstan ni thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas las can dag pa'i 'khor lnga/ gter ston sprul pa'i sku mchog legs ldan rdo rje/ la stod brag spyon legs pa mchog /bla chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag (110ba)za hor gyi ban+de la'o/ /mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen pos bsam yas mchod rten nag po nas gdan drangs pa'i gshin rje 'char ka nag po'i yang zlog gsad pa gcig tu dril ba nyi ma mdung gang mar grags pa des spa gro skyer chu'i lha khang nas zla ba bdun pa'i tshes dgu'i tho rengs gdan drangs pa'i sāts+tsha nag por brten nas tshe dang bsod nams bsnub thabs/ dgra bo'i bsod nams bsnub pa 'khor lo nag po'i las sbyor/ snying gzer nag po'i las mtha' pha rol dge 'dun gyi mdo sgrub kyi byas pa bshig pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po legs ldan rdo rje/ de'i mchod dpon sngags 'chang legs mchog pa/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul pa'i gter ston bdud 'joms rdo rje nyi zla'i mtshan can la slob dpon chen pos dngos su gnang ba'i 'chi med tshe'i sgrub pa nam mkha' zas su za ba'i gdams pa shin tu zab pa khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan yab sras gnyis la bya gshong du rig 'dzin rjes gnang ba'i reg zhig gi lung phra zhib phyag len zhal shes dang bcas pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku tshe dpag med mgon/ sprul sku o rgyan pad+ma tshe dbang rtsal/ yang sprul legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor brje'i mnog chos su gnang ba'i bka' drin bla na med pa'o/ /lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ glang phu chos rje 'jam dbyangs dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nge)'byin pa'i dus rtags kyi nang nas mnga' bdag nyang dang chos dbang sku 'brungs pa'i 'di man ma sgo ba shog ser nas 'bebs ra lus pa yin min brtag /lung bstan ni thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas las can dag pa'i 'khor lnga/ gter ston sprul pa'i sku mchog legs ldan rdo rje/ la stod brag spyon legs pa mchog /bla chen ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag (110ba)za hor gyi ban+de la'o/ /mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen pos bsam yas mchod rten nag po nas gdan drangs pa'i gshin rje 'char ka nag po'i yang zlog gsad pa gcig tu dril ba nyi ma mdung gang mar grags pa des spa gro skyer chu'i lha khang nas zla ba bdun pa'i tshes dgu'i tho rengs gdan drangs pa'i sāts+tsha nag por brten nas tshe dang bsod nams bsnub thabs/ dgra bo'i bsod nams bsnub pa 'khor lo nag po'i las sbyor/ snying gzer nag po'i las mtha' pha rol dge 'dun gyi mdo sgrub kyi byas pa bshig pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po legs ldan rdo rje/ de'i mchod dpon sngags 'chang legs mchog pa/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa/ des bdag la'o/ /sprul pa'i gter ston bdud 'joms rdo rje nyi zla'i mtshan can la slob dpon chen pos dngos su gnang ba'i 'chi med tshe'i sgrub pa nam mkha' zas su za ba'i gdams pa shin tu zab pa khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan yab sras gnyis la bya gshong du rig 'dzin rjes gnang ba'i reg zhig gi lung phra zhib phyag len zhal shes dang bcas pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/longs sku tshe dpag med mgon/ sprul sku o rgyan pad+ma tshe dbang rtsal/ yang sprul legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen khyab bdag zha lu pa rin cen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag za hor brje'i mnog chos su gnang ba'i bka' drin bla na med pa'o/ /lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ glang phu chos rje 'jam dbyangs chos skyong dbang phyug /lcags zam (111na/sprul sku kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug /zur kun mkhyen chos — 167—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /'bri gung gter ston mkha' grol slong yangs kyis spyan drangs pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/gsol 'debs las/ rig 'dzin rgyal ba rnams la gsol btab mthus/ dam chos rin cen phun sum tshogs pa'i gter/ bkra shis grags kyi dgongs pa yang zab don/ yongs kyis nyams su longs par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes gsungs pa'i 'bri gung gter ston mkha' grol slong yangs pa ni/mnga' bdag nyang gi gter lung las/ mu tig btsan ni sde snod kyi phyogs tsam 'dzin pa'i skyes bu yong : lnga brgya'i dus kha rag sngon mdun du lha rin cen rgyal po bya ba skye: sha mtshan mo mtshan cha 'dra 'ong : skyid shod cung zhig bde bar 'gyur: de nas 'bri zhes bya ba'i sde skyong ba rat+na'i mtshan can dag tu skye: zhes dang / rig 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi spyi lung mdor bsdus snying por/ lha sras sprul pa bod 'tsham sprul lo pa blo sgam snying stobs rtsal ldan gdong sme can: sna tshogs ming can 'gro ba'i ded dpon mchog:rin cen 'dzin pa nyi dros dus su 'byung : zhes dang / rang gter las/ rdo rje'i rigs 'dzin dha me'i ming : skyid kyi ming 'dzin pha ma yis bskyed pa'i sa khams sprul gyi lo pa ni chung nas phas bor ma yin ma bskyed pa: rig rtsal cher spyod shes rab blo ldan zhing : nges don chos spyod lha gsum don ldan pa gsang ba sngags kyi rigs ldan skyes bu ni: rat+na'i ming can ngas bstan chos la mos bstoganyisalo la zab gter sgo mo 'byed ces dang / de'i 'phros las mtshan rtags sogs bstan pa ni/ gter 'byin skyes bu'i gsang (111ba)ba'i mtshan rtags ni sku gsum mtshon phyir smin mtshams rtse gsum ris mgrin par gsungs dbyangs chos sgra sgrogs pa'i dung : snying gar bde gshegs thugs mtshone chos 'byung dbyibs ye shes lnga rdzogs spyan mi kha dog lnga dpa' bo'i mtshan rtags stag gi sham thabs— /68—

dang gtor — 169

— 171 —

bsdus9pal)( gan se)phyag rgya gcig — 172

gi 'phreng ba/ rat+na gnyis pa chos kyi (115na)grags pas mdzad pa'i zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga don gnyis myur 'grub bam dkyil chog rka)shin tu bsdus pa grags pa/ thems med/ des dben gnas 'brong ngur du mdzad pa'i dkyil chog don gnyis myur (ka)'grub zhi khro'i dbang la sbyor tshe bum bskyed kha bsgyur/ des mdzad pa'i zhi khro'i dbang 'phreng gi zhal 'phreng (ka)bkra shis (ka)'phrin las myur 'grub/ thems med/ des mdzad pa'i zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi sātsā'i cho ga (ka)phan bde myur 'grub dang bcas pa/ 'chi med tshe sgrub phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang / /smin lam gdams pa'i khrag rtsa gsum mthong ba rang grol gyi: chos rnams kun gyi snying po bsdus zhes pa'i gter gnas kyang thems byang gnad thems gsal ba las/'di rnams gter gnas mi gcig so sor sba: rin cen spungs pa klu bdud nag po'i 'phrang : khyung 'dra'i brag dang zha mu pa'i gtsug lag khang : dpal gyi bsam yas lha sa drug yin no: zhes pa ltar — 185

dbang nor bu/ sa skya bdag chen sngags 'chang chen mo/ 'phyong rgyas zhabs drung hor bsod pa bstan pa dar gud kyi skabs shig sde ba 'phrang go bar bdud sprul gyi bar gcod dang / phan pa bsgrub pa'i mi bdun 'byung tshul rje rin cen phun tshogs dang gter ston rang zur tsam bstan pa rnams/ shog ser klog 'bebs dang dbang 'khrid sogs kyi dus mkho ba'i gter bdag spyi gsol/snying tig gnyan po'i bka' srung mched bzhi'i gsol mchod skye med chos dbyings ma/ sngags bsrung rdo rje'i gshog rgod (rmu ge ma'i srog dbang gi yi ge /gter srung ོ mo rdo rje gshog rgod ma'i gsol mchod kyi rim pa rgyas pa/ sa skyong hor bsod pas bskul nas gter ston gyis mdzad pa'i gter srung gi gtor bsngo sngon tshe pad 'byung ma/ gzhog rgod ma'i bsnyen sgrub (grur)kog)las rnams kyi dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor dpe ris skor (zur)la/ pho 'khrid kyi 'khrul 'khor/ mo 'khrid kyi 'khrul 'khor/lam rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rtsa 'khor/ lam rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi dbang (127ba)gtor/tshe dpag /rta mgrin/ bstan skyong gi gtor ma'i shog khra bcas pa rdzogs par thob pa las rta mgrin gyi dbang rgyas pa ma gtogs pa'i dbang dang zur gyi rtags yod pa rnams kyi lung gi brgyud pa la spyi bye brag gnyis las/ dang po ni thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang yab yum/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ rgyal yum ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ lo chen be ro tsā — 192

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nge)na/ gter ston shes rab 'od zer/ da rma rgyal sras kun bzang / thugs sras dkon cog chos dbang grags pa/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /bye brag 'chi med sku gsum 'dus pa dang thugs rje chen po pad+ma dbang phyug gi brgyud pa ni/chos sku tshe dpag med mgon/ longs sku spyan ras gzigs dbang / sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal man sngar ltar la/ dbang chen dregs pa kun 'dul gyi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku rta mchog rol pa/ sprul sku pad+ma thod 'phreng man sngar ltar/ gshin rje'i yang bzlog spu gri reg gcod dang nag po bzlog med gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang / gshin rje gshed po/ lag na rdo rje/ shin+ti gar+bha/ o rgyan chen po man gong bzhin no/ /g.yung drung gi rtags yod pa ma gtogs pa'i lung yongs rdzogs dang rta mgrin gsang ba gcig grub kyi dbang brgyud ni/ ga me rgyal sras kun bzang nas/ slob dpon bsod nams rin cen/ sprul sku ngag dbang pad+ma 'phrin las/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /be+e ro'i (128na〉sgrul pa gter ston sna tshogs rang grol gyis bsam yas steng khang snying mdzod ba gam gleg po mun pa'i dkyil 'khor nas spyan drangs pa'i 'jam dpal gshin rje nag po gsum dril gyi skor la/ dug ri nag po gsum dril nang gcod dbang gi bka' dang de'i don gsal byed kyi steng nas 'jug pa/ dpung skud/ dur khrod chas dbang sngon du 'gro ba'i bum pas rigs lnga'i dbang /gtor mas sku dbang / bzlas pas gsung dbang / phyag mtshan gyis thugs dbang / sman rag gtor ma'i dbang / bdud rtsis gsang dbang / phyag rgyas sher dbang / ngo sprod kyis tshig dbang / las gshin gyi gtor ma sku 'bag gi chos dbyings ye shes kyi dam tshig /bgrang 'phreng srog sngags kyis sor rtog ye shes kyi dam tshig /phyag mtshan gyis me long ye shes kyi dam tshig /glegs bam gyis mnyam nyid ye shes kyi dam tshig /srog 'khor gyis bya grub ye shes kyi dam tshig bcas pa'i dbang rnams mnos nas/lung la/ gleng gzhi/ byang khog lus/ tsit+ta snying / las can smin lam bod khams bde la dgod thabs — /93—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)dang lnga/ dang po ni/ dang po sngon byung gleng nag po gsum dril 'di la ṣi ma nang khul du'ang lhad ༅ gyi dogs gnas mdzad mkhan mang zhing de ga 'dra ba zhig 'dug kyang thems byang gter nas brkus pa lta bu'i thabs zad pa 'dra ba 'di la dpags na yid ches su 'gro ba 'dra'o/ /gzhi'i khungs: gsal bar bya phyir lo rgyus yod: ces gleng gzhi gsal bar bya phyir lo rgyus la nang gses kyi ma 'ongs lung bstan sa gnad gso ba/ bsam yas su slob dpon chen po la rgyal po/ be+e ro/ gnubs chen gsum gyis nag po (128ba)gsum dril gyi skor zhus tshul thems dang bcas pa/ gnyis pa byang khog lus ni/ byang khog lus dang dpe mthun pa'i dus gnad sgom bzlas bsrung ba dang : gsum dril gnad kyi man ngag dang : ting 'dzin stobs kyis ngar 'dogs yod ces gong gnon zhi bar bsnyen pa 'jam dpal chos dbyings ye shes sems pa'i sgrub pa/ thems med/ yang snying bcud kyi dum bu rtsa ba rdo rje'i mkhar rdzong zhes pa tho rengs gung srod sogs kyi dus/ sgrub pa'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro'i man ngag rno la ngar 'dogs pa'i sgrub pa mdor bsdus/phan yon bcu gsum dang ldan pa'i 'khor lo'i bri yig rnams/ gsum pa tsit+ta snying ni/ tsita snying dang dpe mthun pa'i nag po gsum dril bcud dum dang : yang gsang drag po'i sgrub pa dang : nang gcod gnad kyi mig tshags dang : yang tig rdzogs rim rnam gsum dang : thun 'tshams bsrung 'khor rnam gzhag yod: ces tshe chi u ṣa gsum dril ba'i yang gsang snying gi bcud dum zhes pa mngon rtogs mchod pa/ bskul/ bstod pa dang bcas pa/ dpal chen 'jigs byed sbrags sgrub/ thems med/ man ngag mun sel sgron me/ thems med/ nang gcod gnad kyi mig tshags snying dum gsang ba zhes pa gtor ma/ tshogs thog mtha' bar gsum/ lhag ma/ chad tho/ zor/ bstan skyong / bro brdung / gdug rtsub sreg po'i sbyor ba rgyal po kun skyong gi gzhung bzhi bkod pa/ ma ha kā la lcam dral sogs bka' srung gi 'phrin las/ rang byung bzhi'i 'khor lo/ gsang ba srog gi 'khor lo/ gnas pa rtsa'i 'khor lo/g.yo ba rlung gi 'khor (129na tshe spo thems med/ bzhi ston pa'i thems/ rdzogs rim dang po lha la sems bzung ba/ gnyis pa gtum mo lam gyi rdzogs rim/ gsum pa rig pa mngon sum ston pa'i rdzogs — 194

gtad rta'i rtsibs ma'i sel nag /gshin rje'i gtad rgyud nag po las byung ba'i las gshin gyi mngon rtogs spyan 'dren gtor bkang /— 195

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nganagater ston chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis spyan drangs pa'i gter chos khag gi skor/chos rgyal dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal ni/ rat+na'i bstan pa spyi lung las/ ngo mtshar mchog gi gter ston nyer lnga 'byung : gsang gter nyer lngas bod yul 'geng bar 'gyur: thugs gter lnga po mnga' bdag sprul bas gdon : (130ba)zhes mnga' bdag gi sku sprul nyang / gsung sprul chos kyi dbang phyug /thugs sprul mnga' ris paṇa chen gsum gyi rjes su/ rang gter ārla pa gling nas dam rdzas myong grol dang lhan cig spyan drangs pa'i lung bstan las/ nyi shu rtsa lnga khyad par thugs gter lnga:da lta mgo nag spyi yi rgyal po khyod smon lam dag pa'i skye ba rnam lngas gdon dam rdzas 'di dang phrad pa'i skyes bu de skye ba du mar zab gter la spyad pas sku yi gzi brjid mtshan rtags bcu gsum ldan bden pa'i ngag 'grub sgra dbyangs tshangs pa'i gsung : thugs kyi byin rlabs dgongs pa'i gting dpag dka' bdag dang rgyal po'i yon tan sprul pa ste: 'phrin las rnam pa lnga la rang dbang spyod ces mnga' bdag gi yon tan gyi sprul par bstan zhing rigs dang yul phyogs kyang / da lta'i btsun mo bdud blon dam sel gyi bar gcod log pa'i dbang du ma shor na 'di nas nub phyogs mi nyag tsa shing gi rgyal rigs khyi'am 'brug gi lo bar skye: zhes rten 'brel 'grig na bsam yas nas brtsis pa'i nub la stod byang du mi nyag stong 'khun rgyal po tsa ma'i rigs su 'khrungs pa dang / dgung snying khyi lo pa sogs gsal bar bstan zhing sku gzugs rigs bsdus kyi tshe'i don dbang gi gtad rgya'i skabs las/ mnga' bdag rgyal po'i skye ba bcu bdun tshe: rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag gnyis kyi mtshams rong mdo chu bo chen po rgyug pa'i 'gram sa khams khyi 'brug lo pa snying rje can:drag shul tsho rol spyod pa'i rigs bzhi'i rtags: dkar dmar sme ba sprul gyi mgo bo can lag g.yas — 197—

btags grol gsang yig lnga pa/ bcud len tshe stobs 'phel ba mkha' 'gro'i gsang rdzas/ sdig can btsan thabs(132bskrang ba 'pho ba mdzo sum tshad 'bebasarnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo che/ 'gro 'dul o rgyan chen po/ bka' yi bsdu ba po ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ rtsa gsum grub brnyes khri srong lde btsan/ sprul pa'i gter ston mkha' 'gro 'phrin las yongs grub rtsal/ thugs srasarig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po thugs rje dbang grub rtsal/ gru gu'i sngags 'chang don grub bkra shis/ zur rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ /bla ma mtsho skyes rdo rje la rim pa gsum du yod pa las/ dang po srin mo sbar rjes brag nas nyang rin po ches spyan drangs/ gnyis pa dwags po gyer bye ma dkar po nas sangs rgyas gling pas spyan drangs/gsum pa 'di gu ru chos dbang gi gter zhabs dbang po'i sde skal bar byon pa ste/ de yang mtshams phug sgrub pa'i gnas byang las/ spur rgyal bod yul brag dmar g.ya' ma lung : rang byung gsang ba'i phug par tshe'i lha tshogs: zhal bstan dkyil 'khor bkrag ldan tshe chu khol: 'od mdangs gsang ba tshe yi dkyil 'khor gsal: zhes rgyal po khri srong lde btsan mi yul du lo sum stong bzhugs pa'i tshe chu bsgrub par/ rgyal po gnas 'dir 'byon du chas lags kyang : dmar rgyan klu dpal log pa'i bshol 'debs btsan: rgyal pos dad pas spyan drangs steng khang du yang tig thugs kyi gsang gnad rdzogs par gnang : khyad par gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje yi sgrub thabs rig dril rje 'bangs gsum la gdams zhes gtsang rong gdags (133na)kyi brag lhang lhang mar grags pa sngon tshe o rgyan chen pos bdud rigs dam la btags pa'i mtshams phug dge ba'i gter gnas nas lcags sprul lhang zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin sprul pa'i gter ston dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhes gter g.yog kun gyis mthong sar rang gter gyi skal bar spyan drangs pa'i gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje sku gsum —200

gyer bye ma dkar po nas sangs rgyas gling pas spyan drangs/gsum pa 'di gu ru chos dbang gi gter zhabs dbang po'i sde skal bar byon pa ste/ de yang mtshams phug sgrub pa'i gnas byang las/ spur rgyal bod yul brag dmar g.ya' ma lung : rang byung gsang ba'i phug par tshe'i lha tshogs: zhal bstan dkyil 'khor bkrag ldan tshe chu khol: 'od mdangs gsang ba tshe yi dkyil 'khor gsal: zhes rgyal po khri srong lde btsan mi yul du lo sum stong bzhugs pa'i tshe chu bsgrub par/ rgyal po gnas 'dir 'byon du chas lags kyang : dmar rgyan klu dpal log pa'i bgol 'debs btsan: rgyal pos dad pas spyan drangs steng khang du yang tig thugs kyi gsang gnad rdzogs par gnang : khyad par gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje yi sgrub thabs rig dril rje 'bangs gsum la gdams zhes gtsang rong gdags (133na)kyi brag lhang lhang mar grags pa sngon tshe o rgyan chen pos bdud rigs dam la btags pa'i mtshams phug dge ba'i gter gnas nas lcags sprul hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin sprul pa'i gter ston dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhes gter g.yog kun gyis mthong sar rang gter gyi skal bar spyan drangs pa'i gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje sku gsum —200

ba longs sku tshe bdag yab yum/ pad+ma tshe dbang rtsal dang jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal sprul sku tshe bdag yab yum gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan/ gter ston rgya zhang khrom/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug /gter ston chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/ sna nam zlor gar rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po thugs rje dbang grub rtsal/ yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu/ zur khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol / des bdag za hor brje'i mnog chos su stsal zhing rang gis mnos pa dang gzhan la bskul ba mtha' dag gi skabs su tshe mda' 'phel 'grib gyi ltas ngo mtshar ba dngos su byung ngo / /mnga' bdag sprul pa dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i zhes gtsang rong sbas yul —201 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)khams bu lung gi phug pa nas gdan drangs pa'i bla ma drag po ga rma gu ru'i skor la/ skyabs sems/gsol btab/ byin 'bebs sngon du 'gro ba'i phyag mtshan gyis bdud bzhi 'joms pa dang 'phrin las yongs sgrol gyi dbang / gtor mas sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi dbang / srog dbang drag po sgrol dbang / gu lang gi zor dbang bcas mnos nas/ lung la/ rtsa ba'i sgrub pa sprul lo gtsang thob rgyal du shog ser las phab pa/ 'phrin las rgyun khyer gyi rim pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i ljags bsgrigs/ des mjad pa'i sgrub (134na)pa'i las rim kha skong ba'i 'dod yon tshogs kyi cho ga /'phrin las drag po'i srog gtad mjug tu chos spel ba'i dus rtags kyi lung bstan dang bcas pa sprel lo hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyer dgu la 'bri gung rtse bar ltas ngo mtshar ba byung bar brten shog ser las phab pa/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi bkas bskul bar brten zur kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i srog gtang sbyin pa'i lag len/ gtor nag las kyi mde'u thung /gsang ba mu stegs gtor nag sprul lo gtsang thob rgyal du shog ser las phab pa/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang pos sbrags yang rdzong tshogs khang du mdzad pa'i gtor nag gi yi ge /der mi gsal ba'i gtor nag gi lag len gsal byed zur thams cad mkhyen pas khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba'i bzhed pa skong phyir mdzad pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ga me he ru ka /'phrin las kyi rig 'dzin pra bha 'a hasta/ gu ru rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal/ jo mo mkhar chen bza'/ chos rgyal tshangs pa lha'i me tog gter ston mkha' 'gro 'phrin las yongs grub rtsal/ chos bdag dpral bar sme ba can thugs rje dbang grub rtsal/ rigs sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor bsdo'i zab chos su stsal ba bka' drin gzhal du med pa'o/ /de yang lung bstan du/ gnas chen drag por zab gter spel: dus rtags ma nor gnad stem nga : spyi lung gsang ba'i gal mdor ltos: zhes pa'i gnas chen drag po ni sgrags kyi yang rdzong yin pas rje bla ma zur chen gyis gshed skor (134ba)zhu ba phebs skabs rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po yang —202

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nge)rdzong du bzhugs pa dang 'grig pa'i da lam gshin rje'i dbang lung bgyi ba'i gnas dang khyad par gter gsal 'di skor byed pa rten 'brel shin tu legs pa byung zhes dgyes bzhin du gnang ba'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar ba 'dug go /chos rgyal dbang po'i sde'i gter phran char 'bebs gla ba chu 'thung ma/ phyag rgya mtshan ldan 'gugs pa dbang dus med dang 'dra ba gnyis thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ spyan ras gzigs/ o rgyan chen po/ jo mo 'tsho rgyal/ rje khri srong lde btsan/ gter ston mkha' 'gro yongs grub rtsal/ rig 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang po/ sngags 'chang kun bzang dbang po/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/des bdag la'o/ /mi zad pa me pho khyi lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gsum gyi tho rengs kyi char chos rgyal dbang po'i sde'i 'od gsal dag snang gi tshul du byung ba'i gtsug lag snang srid spyi skong gi mdos chog ces pa lo rgyus bca' gzhi gyer gzhung dang bcas pa chos tshan gcig tu tshang ba'i lung mnos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dregs 'dul gsang ba'i bdag po/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ g.yung drung gi bon po sum ston nyi ma 'od zer/ rang byung gi bon po spang ston chos kyi dbang phyug /rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor lo sgyur rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ thugs sras rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ mkhas grub sha gzugs pa ngag dbang bkra shis rnam rgyal/ mkhas grub chen po dkon cog dpal 'byor/ rig 'dzin sprul sku pad+ma 'phrin las/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /chos rgyal mthi'i mtshan (135na7na gyi dgongs gter bstan bcos skor gyi lung nos pa la/brda don lam zab pad+ma'i snying gtam zhes pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor che ba lam zab 'bring po/ lam zab rab tu bsdus pa/ o rgyan rin po che'i rnal 'byor snod gas (5)dngos 'dzin ma/ yang snying bla ma rdo rje 'chang ltas)yab yum gyi zab dbang / thun drug gsol 'debs rten bskyed rang lus 'dzin med ma/le'u bdun brgyud 'debs rgyas pa pad+ma'i 'od kyi gzhal yas ma gter ston yan rig 'dzin rgod ldem —203—

'debs 6)kun bzang 'jam mgon ma/ rang bstod rnam mang rtos)skye ba ma/ de'i 'grel pa 6)rtse chen pho brang du mdzad pa/ yang rang bstod (5)dpal 'byor phun tshogs ma/ rgyal sras pad+ma chos rgyal gyi brtan bzhugs ltas)'od gsal lha brgyud ma/ ka —204

rgyal mtshan 'dra'i brag la mi 'gyur rtags thob spos shig gsungs: zhes pa ltar slob dpon chen po'i bdud rtsi yon tan gyi (142ba)gnas o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dang mtshungs shing bod 'bangs dga' dang spro bar 'gyur ba'i yar klungs shel gyi brag dpal chen phug gi byang rgyal mtshan 'dra ba'i brag me long lta ba'i ngos nas me mo lug gi lo la/ ji skad du/ ma 'ongs g.yo ru gra zhes bya ba'i phu lung zhi bar bsnyen pa'i man ngag /khro bo rtsa ba'i sgrub pa bskyed rdzogs lam gyi rim pa gsang sngags kun gyi gdams pa'i snying po/ 'jam dpal sgrub pa'i las gzhung bdud las rnam par rgyal ba 'jig rten gsum na dkon pa/ yang zab thugs kyi brnag pa'i smin byed dbang gi cho ga rnams/ gsum pa phan gnod las tshogs skor la/ yang gsang zab 'dril gdams pa'i ting 'dzin bsrung ba'i man ngag /byad dang rbod gtong bstan dgra sgrol ba'i bzlog pa sred med bu'i stobs 'joms pa/ dgra bgegs —215—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)byad ma gsod pa rno gsum mtshon la ngar btags pa 'dra ba/ bsnyen sgrub rtags mthong gi rnal 'byor pas mtha' sdud dgra bo mnan pa'i las mtha'/ phung byed dam sri spun dgu gnon pa'i las 'dis 'joms par 'gyur bar the tshom med pa/ sreg byed me'i las mtha' dgra bo myur du brlag par the tshom med pa/ bsnyen sgrub thengs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis 'phang ba zor gyi las mtha'/ yang zab bzlog pa'i bskul rang bzhin rnam dag ma dang bzlog gzhung chos dbyings drag po ma/ gzu dbang / bskyed dgug /dbye thun/ phur mtshon/ gtun bstab rnams kyi sgo nas gdab las bdud sde bye ba 'bum ya nga skad cig (143ba)la rlag par byed pa/ gong gi las sbyor rnams kyi tsak+ta'i man ngag 'di kho na zhes pa'i 'khor lo ling ga'i gzhung rnams/ bzhi pa bka' srung gter bdag gi skor la/ las byed bka' srung gshin rje gshed po'i 'phrin las kyi cho ga sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i lcags ri/ brgyud 'dzin bu gcig las gzhan la mi spel bar snying la gab ces las gshin gyi rjes gnang / gter srung dam can skyes bu thig le rtsal gyi gsol kha pad+ma thod 'phreng ma dang bcas pa rnams rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/kun tu bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dge /gu ru khrag 'thung nag po/ phung byed shin+ti gar+bha/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/jo mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ slob dpon be+e ro tsā na/ sprul pa'i gter ston gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ /(3) de dag gyi rtsa bar gyur pa thub pa chen po'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi skor/rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa de dag gyi rtsa bar gyur pa thub pa chen po'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi skor ni/ gser 'od las/ bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po gang la la zhig yul skyong zhing rtag pa bde —216

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nga)ba'i longs spyod myong bar 'tshal ba dang / skye bo mang po rnams bde ba la dgod par 'tshal ba dang /phas kyi rgol ba thams cad tshar bkums nas rang gi yul khams gtan du rgyas shing dar bar 'tshal ba dang / yang dag pa'i bstan pa 'jig rten du gnas nas sdug bsngal gyis gnod pa dang / sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams nye bar zhi bar 'tshal na bcom ldan 'das yul gyi bdag po de dag gis gdon mi 'tshal bar mdo sde'i rgyal po dam (144na)pa 'di mnyan nas yongs su bzung bar bgyi zhing mdo sde 'di klog pa dang / gdon pa dang / len pa dang/ 'dzin pa dag la'ang bsnyen bkur ba dang / rim gro dang mchod par bgyid na bdag cag dus tshad ma mchis pa'i lha'i 'khor gzhan rnams chos mnyan pa'i dge ba'i byin rlabs kyi mthus bla na ma mchis pa'i bdud rtsi'i chos kyi ro myong bar 'gyur bas/bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa sman par 'gyur zhing lha gzhan rnams kyang sman yon mchog thob pa 'gyur lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar mi'i rgyal po des sems rtse gcig tu mdo sde 'di mnyan nas yongs su 'dud pa'i slad du'o/ /zhes dang / shes rab khri pa las/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/ rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de tshes brgyad dang / tshes bcu bzhi dang / tshes bco lnga la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha 'don du byed pa dang / 'chad par byed pa na bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med/ grangs med/ tshad med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ gzhal du med pa mang po dag bskyed par 'gyur zhing de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha ton du byed pa dang 'chad par byed pa na lha'i 'khor mdun du gnas pa 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa ltar ston pa thugs rje'i bdag nyid can gyis legs par gsungs pa'i chos ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba yin la/ de lta bu'i gsung rab ni lha klu mi dang dri za la sogs ris med pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal ba la brten nas dbang por 'tsham pa'i drang nges kyi chos so so'i skad dang mthun par (144ba)bka' stsal ba'i tshad ni nam mkha'i pha mtha' bzhin rtogs par dka' bas nyan rang gi slob mi slob kyi 'phags pa rnams dang srid pa rgyun gyi mtha' ma'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang —217—
