rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)'di tsam mo zhes gsungs bar ma nus na so so skye bo rnams kyi yul lta ga la zhig /'on te rgya mtsho chen po las chu thigs tsam zhig yul dbus 'gyur 'chang sogs su 'phags pa dgra bcom rnams kyi bka' bsdu ba rim pa gsum dang 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ mngon par rtogs pa'i sa lam mthon por gshegs pa'i grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi sogs skyes chen du mas 'thor ba sdud pa dang 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab ste thos bsam sgom pa'i chu bo gcig tu 'khyil ba'i ma dros pa'i mtsho chen po las byang phyogs gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs 'dir mdo rgyud chu klung nye bar babs pa'i thog ma pho brang yom bu gla sgang gi yang thog tu dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par sprul pa lha tho tho ri bzhugs pa'i phyag tu nyi zer dang lhan cig par gser shog la be+eḍūrlas bris pa'i dpang skong phyag rgya pa/ mdo sde za ma tog babs pas bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ lag na pad+ma ma'i gzugs can srong btsan sgam po'i dus 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa thu mi saṃ bho ṭas rin po che tog gi gzungs/sher phyin 'bum pa/ thugs rje chen po'i mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig rnams bsgyur ba sogs bstan pa'i srol btod/ 'jam dpal rdo rje'i sprul pa rje khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la mkhan slob gnyis dang be+e ro tsā na sogs lo paṇa mang po dbu'i bla mchod du bkur te theg pa che chung gi bka' dgongs 'grel mtha' klas pa bsgyur (145na〉nis bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ sad na legs mjing yon gyi dus ban+de dpal brtsegs/ chos kyi snying po/ de wa rnye/ dpal gyi lhun po sogs kyis phang thang ka med kyi gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams la :sto ka bam grangs thems byang bkod par dkar chag phang thang ma zhes bka' 'gyur phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i thog ma yin zhid / de rjes ban+de dpal brtsegs dang 'khon klu'i dbang po srungs sogs kyis stong thang ldan dkar na bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams bsgrigs nas dkar chag ldan dkar ma mdzad/ sngon lha sras yab mes kyi ring la lo paṇa rnams kyis chos skad bod la ma grags pa las ming du btags pa mang dag cig mchis pa'i nang nas 'ga' zhig chos kyi gzhung dang byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang mi mthun pa rnams btsan po khri lde srong btsan 'on ljang —218

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)'di tsam mo zhes gsungs bar ma nus na so so skye bo rnams kyi yul lta ga la zhig /'on te rgya mtsho chen po las chu thigs tsam zhig yul dbus 'gyur 'chang sogs su 'phags pa dgra bcom rnams kyi bka' bsdu ba rim pa gsum dang 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ mngon par rtogs pa'i sa lam mthon por gshegs pa'i grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi sogs skyes chen du mas 'thor ba sdud pa dang 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab ste thos bsam sgom pa'i chu bo gcig tu 'khyil ba'i ma dros pa'i mtsho chen po las byang phyogs gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs 'dir mdo rgyud chu klung nye bar babs pa'i thog ma pho brang yom bu gla sgang gi yang thog tu dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par sprul pa lha tho tho ri bzhugs pa'i phyag tu nyi zer dang lhan cig par gser shog la be+eḍūrlas bris pa'i dpang skong phyag rgya pa/ mdo sde za ma tog babs pas bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ lag na pad+ma ma'i gzugs can srong btsan sgam po'i dus 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa thu mi saṃ bho ṭas rin po che tog gi gzungs/sher phyin 'bum pa/ thugs rje chen po'i mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig rnams bsgyur ba sogs bstan pa'i srol btod/ 'jam dpal rdo rje'i sprul pa rje khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la mkhan slob gnyis dang be+e ro tsā na sogs lo paṇa mang po dbu'i bla mchod du bkur te theg pa che chung gi bka' dgongs 'grel mtha' klas pa bsgyur (145na〉nas bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ sad na legs mjing yon gyi dus ban+de dpal brtsegs/ chos kyi snying po/ de wa rnye/ dpal gyi lhun po sogs kyis phang thang ka med kyi gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams la :sto ka bam grangs thems byang bkod par dkar chag phang thang ma zhes bka' 'gyur phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i thog ma yin zhid / de rjes ban+de dpal brtsegs dang 'khon klu'i dbang po srungs sogs kyis stong thang ldan dkar na bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams bsgrigs nas dkar chag ldan dkar ma mdzad/ sngon lha sras yab mes kyi ring la lo paṇa rnams kyis chos skad bod la ma grags pa las ming du btags pa mang dag cig mchis pa'i nang nas 'ga' zhig chos kyi gzhung dang byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang mi mthun pa rnams btsan po khri lde srong btsan 'on ljang —218

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nganardo na bzhugs pa'i dus nyi 'og gi mkhan po ā tsarla dzi na mi tra/ su ren+d+ra bodhi/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi/ dwa na shī la/ bo dhi mi tra dang / bod kyi mkhan po rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ dharma tā shī la/ lo tsā ba dz+nyā na sen/ dza ya rak+ṣi ta/mañdzu shrī warma/ nā len+da ra sne spro she la sogs lo paṇa rnams la rgyal pos dpyad pa gyis shig par bka' gnang ste 'gyur rnying ming bcos su mi rung ba rnams kyang bcos skad kyi ming gces so 'tshal gyis kyang bsnan nas theg pa che chung gi gzhung las ji ltar 'byung ba dang g.yin pa'i mkhan po chen po nā ga rdzu na dang ba su bye sogs kyis ji ltar bshad pa dang byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang yang bstun te 'jal dka' ba rnams kyang tshig so sor phral nas gtan tshigs kyis bshad de gzhung du bris/ skad (145ba)rkyang pa bshad mi 'tshal ba sgra ji bzhin du bsgyur bar rigs pa rnams kyang sgra btsan par bgyis te ming du btags/ skad kha cig don bzhin du gdags par rigs pa rnams kyang don btsan par bgyis te ming du btags nas lo paṇa rnams kyis rje blon gdan 'dzoms pa la zhus nas skad gsar bcad che 'bring chung gsum gyis gtan la legs par phab/ sngar ma 'gyur ba mang po gsar du bsgyur/ bstan pa phyi dar la paṇ+ḍita : ti dz+nyā na kirti/ jo bo chen po mar me mdzad/ kha che paṇa chen bsod nams pa shākya shrī sogs 'phags yul gyi paṇ+ḍita du ma dang / lo chen rin bzang dang 'brog mi sogs 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu mang du byon te mdo rgyud kyi bka' bstan bcos mtha' klas pa bsgyur zhing / bcom ldan ral gri'i slob ma 'jam dgag pa shis rgya nag nas bka' 'gyur ro cog bzhengs pa'i cha rkyen du dngos po mang du bskur ba la brten nas 'dul ba lung gi ma dpe sngon mtshims nam mkha' grags kyis bzhengs pa dang / mdo sde'i skor chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i thugs dam lha mi'i rgyan mchog /gtsang chu mig ring mo'i mdo mang 'dar phyar bas/ gru spangs rtsa'i thugs dam 'dzam gling rgyan/zha lu gser khang gi mdo mang mchims kyi thugs dam gser gzhud ma/ phyugs rgyal ma/ dgon gsar ma le tshan/ spun gsum gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i mdo mang sogs gung bsgrigs/ sher phyogs rgyud 'bum dang bcas pa dbus pa blo gsal sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba bsod nams 'od zer/ rgyang —219

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (pa)po bcom brlag tu bsdus pa'i lung zhu ba ma rdzogs pa 'di dag pa yin la/ de'ang gangs ri'i ljongs su 'gyur ro cog gi lung sde taḥthams cad bsrungs/(150na)dharma ko lnga cha kyi mdzod/dharma rak+ṣi taḥyu gur gyi slob dpon nyi shu ni/chosa'atsho/ka phywa ṇa rak+ṣi taḥdage ba 'tsho/pradz+nyā rak+ṣi taḥshes rab 'tsho/shrī ma sgo pa de shaḥlam nye bar ston pa'i dpal/mok+ṣa rak+ṣi taḥthar pa 'tsho/ka phywa ṇa rak+ṣi taḥdage legs 'tsho/gong dkar ba'i gas yig na 'di ltar byung zhing dpa' bo'i gas yig na ka myu bha dra zhes snang ba brtag/bi dzi pra bha waḥrnam par rgyas pa'i 'od/a mṛ ta warmaḥtsha med go cha/pra bhā ka ra se naḥ'od kye yang gnas sde/khu pen gyi slob dpon brgyad ni/dpa' ba'i gsan yig na bha thung byas te 'od byed du bsgyur bog go/a di du se naḥnyi ma'i sde/ma sgo pa de shaḥlam nye bar ston pa/saṃ gha se naḥdage bon sde/shī la dwa saḥtshul khrims 'bangs/ya sha dwa saḥsnyan grags 'bangs/bzhi dwa saḥsangs rgyas 'bangs/shik+ṣa bha draḥbaslab pa bzang po/gu ṇa so maḥyon to zla ba/ a sho ka mi tra:mya ga med pa'i bshes gnyen/shukla mi lha dkar tsho bshes gnyen/shākya mi traḥshākya bshes gnyen/shī la mi traḥtshul khrims bshes ga 'a/ka yol gyi slob dpon yin/gnyen dbus pa blo gsal sangs rgyas 'bum/sa gsum gyi mgon po chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/tso ma' rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig tu dbus pa blo gsal la 'phags pa rin po che gsan pa'i phyag phyir dbus kyi dga' ldan bde ba can pa bkra shis dpal gyis gsan tshul dang 'bri gung du bzhugs pa'i bka' 'gyur dkar chag bshes gnyen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad par lo rgyus de ltar grags pa'i bkra shis dpal la rin cen 'od zer gyis gsan zer ba snang yang brgyud pa gzhan na 'phags pa rin po cher bkra shi go4chubs zer spu 4 snyug go/bla ma rin cen 'od zer/mkhan chen bzod pa dpal/dga' gzugasapa/rje bsod nams tshul khrims/bra bar mkhan chen shes rab (150bsho rje/mkhan chen blo gsal ba/dmar ston dpal ldan rin cen/dmar ston rgya mtsho rin cen/rje bsod nams rin cen/mkhan chen 'gro bzang snying po/'dul 'dzin dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/'bum rams pa rin cen chos dbang /rab stims pa tshul khrims dbang phyug/dpa' bo chos rgyal don grub/spyan snga dan sgo cog 'bangs/drung pa grags pa don grub/sdom brtson tsho gos gnyis dpal grub/snga btsun grub pa'i rdo rje/ga'i dag4khri po bar nams mchog ldan gyis 'du mo lung sngar nas gsan grub pa /bye ༷sa mdo mang sher phyogs kyi lung 'tshos bar rje sman lung pas byon

traḥtshul khrims bshes ga 'a/ka yol gyi slob dpon yin/gnyen dbus pa blo gsal sangs rgyas 'bum/sa gsum gyi mgon po chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/tso ma' rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig tu dbus pa blo gsal la 'phags pa rin po che gsan pa'i phyag phyir dbus kyi dga' ldan bde ba can pa bkra shis dpal gyis gsan tshul dang 'bri gung du bzhugs pa'i bka' 'gyur dkar chag bshes gnyen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad par lo rgyus de ltar grags pa'i bkra shis dpal la rin cen 'od zer gyis gsan zer ba snang yang brgyud pa gzhan na 'phags pa rin po cher bkra shi go4chubs zer bar snyug go/bla ma rin cen 'od zer/mkhan chen bzod pa dpal/dga' gzugasapa/rje bsod nams tshul khrims/bra bar mkhan chen shes rab (150bsho rje/mkhan chen blo gsal ba/dmar ston dpal ldan rin cen/dmar ston rgya mtsho rin cen/rje bsod nams rin cen/mkhan chen 'gro bzang snying po/'dul 'dzin dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/'bum rams pa rin cen chos dbang /rab 'byams pa tshul khrims dbang phyug/dpa' bo chos rgyal don grub/spyan snga dkon cog 'bangs/drung pa grags pa don grub/sdom brtson tsho gos gnyis dpal grub/snga btsun grub pa'i rdo rje/sa yodag4tshe po bar nams mchog ldan gyis 'dul lung sngar nas gsan grub pa /bye ༷sa mdo mang sher phyogs kyi lung 'tshos bar rje sman lung pas byon

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ khong)skabs ma gsan 'dug kyang rjes su sdom brtson bsod snyoms pa 'di la rong gi lung sbug tu ched gnyer gyis gsan par snang ngo / /mkhas bas chen po blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rje/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ /yang na dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum nas/ ne'u paṇa chen/ brag tshab mkhan po gzhen nu bsod nams/ brag tshab slob dpon bsod nams rdo rje/ dmar ston dpal ldan rin cen man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ bde ba can pa bkra shis dpal/ skyor lung mngon pa ba rin cen 'od zer/'dul 'dzin bsod nams ye shes/ 'dul 'dzin bsod nams bzang po/ bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims/ kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang / rje 'jigs med grags pa/ bla ma nam mkha' rgyal mtsho/ mang thos rgyal mtshan bzang po/ dwags ram pa chos rgyal bstan pa/ dpa' bo chos rgyal don grub man 'dra/ yang na mngon pa ba rin cen 'od zer nas/ skyor lung pa 'phags pa rgyal mtshan/ nyang ro ba dkon cog seng ge /bsod nams ye shes man (151na)gong bzhin no/ /gzhung bla ma dang so thar gyi mdo gnyis kyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ 'dul 'dzin bsod nams bzang po nas/ bla ma dkon cog seng ge /rje bsod nams ye shes/ de la dka' bzhi pa grags gzhon dang byang sems pa gnyis gas gsan/ gnyis ka la mkhan bsod nams bzang po/ slob dpon dpal ldan bzang po/ mkhan nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams rin cen/ rje nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ dwags ram pa chos rgyal bstan pa man 'dra/ /bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor las yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang sher phyin sna tshogs pa'i skor/gnyis pa bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor las byung ba sher phyogs la/ yum rgyas pa 'bum ni shing rta chen po klu sgrub kyis klu'i yul nas spyan drangs pa'i tshe byams zhus/ chos 'phags/—227

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)rtag tu ngu / yongs gtad de le'u bzhi gdengs can rnams kyi mchod gnas su bzhag pas mi'i yul du ma 'drongs/ deng sang byams zhus dang chos 'phags bsdoms pa'i leg rtag tu ngu'i leg yongasagatad de le'u gsum du snang ba nyi khri dang brgyad stong pa nas kha bskangs pa 'gos chos grub kyis rgya nag nas bsgyur pa yod pas dngos bstan du 'khrul gzhi mi bya zhing / de'ang lha btsad po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus rlangs khams pa go chas 'bum thugs la bzung nas bsgyur bas rlangs kyi thugs 'gyur ma/ rje btsad po'i mtshal khrag dang ra dkar gyi 'o ma sbyar nas bris pa'i dum pa bzhi pa la reg zig dmar po lha sa gong gi so phag mchod rten gyi nang bzhugs la yod par grags/ la la kong po bu chur yod zer ba ni mkhan slob 'tsho gsum gyi shangs mtshal gyi 'bum dmar sprul sku dri med lhun pos gter nas spyan (151ba)drangs pa de dang nor gzhi byung bar mngon/ sbas mañdzu shrī dang nyang isgri wa ro gnyis kyis blangs pa'i rgya dpe'i steng nas yo byad rnams mnga' 'bangs la dpya khral bsdus nas dpya 'bum du grags pa/ rje'i dbu skra'i gzhob rams la bsres te ra dkar gyi 'o ma dang sbyar nas bris pa'i reg zig sngon po dum pa bzhi pa de la glegs bam 'di rnams ha cang bsdus pa'i zin bris lta bur song bas slar 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu be+e ro tsa nas rgya dpe dang bstun nas zhu chen du mdzad par dum bu drug pa glegs shing la gras nas par bkab can dang / gsung rab kyi bar du pha wang gi tshang bcas pas pha wang can du'ang brjod pa bla 'gyur 'bring po/ 'brom gza' byang chub sman gyis ke tu gling du g.yos mal bcas nas zan sna bcu gsum res sad mi mi bdun sogs rab byung sum brgya la bsnyen bkur te yum rgyas pa bam po re la shog dril re byas pa'i steng nas gdugs tshod thon pa dang —228

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khridagasum po 'di'i rnam gzhag don gyi thob pa zhig yod 'dra'o/ /de ltar yum bsdus pa paṇ+ḍi (154na)shākya se na dang dz+nyā na dbus kyi 'grel pa la gtugs nas bcos shing / skyid shod snye thang na mo cher jo 'brom yab sras kyis brgyad stong pa gsungs pa'i tshe che long zhig gtan la phab/ slar yang byang rwa sgreng du 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis rgya dpe gsum la gtugs nas lan gnyis su zhus dag cing /de rjes rngog lo tsā ba chen pos kha che'i dpe dang yul dbus kyi rgya dpe du ma bsags nas zhus chen du mdzad pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa bam po nyi shu rtsa bzhi le'u so gnyis pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po yan nyi khri ltar/ de nas yon tan bshes gnyen/ rin po ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan mkhas grub blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /mkhas grub sman lung pas bkra shis chos sder rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba chen po la lung gsan zin pa dang rjes su lco brag nyi lder dhī tsha sprul sku la sher phyogs gsan skabs sprul sku spyan bsnyun pa'i (155ba tshe ro brgyal ba byung bar brten brgyad stong pa sngar gyi de gas go bcad pa'i bskyar nas ma gsan 'dug /yang 'jam dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel la tshar gcig thob pa spag shod chos rje rin cen rgya mtshor gsan gsung ba las brgyud pa ma byung / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa bam po 'bum nang na bzhugs/ sher phyin sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ sher phyin yi ge gcig ma/ shes rab snying po he( ka nyer slob dpon bi mā las dag par mdzad nas bsam yas dge rgyas kyi skor khang gi gdong yar blta la gleng gzhi'i bkod pa dang bcas bris shing tshal pa bka' 'gyur du 'di'i gras su med par rgyud 'bum gras su bcug 'dug go /lnga pa parnyi gta bi mā la dang lo tsā ba rin cen sde'i 'gyur/ sher phyin nyi ma'i snying po/ sher phyin zla ba'i snying po/ sher phyin kun tu bzang po/ sher phyin lag na rdo rje/ sher phyin rdo rje rgyal mtshan rnams (155ba)thob pa las shes rab snying po ma gtogs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī/ su ma ti dz+nyā kirti/ 'e ti dz+nyā na kirti/ rong zom chos bzang / nyang ting 'dzin bzang po mnga' bdag nyang gi yab nyang ston chos 'khor gyi sla' gyi rnam grangs las bi mā la'i slob ma nyang ting 'dzin bzang po ni min no/ /lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ 'di rje bas sa paṇa gyi dngos slob yin cing : ti jo bo rje dang dus mtshungs pas ting 'dzin bzang po de dgung lo brgya lhag tsam bzhugs na ma gtogs bar 'dir bla ma gcig gnyisashig chad dam yang na lho la yag pa byang chub dngos grub la lho pa thams cad mkhyen par grags pas de yin na dus 'grig pa 'dra'o dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nga)chos bzang (156na)dpyal pad+ma can/ gzhon nu ye shes/ rong pa sher seng / bag ston gzhon tshul/bla ma mgon po 'bum/ spug ton bsod rgyan/ mkhan sher rdor/ chos sgo ba chos she /slob dpon bsod seng / tshal grags don pa/ rin cen grags pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa/chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan/ 'bum rams pa man gong ltar las/ bla ma tshogs gnyis dpal grub dag dhī tsha gnyis ka la rin po che sman lung pas gsan pa sogs gong bzhin no/ /yang na tshal grags don pa nas/ rngog byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen kun rgyan pa/ sman rgyal nam mkha' dbang phyug /'bum ram pa man gong dang 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ shān+ti pa/ se'u ri pa/ a bha yā ka ra dge ba'i 'byung gnas/rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ pu khyo shrī/ steng pa lotsā/ so thams cad mkhyen pa/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa thamasacad mkhyen pa/ ko nag pa/ shangs pa grags seng / zhang kun 'bum/ phag khur ba dkon ye/ bag ston gzhon tshul man gong ltar ro/ /yang na shangs pa grags seng nas/ rin cen 'bum/ dkon cog ye shes/ ye shes mgon po/dar ma bzang po/ rdo ri pa/ rje ri pa/ tshal grags don pa/ rngog byang chub dpal man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ dze tā ri/rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen yab sras gsum/ chosarje khu dbon gnyis/ rga lo yab sras gnyis/ bag ston man 'dra/ yang na bag ston nas rdo rje gdan pa'i bar gong bzhin las/ mkhas grub rig pa'i glog 'phrong / rdor 'dzin bstan pa rgya mtsho/ rje ngag dbang chos (156ba)rgyal/ gcung ngag gi dbang phyug /mkhas pa ngag dbang nor bu/ grub chen ngag dbang bzang po/ bla ma kun dga' blo gros/ dpal 'byor gling pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ rdo rje 'chang gnas gsar ba chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na tshal grags don pa nas/ rngog byang chub dpal/mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sman rgyal nam mkha' dbang phyug /'bum ram pa/ bla ma bstan pa rgya mtsho man 'dra/—235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)sher phyin zla ba'i snying po/ nyi ma'i snying po/ kun tu bzang po/ phyag na rdo rje/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan te mdo lnga'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ sangs rgyas 'jam dbyangs nas/ drin can blo mchog rdo rje'i bar sher snying gi brgyud pa gsum pa sor gnas la/ de la bdag gis mnos so/ /sher phyin bdun brgya pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ se'u ri pa yan sher snying gi brgyud pa gsum pa ltar la/ de nas rdo rje gdan pa chung ba/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ mchims brtson seng / rje sa chen/ lho pa khyung ston/ spu ston pa/ ko nag pa/ grags seng pa/ shangs tshul pa/ yon tan dpal/ snye mdo kun dga' don grub/ rang byung rdo rje/ rgyal ba dpal/ brtson 'grus seng ge /blo gros seng ge /'jam dpal chos rdor/ tshal grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa nas bla ma tsho gos gnyis dpal grub kyi bar gong ltar la/ de nas khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na lho pa khyung ston nas/ gtsang pa ston grags/ g.yor po zug /nyang bsod dbang / dharmā shrī/ dkon cog dpal/ grags pa seng ge /stag ston pa/ lo mchog pa/ bag ston pa/ mgon po 'bum/ spu ston pa/ shes rab rdo rje/chos dpal shes rab/ bsod (157na〉rnams seng ge /grags don pa man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ blo brtan/ rig pa'i khu byug /kha che dgon pa pa/ bī ra se na/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ bi mā la gup+ta/ rin cen rdo rje/ shān+ti pa/ su ma ti/ : ti/ rong zom chos bzang / ting 'dzin bzang po/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ dkon cog dpal/ grags rgyan pa/ grags bsod pa/ stag ston pa man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ pu rgya shrī/ steng lo/ so thams cad mkhyen pa/so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ ko nag ral gri man 'dra/—236

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)sher phyin zla ba'i snying po/ nyi ma'i snying po/ kun tu bzang po/ phyag na rdo rje/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan te mdo lnga'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ sangs rgyas 'jam dbyangs nas/ drin can blo mchog rdo rje'i bar sher snying gi brgyud pa gsum pa sor gnas la/ de la bdag gis mnos so/ /sher phyin bdun brgya pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ se'u ri pa yan sher snying gi brgyud pa gsum pa ltar la/ de nas rdo rje gdan pa chung ba/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ mchims brtson seng / rje sa chen/ lho pa khyung ston/ spu ston pa/ ko nag pa/ grags seng pa/ shangs tshul pa/ yon tan dpal/ snye mdo kun dga' don grub/ rang byung rdo rje/ rgyal ba dpal/ brtson 'grus seng ge /blo gros seng ge /'jam dpal chos rdor/ tshal grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa nas bla ma tsho gis gnyis dpal grub kyi bar gong ltar la/ de nas khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na lho pa khyung ston nas/ gtsang pa ston grags/ g.yor po zug /nyang bsod dbang / dharmā shrī/ dkon cog dpal/ grags pa seng ge /stag ston pa/ lo mchog pa/ bag ston pa/ mgon po 'bum/ spu ston pa/ shes rab rdo rje/chos dpal shes rab/ bsod (157na〉rnams seng ge /grags don pa man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ blo brtan/ rig pa'i khu byug /kha che dgon pa pa/ bī ra se na/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ bi mā la gup+ta/ rin cen rdo rje/ shān+ti pa/ su ma ti/ : ti/ rong zom chos bzang / ting 'dzin bzang po/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ dkon cog dpal/ grags rgyan pa/ grags bsod pa/ stag ston pa man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ put+ta shrī/ steng lo/ so thams cad mkhyen pa/so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ ko nag ral gri man 'dra/—236

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nge/bka' tha ma legs pa rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor khongs dkon brtsegs dang phal chen gyi skor/gsum pa mtha' ma legs par rnam pa phye ba'i chos 'khor las byung ba dkon brtsegs dang phal chen gnyis kyi dkon brtsegs ni/ mkhas pa blo gros brtan pa'i rnam bshad las/ de bas na theg pa chen po las gsungs pa'i chos dkon cog gi rnam pa thams cad bsdus pa'i phyir dkon cog brtsegs pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsung pa ltar theg pa chen po'i chos dkon cog gi rnam pa thams cad bsdus pa'i phung por spungs pa lta bu nas dkon cog brtsegs pa'i sgra bshad mdzad cing / 'grel pa de nyid las/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams las brtsams nas theg pa chen po rnam pa bcu drug gis chos bstan te/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sgrub pa na thog mar zhugs par 'gyur ba log par sgrub pa'i rnam pa dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sgrub pa yang dag par 'gyur ba yang dag pa sgrub pa'i rnam pa dang / yang dag par sgrub pa'i legs ta pa'i rnam pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' yang dag sgrub pa la gnas pa/ chos spyod pa mnyam pa spyod pa (157ba)chos la gnas pa'i tshul gyi rnam pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' la gnod pa sems pa dad pa yang dag par bskyed pa'i phyir dpe'i rnam pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par sgrub pa la gnas pa'i bslab pa'i rnam pa dang / nyan thos kyi bslab pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' bslab pa'i khyad par gyi rnam pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la shin tu bslab pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes kyis gzhan gyi don bya ba'i rnam pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi gdams ngag de la nyan thos kyi bslab pa'i rnam pa dang / dge sbyong legs par ma bslab pa'i rnam pa dang / dge sbyong legs par bslab pa'i rnam pa dang / brda'i sdom pa la gnas pa'i rnam pa dang /—237

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nge/bkod bstan pa bam po gsum tshal pa'i dkar chag na bam po gnyis su byas pa'ang yod ces snang / pa dzi na mi tra/ dwa na shī la/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/kha pa la dum bu drug pa 'phags pa mi (158ba)'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod bstan pa bam po lnga dang blo ka bzhi bcu pa dzi na mi tra/ su ren+d+ra/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ dum bu bdun pa 'phags pa go cha bkod pa bstan pa bam po drug /dum bu brgyad pa chos dbyings rang bzhin gyis dbyer med par bstan pa bam po gnyis dang blo ka lnga bcu/ dum bu dgu pa theg pa chen po chos bcu pa bstan pa bam po rin po che sman lung pa'i gsan yig tu bam po gcig dang blo ka nyis brgya tshal pa dkar chag tu slo ka la lnga brgya yod ces snang / phyed dang gnyis dang blo ka lnga bcu/ dum bu bcu pa 'phags pa kun nas sgo'i le'u blo ka nyis brgya dang drug cu ste bam po gcig pa dzi na mi tra/ su ren+d+ra/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ dum bu bcu gcig pa 'od zer kun nas bkye ba bstan pa'i mdo bam po lnga pa/ dum bu bcu gnyis pa 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod bstan pa bam po gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na 'di ltar byung zhing tshal pa bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag na bcu gcig ces snang ba brtag /nyi shu le'u bcu gnyis yod pa'i bam po gsum dang le'u bzhi'i stod cha yan/ga pa la gong gi 'phros rdzogs pa su ren+d+ra/ shrī len+d+ra/ chos nyid tshul khrims gsum gyi 'gyur/ dum bu bcu gsum pa dga' bo rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig na 'di'i tshab tu dga' bo rab tu byung ba bam po phyed bzhi zhes snang ba don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin na ma gtogs 'di'i lung 'bum ram pa man la the tshom gyi gzhir 'dug go /tshal pa'i dkar chag na bam po gnyis su yod pa'i gdam nga'ang snang / mngal du gnas pa bstan pa bam po gsum/ dum bu bcu bzhi pa dga' bo mngal du 'jug pa bstan pa bam po gcig /dum bu bco lnga pa 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi yon tan bkod pa bstan pa'i mdo bam po phyed dang bzhi pa shī len+d+ra bo dhi (159na)dang dzi na mi tra ye shes sde 'gyur/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na 'di dum bu bcu gnyis par mdzad 'dug kyang tshal pa bka' 'gyur dang rin po che sman lung pa'i gsan yig sor bzhag ltar yin/nga pa la dum bu bcu drug pa yab sras mjal ba de kho na nyid nges par bstan pa'i mdo bam po —239

'dra/yang na lho pa khyung ston grags nas/ gtsang pa ston grags/ g.yor po zug ston/ nyang stod bsod nams dbang po/ rgyal ston dharma shrī/ dkon cog dpal/ grags pa seng ge /stag ston spyil bu ba/ lo chen mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ bag ston gzhen tshul/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ spu ston pa/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ bla ma bsod nams seng ge /tshal grags don pa man gong ltar ro/ /yang na sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ paṇa chen blo brtan/ rig pa'i khu byug /kha che dgon pa pa/ dpa' bo'i sde/ mar me mdzad (161ba)bzang po/ dri med sbas pa/rin cen rdo rje/ shān+ti pa/ su ma ti kirti/ paṇ+ḍi ta : ti dz+nya na/ rong zom chos bzang / ting 'dzin bzang po/lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ dkon cog dpal/ spang khang pa grags rgyan/ shangs pa grags bsod/ stag ston spyil bu ba man 'dra/ yang na paṇa chen blo gros brtan pa nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba spel/ rat+na ā ka ra shān+ti pa man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ bar pa/ chung ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta puṭu shrī/ steng pa lo tsā ba/ so thams cad mkhyen pa/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ ko nag ral gri man sngar bzhin no/ /yang na lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa nas/ dkon cog dpal man kyang sngar bzhin no/ /phung po gsum pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ thub dbang / kun dga' bo/ kridzi'i gos can/ sha na'i gos can/ nyi ma gung pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen/ na gā rjun/ 'phags pa lha/ shrī ma dz+nyā kirti/ shān+ti pa/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ kha chen paṇa chen/ dpal chos bzang / dpal pad+ma can/gzhon nu ye shes/ shes rab seng ge /bag ston pa/ mgon po 'bum/ spu ston pa/ mkhan chen shes rdor ba/ chos sgo ba chos she /slob dpon bsod seng / tshal grags don pa/ rin cen grags pa/ bka' —243—

shān+ti pa/ su ma ti kirti/ paṇ+ḍi ta : ti dz+nya na/ rong zom chos bzang / ting 'dzin bzang po/lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ dkon cog dpal/ spang khang pa grags rgyan/ shangs pa grags bsod/ stag ston spyil bu ba man 'dra/ yang na paṇa chen blo gros brtan pa nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba spel/ rat+na ā ka ra shān+ti pa man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ bar pa/ chung ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta puṭu shrī/ steng pa lo tsā ba/ so thams cad mkhyen pa/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ ko nag ral gri man sngar bzhin no/ /yang na lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa nas/ dkon cog dpal man kyang sngar bzhin no/ /phung po gsum pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ thub dbang / kun dga' bo/ kridzi'i gos can/ sha na'i gos can/ nyi ma gung pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen/ na gā rjun/ 'phags pa lha/ shrī ma dz+nyā kirti/ shān+ti pa/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ kha chen paṇa chen/ dpal chos bzang / dpal pad+ma can/gzhon nu ye shes/ shes rab seng ge /bag ston pa/ mgon po 'bum/ spu ston pa/ mkhan chen shes rdor ba/ chos sgo ba chos she /slob dpon bsod seng / tshal grags don pa/ rin cen grags pa/ bka' —243—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na rje blo mchog rdo rje nas/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na kha che paṇa chen nas/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ ko nag pa/ zas gtsang pa/ grags seng ba/bsod rin pa/ mkhan gzhen ye/ 'byung ldan 'od/ byang chub seng ge /zhang kun 'od/ bag ston man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ sangs (162na)rgyas bskyangs/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ dri med sbas pa/ rat+na badz+ra/ chos 'byung zhi ba/ de la dz+nyā na shrī dang pu byu shrī gnyis sags na/ gnyis ka la su ma ti/ 'e ti/ rong zom chos bzang / ting 'dzin bzang po/ nyang ral pa/lho pa kun mkhyen/ spang khang pa/ grags seng / stag ston pa/ blo chen pa/ bag ston man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ rin 'byung zhi ba/ si'u ri pa/ a bha ya/ dge 'byung sbas pa/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ purkye shrī/ steng lo/ so kun mkhyen/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ ko nag pa/ grags seng / zhang kun 'bum/ phag khur ba/ bag ston pa man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ sman zhabs/ rgyal bas byin/ rat+na shrī/ shān+ti badz+ra/ ga rma badz+ra/ pu rje shrī/ bi dza yā rak+ṣi ta/ thar lo/ phag khur ba/ bag ston man 'dra/ chos rje dpa' bo'i gsan yig gzhan ma rnams rgyas rgyas la dkon brtsegs shin tu bsdus shing brgyud pa'ang rgya nag tu snang ngo zhes kha 'phangs pa'i zom me ba zhig 'dug pa gsan yig rgya mtsho sogs ma gzigs pa'i 'ol tshod cig byung ba 'dra'o/ /—244—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na rje blo mchog rdo rje nas/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na kha che paṇa chen nas/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ ko nag pa/ zas gtsang pa/ grags seng ba/bsod rin pa/ mkhan gzhen ye/ 'byung ldan 'od/ byang chub seng ge /zhang kun 'od/ bag ston man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med sku mched/ sangs (162na)rgyas bskyangs/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ dri med sbas pa/ rat+na badz+ra/ chos 'byung zhi ba/ de la dz+nyā na shrī dang pu byu shrī gnyis sags na/ gnyis ka la su ma ti/ 'e ti/ rong zom chos bzang / ting 'dzin bzang po/ nyang ral pa/lho pa kun mkhyen/ spang khang pa/ grags seng / stag ston pa/ blo chen pa/ bag ston man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ rin 'byung zhi ba/ si'u ri pa/ a bha ya/ dge 'byung sbas pa/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ purkye shrī/ steng lo/ so kun mkhyen/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ ko nag pa/ grags seng / zhad kun 'bum/ phag khur ba/ bag ston pa man 'dra/ yang na sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ sman zhabs/ rgyal bas byin/ rat+na shrī/ shān+ti badz+ra/ ga rma badz+ra/ purkye shrī/ bi dza yā rak+ṣi ta/ thar lo/ phag khur ba/ bag ston man 'dra/ chos rje dpa' bo'i gsan yig gzhan ma rnams rgyas rgyas la dkon brtsegs shin tu bsdus shing brgyud pa'ang rgya nag tu snang ngo zhes kha 'phangs pa'i zom me ba zhig 'dug pa gsan yig rgya mtsho sogs ma gzigs pa'i 'ol tshod cig byung ba 'dra'o/ /—244—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nge)'khor lo mtha' ma'i snying po phul du byung ba sangs rgyas phal po che'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs ston pa'i sde snod skor/nyan rang sogs thams cad dang thun mongs ma yin pa'i 'khor lo mtha' ma'i snying po phul du byung ba sangs rgyas phal po che mtshan gyi rnam grangs su shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sde snod/ snyan gyi gong rgyan pad+ma'i rgyan sogs su thams cad mkhyen pa chen po 'gos lo tsā ba ye bzang rtse pa bzhed pa yin la/gzhan yang sangs rgyas smag chad rma ga chad/ smad chad ces mtshan sna tshogs byung bar dbus pa blo gsal gyis rma ga chad (162na༄sa pa yang dag pa'i brda rnying du mdzad cing / spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa chos kyi grags pas ma rig pa'i smag rum med pas na smag chad du sgra bshad pa gnyis ka chos kyi spyan ldan chen por 'dug pas khungs btsun par mngon zhing / mkhan chen dka' bcu pad+ma bzang pos ma smad pa'i don yin pas smad chad dang / chos rje dpa' bo smag chad ces pa phal chen gyi brda rnying du ngos 'dzin mdzad pa ni the tshom gyi gzhir snang / de'ang rgya che rol pa sogs mdo dang 'dul ba'i skor las de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas nas zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i bar du chos ma gsungs par bshad pa dang / phal po cher bdun phrag dang po la phal po che'i le'u dang rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba/ bdun phrag gnyis pa la sa bcu pa'i mdo sogs gsungs pa phan tshun blo dman gyi ngor 'gal ba ltar snang yang sa bcu pa'i le'u mkhas pa dbyig gnyen gyis bkral ba'i yang 'grel slob dpon nyi ma grub kyis sbyar ba las/ mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas nas ring po ma lon te/zhes bya ba ni mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas yun ring ma lon zhes pa'i tha tshig go /de nyid kyis bye brag dbye ba'i phyir zhag bdun pa gnyis pa'i tshe zhes bya ba gsungs te/ zhag bdun pa gnyis la gdul ba'i dbang du rdzu 'phrul gyis brlabs pa'i phyir ro/ /—245

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (ngona'akhor lo mtha' ma'i snying po phul du byung ba sangs rgyas phal po che'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs ston pa'i sde snod skor/nyan rang sogs thams cad dang thun mongs ma yin pa'i 'khor lo mtha' ma'i snying po phul du byung ba sangs rgyas phal po che mtshan gyi rnam grangs su shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sde snod/ snyan gyi gong rgyan pad+ma'i rgyan sogs su thams cad mkhyen pa chen po 'gos lo tsā ba ye bzang rtse pa bzhed pa yin la/gzhan yang sangs rgyas smag chad rma ga chad/ smad chad ces mtshan sna tshogs byung bar dbus pa blo gsal gyis rma ga chad (162na༄sa pa yang dag pa'i brda rnying du mdzad cing / spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa chos kyi grags pas ma rig pa'i smag rum med pas na smag chad du sgra bshad pa gnyis ka chos kyi spyan ldan chen por 'dug pas khungs btsun par mngon zhing / mkhan chen dka' bcu pad+ma bzang pos ma smad pa'i don yin pas smad chad dang / chos rje dpa' bo smag chad ces pa phal chen gyi brda rnying du ngos 'dzin mdzad pa ni the tshom gyi gzhir snang / de'ang rgya che rol pa sogs mdo dang 'dul ba'i skor las de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas nas zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i bar du chos ma gsungs par bshad pa dang / phal po cher bdun phrag dang po la phal po che'i le'u dang rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba/ bdun phrag gnyis pa la sa bcu pa'i mdo sogs gsungs pa phan tshun blo dman gyi ngor 'gal ba ltar snang yang sa bcu pa'i le'u mkhas pa dbyig gnyen gyis bkral ba'i yang 'grel slob dpon nyi ma grub kyis sbyar ba las/ mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas nas ring po ma lon te/zhes bya ba ni mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas yun ring ma lon zhes pa'i tha tshig go /de nyid kyis bye brag dbye ba'i phyir zhag bdun pa gnyis pa'i tshe zhes bya ba gsungs te/ zhag bdun pa gnyis la gdul ba'i dbang du rdzu 'phrul gyis brlabs pa'i phyir ro/ /—245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)de ltar ma yin na ni rgya che rol pa'i mdo chen po las bcom ldan 'das zhag bdun dang po'i tshe ni byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs pa'i bzhin du dga' ba'i zas bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis gnas so/ /gnyis pa'i tshe spyan gnyis mi 'dzum par byang chub kyi shing la gzigs so/ /gsum pa'i tshe stong (163na)gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas bzung ste 'chag pa rgyang ring du bcas so/ /bzhi pa'i tshe ni shar gyi rgya mtsho dang nub kyi rgya mtsho nas bzung ste 'chag pa rgyang thung ngur bcags so/ /lnga pa'i tshe btang bzung gi gnas na bzhugs so/ /drug pa'i tshe ni ra rdzi shing n+ya gro dha'i nang na bzhugs so/ /bdun pa'i tshe ni shing rgyal po'i zas zhes bya ba'i drung nas bzhugs so/ /zhes bya ba gang yin pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa kha cig bcom ldan 'das dang po mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas nas zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i bar du byang chub kyi snying po dang nye ba na bzhugs so zhes 'dod pa gang yin pa 'di gnyis ka dang yang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /'dul ba'i bye brag gis ni de dag gnyis ka na yang snang bas mi 'gal te/ de ltar na zhag bdun pa gnyis ka srid do/ /'di dag la 'dod pa na spyod pa'i las dge ba'i rab kyi phul du phyin pa thob pas sprul pa'i bde ba la dbang byed pa yod pas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams so/ /lha de rnams kyi nang nas zhes bya ba ni dga' ba dang gsal ba byed pas lha rnams te/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba mang ba'i phyir dgar bar byed la/ 'od dang ldan pa'i phyir gsal bar byed do/ /lha de dag rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i phyir mi rnams kyis bstod pa byed pa yin no/ /bzhugs te zhes bya ba ni bzhugs shing bzhugs so pa'o/ /dbang sgyur zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha thams cad dang bde ba'i longs spyod rnams la dbang bsgyur bas na dbang bsgyur te de'i 'o/ /lha rnams kyi'am rnams kyi nang nas rgyal po yin pas lha'i rgyal po ste rje bo yin no/ /zhes rgyas par bshad pa'i don ltar (163ba)gdul bya gang la gang 'tsham gdul ba'i dbang gis sna tshogs pa'i rgyahrūl gyis de ltar bstan pa la nyes pa mi 'byung ngo / /de'ang kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yin tu/ sangs rgyas phal po che/ rma ga chad/ sdong po bkod pa/ bzang spyod kyis mjug sdud dang bcas par —246—

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ rtong)blo ka sum khri dgu stong sum cu/ bam po brgya dang sum cu dang blo ka sum cu yod par gsungs shing /tshal pa bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag tu bam po brgya dang bco lnga/ ldan dkar mar bam po brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bdun du mdzad/ de'ang spyir btang gi dbang du byas na phal chen gyi khongs su 'du zhing phal chen zhes pa'ang le'u bcu gcig pa'i sgos ming spyi la btags pa mngon la/ zhib mor dpyad na sngon byon 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu rnams kyis mdzad pa'i dkar chag ldan dkar mar/ phal po che/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba/ dgu blo ka bzhi stong nyis brgya bam po bcu bzhir yod pa'i 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyi rgyan gyi tshul rab tu byung ba le'u dang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i le'u gnyis pa/kun tu bzang po'i ting nge 'dzin dang rnam 'phrul rab tu byung ba le'u gsum pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho shin tu bstan pa'i phyogs gsal bar bya ba yang dag par bsgrub pa le'u bzhi pa/ gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho yongs su dag par snang ba le'u lnga pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i khor yug (164na)bstan pa le'u drug pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i sa gzhi'i rgyan shin tu bstan pa le'u bdun pa/ zhing gi rgyud shin tu bstan pa le'u brgyad pa/ 'jig rten khams kyi rgyud rnam par dgod pa le'u dgu pa/ rnam snang gi le'u bcu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa phal po che'i le'u bcu gcig pa/ sangs kyi mtshan shin tu bstan pa'i le'u bcu gnyis pa/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bstan pa le'u bcu gsum pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer las rnam par sangs rgyas pa'i le'u bcu bzhi pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dris pa'i snang ba le'u bco lnga pa/ spyod yul yongs su dag pa le'u bcu drug pa/ bzang po'i dpal le'u bcu bdun pa/ ri rab kyi rtser gshegs pa le'u bco brgyad pa/ri rab kyi rtser de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam 'phrul dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i le'u bcu dgu pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par dgod pa bcu bstan pa le'u nyi shu pa/—247—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)tshangs spyod bstan pa le'u nyer gcig pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dang po sems bskyed pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i dpe yang dag par bsags pa'i tshigs su bcad pa le'u nyer gnyis pa/ chos snang ba le'u nyer gsum pa/ rab tshe ma'i gnas na rnam par 'phrul ba le'u nyer bzhi pa/ rab tshe ma'i gnas su byang sems 'dus pas tshigs bcad bstan pa le'u nyer lnga pa/ yon tan gyi me tog shin tu bsags pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa le'u nyer drug pa/ gter mi zad pa bstan pa le'u nyer bdun pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang bzhud pa dang gshegs pa dang bzhugs(164ba)pa'i rgyan le'u nyer brgyad pa/ dga' ldan du byang sems 'dus pa le'u nyer dgu pa/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba le'u gcig blo ka sum stong dgu brgya bam po bcu gsum yod pa'i rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba le'u sum cu pa/ sa bcu pa bstan pa le'u gcig blo ka nyis stong bzhi brgya bam po brgyad yod pa'i sa bcu pa'i mdo le'u sogacig pa/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bstan pa le'u bcu gcig pa blo ka stong brgyad brgya bam po bcu drug pa'i kun bzang gis bstan pa le'u so gnyis pa/ ting nge 'dzin bcu pa le'u so gsum pa/ mngon shes bstan pa le'u so bzhi pa/ bzod pa'i le'u so lnga pa/ grangs la 'jug pa le'u sodrug pa/ tshe'i tshad le'u so bdun pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas bstan pa le'u so brgyad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab par bstan pa le'u so dgu pa/ de bzhin gshegs mtshan rgya mtsho bstan pa le'u bzhi bcu pa/ dpe byad bzang po'i 'od zer bstan pa le'u zhe gcig pa/ kun bzang gi spyod pa bstan pa le'u zhe gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i skye ba dang 'byung ba bstan pa le'u gcig blo ka stong lnga brgya bam po lnga'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i skye ba dang 'byung ba bstan pa le'u zhe gsum/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u gcig glo ka sum stong sum brgya bam po gcig gi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u zhe bzhi pa/ stong po bkod pa 'phros don dang bcas par le'u gcig blo ka dgu stong bam po sum cu pa'i sdong pos brgyan pa/ de'i 'phros don nor bzang gis 'jam dbyangs lan gnyis pa mjal zin pa'i bam 'tshams su sdong pos brgyan pa'i le'u zhes lnga pa/ de'i mjug tu nor bzang gis (165na)—248

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)tshangs spyod bstan pa le'u nyer gcig pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dang po sems bskyed pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i dpe yang dag par bsags pa'i tshigs su bcad pa le'u nyer gnyis pa/ chos snang ba le'u nyer gsum pa/ rab tshe ma'i gnas na rnam par 'phrul ba le'u nyer bzhi pa/ rab tshe ma'i gnas su byang sems 'dus pas tshigs bcad bstan pa le'u nyer lnga pa/ yon tan gyi me tog shin tu bsags pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa le'u nyer drug pa/ gter mi zad pa bstan pa le'u nyer bdun pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang bzhud pa dang gshegs pa dang bzhugs(164ba)pa'i rgyan le'u nyer brgyad pa/ dga' ldan du byang sems 'dus pa le'u nyer dgu pa/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba le'u gcig blo ka sum stong dgu brgya bam po bcu gsum yod pa'i rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba le'u sum cu pa/ sa bcu pa bstan pa le'u gcig blo ka nyis stong bzhi brgya bam po brgyad yod pa'i sa bcu pa'i mdo le'u sogacig pa/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bstan pa le'u bcu gcig pa blo ka stong brgyad brgya bam po bcu drug pa'i kun bzang gis bstan pa le'u so gnyis pa/ ting nge 'dzin bcu pa le'u so gsum pa/ mngon shes bstan pa le'u so gshegs pa'i skye ba dang 'byung ba bstan pa le'u gcig blo ka stong lnga brgya bam po lnga'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i skye ba dang 'byung ba bstan pa le'u zhe gsum/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u gcig glo ka sum stong sum brgya bam po gcig gi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u zhe bzhi pa/ stong po bkod pa 'phros don dang bcas par le'u gcig blo ka dgu stong bam po sum cu pa'i sdong pos brgyan pa/ de'i 'phros don nor bzang gis 'jam dbyangs lan gnyis pa mjal zin pa'i bam 'tshams su sdong pos brgyan pa'i le'u zhes lnga pa/ de'i mjug tu nor bzang gis (165na)—248

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ khonganakun tu bzang po bsten nas bzang spyod smon lam gsungs pa'i mthar sdong pos brgyan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs chen po las nor bzang gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur ba'i spyod pa phyogs gcig pa ste ji snyed pa rdzogs byang gi mtha' can rnams kyi lung legs par mnos pa'i rgya nag nas 'gyur ba lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/mgon po klu sgrub/ de la paṇ+ḍi ta byang chub bzang po dang paṇ+ḍi ta dga' ba gnyis kyis zhus/ de gnyi gas rgya nag tu 'gyur mdzad/ de nas hā shang thu thu zhun/ gyis btsun ja/ ten zhi du go zhi/ tshing lang go zhi/gyi nyung / ha'i hrī tha'i/ gyi ju son chen gyin/ sing ga sang / gying sa dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros bla ma bsod nams seng ge /gar tig pa bsod rgyan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ mtha' rtsa'i mkhan chen grags pa rdo rje/ tshal pa rin po che grags pa don grub/ dgra bcom pa rin cen grags pa/ bla ma shākya rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje gdan pa sngags 'chang 'jigs med dpa' bo/ chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan/ 'bum ram pa rin cen chos dbang /rab 'byams tshul khrims dbang phyug /rje chos rgyal don grub/ spyan snga dkon cog 'bangs/ drung pa grags don pa/ bla ma tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ rin po che sman lung nas kyis po ti lnga bla ma tshogs gnyis pas gsan nas drug pa sgyi tsha sprul skur gsan pa yin 'dug pas 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du byas te bla ma gnyis ka drangs so/ /sprul sku 'jig rten dbang phyug /mkhas grub blo gros mchog gi rdo rje/ des bdag za hor ban+de (165ba tha'o/ /yang na mkhan chen sher rdor ba nas/ 'bri gung lo tsā ba/ khams pa mchog dkar ba byang rgyal/ bla ma bsod nams shes rab/ mtha' rtsa'i bla ma gzhen nu dar/ tshal grags don pa man gong ltar ro/ /rgya gar nas 'gyur ba'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po klu sgrub yan gong ltar las/ ār+ya de wa/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ dharma rak+ṣi ta/ 6ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ mchims brtson seng / rje btsun saskya pa chen po/ sum pa lo tsā ba/ lho pa khyung ston/ gtsang pa ston grags/ g.yor po sbug ston/ nyang bsod nams dbang po/ jo stan zas gtsang / shangs pa sgang gi slob dpon grags seng / stag rme ru'i —249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)zhang kun dga' 'bum/ phag khur ba dkon cog bla ma/ bag ston ga zlone tshul/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/spu ston pa/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje man gong bzhin no/ /bzang spyod kyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ thub dbang / 'jam dpal/ klu sgrub/ klu'i byang chub/ḍom+bi pa/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ rin cen 'byung gnas zhi ba/ rdo rje gdan pa che 'bring chung gsum/so ma shrībha dra/ bu mā la shrī/ bhe na du shrī/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ spang khang pa grags rgyan/ shangs pa grags seng / zhal snga ba bsod rin/ mkhan chen gangs pa/ bla ma shes rab dpal/ dge slong kun dga' nyi ma/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ slob dpon mgon po 'bum/ spu ston bsod rgyan/ mkhan shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma chos dpal shes rab/ slob dpon bsod nams seng ge /tshal grags don pa man gong dang 'dra/ yang na rje bla mchog rdo rje nas/ rigasakun bdag po mgon po bsod nams mchog (166na/rdon/ des bdag la'o/ /'khor lo gsum po'i sde tshan ci rigs par gtogs pa'i mdo mang gi skor/bzhi pa 'khor lo gsum po ci rigs par gtogs pa sde tshan phyogs gcig bsgrigs pa mdo mang la/ de'ang de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i bka' 'khor lo gsum po ni/ mngon pa mdzod du/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs/ /zhes gdul bya rigs can gsum rjes su 'dzin pa'i ched du so so'i dbang po dang 'tsham par bstan pa las/ la la dag yang dag pa dang / 'ga' zhig de'i ldog phyogs su bzung ste drang don mtha' dag brdzun par byas na las dang 'bras bu sogs kyang med pa'i chad pa'i mthar lhung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa la'ang skur ba btab par 'gyur bas/ 'phags pa rnam par 'thag pa thams cad bsdus pa'i mdo las/ ma pham pa gang gi nub —250

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nge)mo de bzhin gshegs pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang / gang gi nub mo de bzhin gshegs pa len pa med par yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba de'i bar du/ de bzhin gshegs pas gang ci gsungs pa de dag thams cad ni yang dag pa de kho na bzhin ma nor ba de bzhin te/ gzhan du ma yin na 'di la mi blun po kha cig de bzhin gshegs pa'i thabs la mkhas pa mi shes shing khong du mi chud par nga'i ldem po'i ngag la 'di skad du/ 'di ni rung ngo 'di ni mi rung ngo zhes zer te/ de lta bu de dag ni dam pa'i chos spong ba yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa la skur ba 'debs pa yin te/ rgyu des na de dag ni sems can dmyal ba zhes nga 'chad do/ /zhes chos spong ba'i sgrib pa'i sgo 'di shin tu 'byung nye zhing nyes dmigs che bar (1slob)bka' gdams rin po che'i bstan rim dang lam rim che chung sogs su shin tu rgyas par gsungs na'ang sgom chen par rlom pa mang dag cig dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i skor rags pa tsam yang ma thos par chos sgor zhugs ma thag nas chos thams cad stong pa nyid yin no zhes pa'i chad lta had po zhig ngag tu khyer nas las 'bras sogs la ji mi snyam par byed pa dag ni rmongs pa'i mun pas bsgribs pas de las 'os med cing mang por thos pa la la'ang theg pa che chung dang mdo sngags kyi gsung rab rnams tsha grang ltar 'gal ba kho nar bzung nas tshul bzhin nyams su mi shes pa ni/ rje bla ma btsong kha pa chen pos rin po che gsum gyi gtam gyi sbyor ba las/ mang du thos kyang chos kyis phongs pa ni/ /gsung rab gdams par 'char ba med pas nongs/ /zhes pa'i don kho na thog tu babs pa'i tshul de lta bur ma song ba dgos pas/ ji skad du/ bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa dang / /gsung rab ma lus gdams par shar ba dang / /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag rnyed pa dang / /nyes spyod chen po'i g.yang sa las kyang bsrung / /zhes bka' stsal pa'i don lag len du thebs pa zhig nge ba'i par gal che zhing / de'ang la la dag bka' bar par ma bstan pa'i de las kyang ches zab pa zhig 'khor lo mtha' mar yod pa skad du smra na'ang / bka' bar pa las chos zab pa pha rol tu phyin —251 —

bstan pa'i tshig la dngos su 'gal yang / don gyi char dgongs pa 'grel (167na〉ges dgos pas chos thams cad kyi drang nges dang / sgra ji bzhin pa yin min dang /dgongs pa can dang dgongs pa can ma yin pa sogs kyi rnam gzhag gtan la 'bebs par mtha' ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor bskor ba yin la/ de'ang mdo mang du mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel/ ting 'dzin rgyal po blo gros mi zad pa/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa sogs theg chen dang / rgya rol las rgya sogs theg pa 'og ma sna tshogs yod pas 'khor lo gsum po gcig tu ngos 'dzin dka' zhing / dgongs pa nges 'grel gyis mtshon pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i gtam brjod bya'i gtso bor byed pa'i mdo rnams sa bcad gsum pa'i khongs su sdud pa mthad kyang mkhas pa rnams kyis mdo sde sna tshogs phyogs gcig tu dkar chag mdzad pa dang mi mthun pa'i rjes su thob yig dang glegs bam go bsdur mgo rmongs pa sogs kyi skyon nas dkar chag dang gsan yig rnying pa rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs pa yin la/ mdo mang gi skor dbus 'gyur 'chang sogs 'phags pa'i yul du'ang lung cha tshang ba phyogs gcig tu 'chad pa shin tu dkon par grags shing / rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya ngan med pa'i dpal la mdo sna nyis brgya lhag bcas kyi lung rgyun khungs btsun bzhugs pa ma byon sangs rgyas bdun pa rab gsal gyi rnam par sprul pa ka smi ra ba'i bsod snyoms pa chen po paṇa chen shākya shrīs legs par gsan/ des bod du dpyal chos bzang / khro phu lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa gsum la gnang nas dar/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas kyi steng (167ba)pa lo tsā ba tshul khrims 'byung gnas la bye brag bshad mdzod dang rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing gnyis bsgyur ba dang / mdo mang gi lung rgyun dag pa zhig tshol zhes slar rgya gar du brdzangs par rtogs brjod rin po che ni shin tu bsgyur dka' bas ma 'gyur bar 'jam dpal dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen gyis bsgyur bar bzhed pa rgya nag tu phebs pa sogs —252

tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa gsum la gnang nas dar/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas kyi steng (167ba)pa lo tsā ba tshul khrims 'byung gnas la bye brag bshad mdzod dang rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing gnyis bsgyur ba dang / mdo mang gi lung rgyun dag pa zhig tshol zhes slar rgya gar du brdzangs par rtogs brjod rin po che ni shin tu bsgyur dka' bas ma 'gyur bar 'jam dpal dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen gyis bsgyur bar bzhed pa rgya nag tu phebs pa sogs —252

dkar lcang lo'i 'phreng ba can sngags rnying (168na)ma'i rig pa 'dzin pa chen po des zhus nas mnga' bdag nyang yab sras gnang ba sogs paṇa grub de dag las 'phel ba'i dar rgyas che zhing / de nas ring zhig na bstan pa'i srog 'thud pa lta bu ni shab pa bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims yin la/ des shab stod kyi g.yu dga' ldan du rong ba sher seng la dpyal nas brgyud pa tshar gcig gsan yang slar zhib dpyad pas dpyal pad+ma can dang mkhan po gzhen me'i bar du hol khongs gcig dang / gzhen ye dang rong pa sher seng gi bar du hol khongs yod 'dra zer bar brten/ slar yang sa skya yang dgon pa bla ma gsan dus lho pas kyang gsan pa yin nam zer ba las nges tig ma byung bar brten slar mdo mang gi brgyud pa spyi dang / bye brag so so'i sgos brgyud dogs gnas med pa shin tu dag pas gsan pa ni bla ma —253

ba'i dud pa bzhin du song zhes smras pa'i tshe dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa las/ lo nyer brgyad lon pa na ting nge 'dzin las langs —295

man chad du/ chos log spyod pa nyung zhes thos/ /zhes pa'i shugs bstan gyis yan chad rnams bstan pa snga dar gyi mjug tu ar tsho ban+de bco brgyad sogs chos log spyod pa mang po byung ba sogs la dgongs pa lo chen gyi rtsad pa'i phyogs snga dang dbyibs 'dra bar dga' gdong / sposakhong / stag tshang pa/ rta nag pa/ mang thos klu sgrub pa/ mkhan chen ngag chos pa sogs snga phyir byung ba'i 'brel pa tshad ldan rnams su gsang sngags rnying ma yin par ngos ma bzung / thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal ni gsung brling zhing gang la'ang zur mi za bar grags mod/ 'on te dri ma lhag bsam rab dkar dwags brgyud pa'i phyogs la shin tu 'dzug cing rno bar snang na'ang gsang sngags rnying ma phyogs la sgros tsam yang med/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ kun mkhyen dol po ba/ rje rang byung rdo rje/ 'gos lo thams cad mkhyen pa ye bzang rtse pa/ khrims khang lo tsā ba bsod nams rgya mtsho/ zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pa sogs ris su ma chad pa'i mkhas grub rnams kyis tshad ldan du ngos bzung / dpal sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi gdung rabs/ khro phu ba/ 'bri gung skyu ra/ rngog /rlangs lha gzigs sogs gdung gis btsun zhing yab mes gong ma'i ring nas grub pa brnyes pa shin tu mang bar byung ba rnams kyang sngags rnying ma ba kho na yin pas rnam par ma dag pa'i chos log la yang dag pa'i grub pa brnyes na rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag dgongs pa lo chen gyi rtsad pa'i phyogs snga dang dbyibs 'dra bar dga' gdong / sposakhong / stag tshang pa/ rta nag pa/ mang thos klu sgrub pa/ mkhan chen ngag chos pa sogs snga phyir byung ba'i 'brel pa tshad ldan rnams su gsang sngags rnying ma yin par ngos ma bzung / thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal ni gsung brling zhing gang la'ang zur mi za bar grags mod/ 'on te dri ma lhag bsam rab dkar dwags brgyud pa'i phyogs la shin tu 'dzug cing rno bar snang na'ang gsang sngags rnying ma phyogs la sgros tsam yang med/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ kun mkhyen dol po ba/ rje rang byung rdo rje/ 'gos lo thams cad mkhyen pa ye bzang rtse pa/ khrims khang lo tsā ba bsod nams rgya mtsho/ zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pa sogs ris su ma chad pa'i mkhas grub rnams kyis tshad ldan du ngos bzung / dpal sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi gdung rabs/ khro phu ba/ 'bri gung skyu ra/ rngog /rlangs lha gzigs sogs gdung gis btsun zhing yab mes gong ma'i ring nas grub pa brnyes pa shin tu mang bar byung ba rnams kyang sngags rnying ma ba kho na yin pas rnam par ma dag pa'i chos log la yang dag pa'i grub pa brnyes na rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag 'dra rgya gar du'ang byung ba dka'/ dpe 'di 'dra ba rnams slob dpon pad+mas mi ma yin gyi lag nas blangs sam zhes gsungs te thugs rgyal chag skad/ de'i phyir o rgyan chen po/ shin+ti gar+bha/ bi mā la sogs sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu rnams dang be+e ro tsa na dang gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes sogs rdzu 'phrul dang rkang mgyogs thob pa'i lo tsā ba mang pos rnyed pa'i chos kyi mtha'i tshad ni mkhas par rlom pa gzhan dag gis gzung ba'i gnas ma yin te/ khyim zhag gi dkyil 'khor rer nyi mas go la'i lam bskor bar sa ku rtsis rang nyams la dpags te smad pa dang 'dra/ dpal 'dzin gyis gsar ma'i rgyud 'grel sgrub thabs 'di tsam zhig 'gyur ba la rdzogs pa chen po zhes pa'i ming tsam yang med ces smra ba —302

bar med du mi rung ba 'ga' zhig ma gtogs gtso bor bka' nas bkar brgyud pa'i rgyud phyogs gcig tu bzhugs pa'i rgyun yin zhing / lhun grub pho brang gi rgyud 'bum du gter rgyud mang pos kha bskangs shing / gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje'i gsan yig tu'ang bka' brgyad dgongs 'dus sogs kyi rgyud (201ba)mang tsam 'dren pa mdzad 'dug kyang de dag rnams ni so so'i chos sde'i skabs 'byung bas 'dir zur du 'dri ba'i dgos pa lhag po'ang mi snang la/ bka' ma —303—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khridani sngon chad lo tsā ba rnams kyis bsgyur ba las spros pa'i slad nas slar 'gyur rnying mar ma zad gsar ma la'ang da ni dus dbang gis yod pa'i dogs gnas tsam yang mi 'dug pas slar snon byung dogs ma dgos shing / gter ston chos rje gling pa dang rog rje gling pa gnyis thang yig tu gsal ba sngar ma byung zhing / der mi gsal ba'i gter ston bstan 'gro'i ched du mang du 'byung bas na gter rgyud kyi mtha' 'di zhes thug pa med pa'i phyir rgyud 'bum du bris pas kyang mi lang bas 'gad gtsang po mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis bka' ma'i rgyun yod gtso bor byas te bkod pa yin la/ de'ang theg pa la rim 'dzeg dang yas 'bab gnyis las gsar rnying gi rgyud 'bum bzhugs tshul yas 'bab tu yod pa shas che bas de dag gi rjes su 'brangs te theg pa rim pa dgu las kun gyi yang rtse nas brtsams te go rim du bstar ba la/ rdzogs pa a ti yo ga /lung a nu yo ga /bskyed pa ma hā yo ga gsum/ dang po la/ sems ma yin pa'i chos logs na med pas sna tshogs sems kyi sde/ chos nyid kun tu bzang mo'i klong las 'gro sa gzhan med par smra ba klong gi sde/ yin lugs gnad thog tu 'bebs pas man ngag gnad kyi sde zhes grags che zhing / thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mkhas grub chen po ye bzang rtse ba'i zhabs kyis/ sems sde ni lnga be+e ro tsa na dang / bcu gsum bi mā la las byung ba yin la/ klong sde'ang be+e ro tsa na las byung (202na)ba'i man ngag go /man ngag gi sde ni snying thig ces grags te bi ma la mi tra las byung zhing / de'i slob ma nyang ting 'dzin bzang po las brgyud de gsum po 'di dag ni bod kyi khams 'dir shin tu dar ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yang ti spyi ti sogs kyang sde gsum gyi khongs su 'du ba'i dbang du mdzad pa don la mi gnas pa'ang ma yin zhing / de'ang be+e ros shrī sidha la gsan pa'i sems phyogs skor la rnam grangs mang yang sgos rgyud sems med bco brgyad la ring brgyud slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang shrī sidha'i bar du bla ma nyi shu tsam yod kyang / nye brgyud ni mkhas pa ye bzang rtse ba'i deb sngon du/ yang rdzogs pa chen po sems phyogs su grags pa 'di rnams/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi bla ma rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis brte chung ma can du bstan nas/ zhal —304

gsan/ de la be+e ro tsa nas gsan pa yin la/ be+e ros khams su byon nas rgya cher gsungs/ zhes pa ltar brgyud pa nye brgyud 'di nyid gtso che bar mdzad cing / de'ang slob dpon shrī sidha spa gor be+e sgom pa'i man ngag byin/de ltar dbang bdun rdzogs par bskur nas thug phrad gsum gyis rang grol mngon sum du ngo sprad/mngon sum nyid kyi tshad la phab/ thig le drug gis rnam rtog gi spros pa bcad/ che ba lngas spros pa'i dgongs pa khyad par du spags te rtsol ba med par ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i don nyid mngon du gyur par mdzad pas sems slong gi skor bka' ma bod du 'gyur ba phal cher lo chen 'di'i rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)ba shas che/ de'ang be+e ro tsa na blon po'i phra mas tsha ba rong du spyugs (203na)pa na sngar gyi grogs gtsang legs grub kyi skye ba g.yu sgra snying po la rdzogs chen bshad par rgya gar du grags pa'i phyi'i skor/ rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga/ yan lag gi rgyud bdun/ bshad pa'i rgyud bzhi ste bcu drug /kun byed rgyal po ma bu dgu skor 'grel pa lde mig dang bcas pa rgyud sde'i skor/ sems sde bco brgyad man ngag ngo sprod dang bcas pa sems sde'i skor/ glong dkar nag so sor ma bu gnyis dang / glong chen rab 'byams ma bu bzhi glong sde'i skor/ snang stong ye shes/ lta sgom spyod 'bras sogs kyi bam po brgya skor gyis bam po'i skor/ mdo lung mdo rtsa mdo 'grel gsum gyis mdo lung skor/ ma stong pa'i ye shes dang bu rig pa'i ye shes gnyis kyis ma bu'i skor/ bka' rdzong gnyan rdzong gnyis kyis rdzong gi skor/ man ngag snyan brgyud che chung gnyis te snyan brgyud skor/ bsam gtan brgyad cu pas bsam gtan skor te sems phyogs dgu'i gsang rgyud chen po gcig /yang ti spyi ti gnyis dang rnam grangs gsum las 'gyur lugs gsang skor zab mo dgu'i nang nas grags sogs zab mo skor drug /sde bzhi gsum sogs paṇ+ḍita lugs kyi bshad thabs/ bdun bskur/ gzhan yang gnas lugs/ 'khrul tshul/ rtogs thabs gom bstobs/ 'bras bu rnams gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud lnga/ glong dgu /yan lag gi rgyud nyer lnga/ dga' rab rdo rje man ngag phran bu bco rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)mā ra sogs la gsungs pa/ yang ti'i skor sgro rgyan chen pos mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan la gsungs pa mang zhing gtso che la/ spyir yang yo ga gsum gyi bstan pa 'di dang por gnyags la babs/ bar du gnubs la babs/ mtha' mar zur la babs pa'i gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra la thugs zin dpal gyi bu bzhi'am brgyad la sogs pa'i slob ma mang du byung ba mtha' dag 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku grub pa sha stag yin zhing gnyags kyis a ro ye shes (204ba)'byung gnas la rdzogs chen gsungs par phyi skor/nang skor/ gsang skor/ gzer skor/ sde skor/ sprul skor te drug tu grags pa sogs a ro khams lugs/ gnyags kyis nyang mchog rab gzhen nu la bshad pas nyang lugs/ gnyag bang kyis sog po dpal gyi ye shes la bshad/ des gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che la bshad pas rong lugs/rong lugs la'ang bshad srol bzhir grags pa'i gnubs kyis sras bzhi'i sogs ye shes dbang phyug la lta ba sgang dril du bshad/ spa gor blo chen 'phags la gab pa mngon phyung du bshad/ dan yon tan mchog la gtar kha gegs sel ltar du bshad/ sru legs pa'i sgron ma la zab mo khong lto ru bshad/sras kyi thu bo yon tan rgya mtsho la sgang dril mngon phyung khong sdebs khong lto gegs sel rnams tshang bar gsungs/ sog po dpal gyi ye shes nas skor ston shes rab ye shes la brgyud par skor lugs/ gsum pos mchims phur bshad pas mchims lugs/ cog ros 'gar la bshad pas cog ro lugs/ dar rje dpal gyi grags pas 'phyong drug tu dpyad pas rtog chos su grags/ des khams su bshad pas khams lugs dang / slar yang dbus su 'phel bas dbus lugs sogs rnam grangs ches mang zhib /lha rje zur po ches snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa nyams shing 'thor ba dag legs par bsdus te rtsa ba dang bshad rgyud 'grel par bsdebs/ sgrub thabs dang cho ga yig sogs la brten nas slob ma 'bangs rtse mo bzhi/ rtse kog lnga/ sgom chen brgya rtsa brgyad sogs dang / yang slob ka ba bzhi/ gdung ma brgyad/gdung phran sum cu rtsa gnyis/ yul po che mi gnyis sogs mang du byung bas bstan rgyun deng sang gi bar du gnas pa dang / nyang chos (205na)dbang rdo rje gling pa'i zab gter las byon pa mtha' klas/ rgyud —308—

dam pa'i sna'i/kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nganacan ma sangs rgyas kun grol/ gu ru chos kyi rdo rje/ sprul sku nor bu 'dzin pa/ chos rje nor bu don grub/drin can sangs rgyas nor bzang / mnyam med bshes gnyen chos rgyal/ gu ru bsam 'phel nor bu/sprul sku chos kyi dbang po man gong ltar ro/ /nye brgyud ni/ gter ston nas/ drin can ma/ chos kyi rdo rje/ nor bu 'dzin pa/ nor bu don grub/ bshes gnyen chos rgyal/ chos kyi dbang po man gong bzhin no//yang (206ba)na nor bu 'dzin pa nas/ don yod rgyal mtshan/ bshes gnyen nor bu/ bshes gnyen chor+sha/rgyal man 'dra/ yang na ga rma gu ru nas/ brag sna ba kun mkhyen dbang phyug /khyab bdag sman lung pa man gong ltar ro/ /yang na ga rma gu ru nas/ rang grol nam mkha' chos dbang / rje sman lung pa man 'dra/ yang na ga rma gu ru nas/ 'brul zhig chos dbang bsam grub/ mnyam med chos dbang kun bzang /rig 'dzin ga rma gsang sngags/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /'dis mtshon pa'i rgyud grags che ba nor so med pa rnams la thog mtha' bar gsum gyi le'u'i brjod don 'god ma dgos shing / dmangs ma rnams la de ltar ma bkod na gsar ma rgyud 'bum dang mi 'dra ba'i rgyud rnam grangs mang zhing mtshan dang le grangs gcig pa la don mi mthun pa sogs 'ong 'dug pa nas rjes su dpe rgyun dang sgo bstun pa'i tshe yid ches kyi gnas su 'gyur ba'i phyir yi ge'i tshegs la ma rtsegs par bkod pa legs par mngon no/ /rgyud thams cad kyi rtse rgyal nam mkha' 'bar ba'i rgyud la/ 'di skad ci yang ming med mtha' stong 'bebs kyi rgyud paṇa chen sku mched kyi gsan yig tu spyi tir mdzad pa don la mi 'gal/ mang thos bsam brjod dmigs pa'i yul las 'das pa'i dus mtha' med pa'i dus na/ gnas kyi rgyal po mu mtha' grol ba na/ ston pa'i rgyal po ming med kun grol bzhugs pa/ sogs gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa dang 'khor gyis nor bzang / mnyam med bshes gnyen chos rgyal/ gu ru bsam 'phel nor bu/sprul sku chos kyi dbang po man gong ltar ro/ /nye brgyud ni/ gter ston nas/ drin can ma/ chos kyi rdo rje/ nor bu 'dzin pa/ nor bu don grub/ bshes gnyen chos rgyal/ chos kyi dbang po man gong bzhin no//yang (206ba)na nor bu 'dzin pa nas/ don yod rgyal mtshan/ bshes gnyen nor bu/ bshes gnyen chor+sha/rgyal man 'dra/ yang na ga rma gu ru nas/ brag sna ba kun mkhyen dbang phyug /khyab bdag sman lung pa man gong ltar ro/ /yang na ga rma gu ru nas/ rang grol nam mkha' chos dbang / rje sman lung pa man 'dra/ yang na ga rma gu ru nas/ 'khrul zhig chos dbang bsam grub/ mnyam med chos dbang kun bzang /rig 'dzin ga rma gsang sngags/ zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /'dis mtshon pa'i rgyud grags che ba nor so med pa rnams la thog mtha' bar gsum gyi le'u'i brjod don 'god ma dgos shing / dmangs ma rnams la de ltar ma bkod na gsar ma rgyud 'bum dang mi 'dra ba'i rgyud rnam grangs mang zhing mtshan dang le bzang po/ byang po 'jam dpal/ shangs pa nag po/glan rdo rje 'od/ sras bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'gos dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ sras bsam grub 'phel/ 'gos dngos grub mgon/ bla ma (209na〉shākya rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal bzang pa/ rgyal sman sngo thogs pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ gnyal pa bde legs dpal/ gra ri khrod pa rog 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen/ rog shes rab 'od la yid dam gyi lhas lung bstan pa'i gdung rabs nyer lnga byung ba'i brgyad pa rin chen chos rgyal bar sras bdun yod pa'i bzhi pa yin/ 'di'i gceng la rgyal sras shes rab bzang po zer/ gra ar dge ba chos dpal rgyal mtshan/ phyam dgon pa mes sgom bsam gtan dpal bzang po/lang 'gro'i rnam sprul gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rat+na gling pa/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/ rje btsun ngag dbang grags pa/ mnyam med ngag dbang nor bu/ bi mā la'i rnam sprul nor bu yongs grags/rgyal ba'i sras po nor bu dbang rgyal/ gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ rje gar dbang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku mchog gter ston gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ /dar gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ sras nor bu dbang rgyal nas/ bya btang nor bu chos brtan/ gnubs ban rnam sprul rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ de sras gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gong gsal nas nyang dang chos dbang gi gter ma rnams la gter brgyud gcig paṇa chen sku mched phyogs la 'dug kyang brgyud pa de las ma thob cing bzang po/ byang po 'jam dpal/ shangs pa nag po/glan rdo rje 'od/ sras bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'gos dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ sras bsam grub 'phel/ 'gos dngos grub mgon/ bla ma (209na slo1kya rgyal gdung rabs nyer lnga byung ba'i brgyad pa rin chen chos rgyal bar sras bdun yod pa'i bzhi pa yin/ 'di'i gceng la rgyal sras shes rab bzang po zer/ gra ar dge ba chos dpal rgyal mtshan/ phyam dgon pa mes sgom bsam gtan dpal bzang po/lang 'gro'i rnam sprul gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rat+na gling pa/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/ rje btsun ngag dbang grags pa/ mnyam med ngag dbang nor bu/ bi mā la'i rnam sprul nor bu yongs grags/rgyal ba'i sras po nor bu dbang rgyal/ gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ rje gar dbang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku mchog gter ston gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal to/ /dar gyi rtags yod pa'i lung brgyud lugs gcig ni/ sras nor bu dbang rgyal nas/ bya btang nor bu chos brtan/ gnubs ban rnam sprul rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ de sras gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /gong gsal nas nyang dang chos dbang gi gter ma rnams la gter brgyud gcig paṇa chen sku mched phyogs la 'dug kyang brgyud pa de las ma thob cing lhun grub pho brang phyogs la gsal kha mi snang / ma nas gter brgyud rnams gter ma khe rkyang min pa'i bka' gter zung 'jug —315—

pa/ ngo sprod nyi shu rtsa gsum bstan pa bcu gsum pa bsgyur byed kyi lo paṇa dang bka' gter gong 'dra/ ye shes mar me'i (khri)rgyud la/ 'di skad bdag gis bstan pa'i dus gcig na ma bris pa'i dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba na srog med pa'i sku sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur chen po sogs le'u gsum lo paṇa dang bka' gter gong 'dra/ sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa'i dgongs pa tshig gsum pa'i rgyud (dran ces bya ba la/ ye shes kyi snang ba 'gag pa med pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor chen po gsal ba'i klong na rang snang rtogs pa'i 'khor rigs lnga dang snang ba 'od kyi phung po la 'du 'bral med par bzhugs so zhes sogs rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang lam bstan pa dang po sogs le'u gsum lo paṇa dang bka' gter gong 'dra/ man ngag snying gi dgongs pa rgyal ba'i bka' zhes bya ba'i rgyud la/ 'di skad bdag gis bstan pa'i dus gcig na rgyal ba 'od kyi phung po chen po ye shes kyi gzhal med khang na rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor 'od gsal ba'i dgongs pa la bzhugs pa sogs sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ bar do'i snang ba bstan pa bdun pa/ 'khor ba ngan song du 'khyams tshul brgyad pa/ gsang skor glegs bam du 'di yan las mi 'dug cing brgyad po khyab bdag khra tshang par yang zhus/ mun khung du sgron me bteg pa lta bu'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o/ /lo paṇa dang bka' gter gong ltar ro/ /(220ba)thig le kun 'dus chen po'i rgyud la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po de rnam dag pad mo'i tshal rin po che ye shes kyi gzhal med khang chen po na sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang sogs gleng gzhi gleng bslang ba'i le'u dang po/ rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khrinabastan pa'i le'u dang po/ sku bzhi rang snang dang bcas pa drug pa/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la ngo sprod pa 'dun pa/ ngo sprod nyi shu rtsa gsum bstan pa bcu gsum pa bsgyur byed kyi lo paṇa dang bka' gter gong 'dra/ ye shes mar me'i (dra)rgyud la/ 'di skad bdag gis bstan pa'i dus gcig na ma bris pa'i dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba na srog med pa'i sku sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur chen po sogs le'u gsum lo paṇa dang bka' gter gong 'dra/ sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa'i dgongs pa tshig gsum pa'i rgyud (khra de ces bya ba la/ ye shes kyi snang ba 'gag pa med pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor chen po gsal ba'i klong na rang snang rtogs pa'i 'khor rigs lnga dang snang ba 'od kyi phung po la 'du 'bral med par bzhugs so zhes sogs rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang lam bstan pa dang po sogs le'u gsum lo paṇa dang bka' gter gong 'dra/ man ngag snying gi dgongs pa rgyal ba'i bka' zhes bya ba'i rgyud la/ 'di skad bdag gis bstan pa'i dus gcig na rgyal ba 'od kyi phung po chen po ye shes kyi gzhal med khang na rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor 'od gsal ba'i dgongs pa la bzhugs pa sogs sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ bar do'i snang ba bstan pa bdun pa/ 'khor ba ngan song du 'khyams tshul brgyad pa/ gsang skor glegs bam du 'di yan las mi 'dug cing brgyad po khyab bdag khra tshang par yang zhus/ mun khung du sgron me bteg pa lta bu'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o/ /lo paṇa dang bka' gter gong ltar ro/ /(220ba)thig le kun 'dus chen po'i rgyud la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po de rnam dag pad mo'i tshal rin po che ye shes kyi gzhal med khang chen po na sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang sogs gleng gzhi gleng bslang ba'i le'u dang po/ man ngag rgyud bzhi bshad pa drug pa/ man ngag rgyud bzhi'i dgongs pa bstan pa bdun pa/ rjes su yi rang ba ste le'u bcu gnyis mjug na lo phran zhe bdun pa zhes pa zhig snang / pa'o slob dpon chen po pad mas nam mkha'i snying po sogs rje 'bangs grogs gsum la gdams pa/ sku —332

pos gdams pa sogs gong bzhin no/ /gsung rgyud rdo rje rtse mo 'dus pa la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na 'khor chen po 'dus pa'i tshogs ma lus pa rnams legs par nyon ngas shes rab kyi pha rol la/ paṇa ོ sku mgo kyi gas yig tu klong sder snang ngo / /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po de me ri 'bar ba'i rtse mo sri la mu dra'i dur khrod kyi gnas chen po na sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ ngo sprod bzhi'i dgongs pa dang bcas pa'i brda bstan pa dgu pa/ sems dang ye shes brdar bstan pa bcu pa/—333—

/'brom rin chen 'bar/ ldang ma lhun grub rgyal/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug /'a sgom klu po/ bla ma shes rab grags/ la stod rje btsun zla ba/ rgyal ba zhang ston/ zhad chen nyi 'bum/ gu ru jo 'ber/ sgom bsam gtan bzang po/ chos rgyal rat+na gling pa/ rgyal sras tshe —334—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)phyug /gu ru shangs pa ras pa/ bla ma zab don chos 'bar/ dam pa dge ston yab sras/ gnyan ston shes rab rtse mo/ drin can sprul sku mched gnyis/ rgyal sman nam mkha' rdo rje/ rig 'dzin ku mā rā dza/g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ thugs sras dge 'dun bzang po/ rgyal sras rdo rje thugs mchog rtsal/ mkha' spyod dbang mo don grub bzang mo/ gter ston kun skyong gling pa/ zur hā ma rgyal ba dpal bzang lha rigs 'jam dpal dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mnga' rigs paṇa chen dbang rgyal rdo rje/ gcung rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ ri phug rgyal sras kun mkhyen 'byung gnas/ de sras 'jam dbyangs legs ldan/ mtshungs med don grub rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /gter ma ltar na/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po nas/ man gong ltar ro/ /yang na ku mā rā dza nas/ klong chen rab 'byams/ rje chos dbang bzang po/ bla ma chos nyid rang grol/ gu ru shākya bzang po/ gu ru burnya shrī/ sprul sku chos kyi dbang po/ rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na ri phug rgyal sras thugs mchog rtsal nas/ pha rgod bsod nams bzang po/ don grub bzang mo/ rdzogs chen pa shākya rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang gsang sngags rdo (223na)rje/ legs ldan rje man 'dra/ yang na lce btsun nas/lce sgom nag po/ jo sras rgyal po/ la stod pa gzhon dga'/ lte ston rdo rje bzung / mkhas btsun 'od bzung / lhun grub rdo rje/ rong pa sgom man gong ltar ro/ /yang na ku mā rā dza nas/ klong chen rab 'byams/ rje chos dbang bzang po/ bla ma chos nyid rang grol/ gu ru shākya bzang po/ gu ru burnya shrī/ sprul sku chos kyi dbang po/ rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na ri phug rgyal sras thugs mchog rtsal nas/ pha rgod bsod nams bzang po/ don grub bzang mo/ rdzogs chen pa shākya rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang gsang sngags rdo (223na)rje/ legs ldan rje man 'dra/ yang na lce btsun nas/lce sgom nag po/ jo sras rgyal po/ la stod pa gzhon dga'/ lte ston rdo rje bzung / mkhas btsun 'od bzung / lhun grub rdo rje/ rong pa sgom chen/ skal ldan ye shes/ lha rje jo skyid/ sprul sku bstan 'dzin/rdo rje rtse mo/ sangs rgyas dbang rdor/ lce khro bo rgyal po/ bla ma dga' rab rdo rje/ zur hāpa chos rje/ dam pa dpal bzang / shākya mi tra/ sog po dpal ye/ sprul ston kun bzang dpal/ ka thog pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ka thog pa rnam grol bzang po/ legs ldan rje man 'dra/ yang na lce sgom nag po nas/ gzad drang srong sngon mo/ gtsang pa ya ring grags gse/ mkhar steng thag ston pad+ma/ 'phyong rgyasaspen mkhar sha ston rdor gling pa/ 'phyongs phug nyang brtson 'grus seng ge /dbon rin po che skal ldan —336

gnas brtan rab snang / smad 'tshong ma burnya sa ma rnyi/ khyi'i rgyal po ku ku rā dza/ o rgyan gyi dge slong ma hā rā dzā/ ā tsarla a lo ka /phyi'i rgyal po phyi ma/ burnya kun+da/ 'jam dpal bzang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po gnyis kyis gsan/ yang na shrī sidha la slob dpon pad mas gsan/ slob dpon pad ma/ bi mā la/ be+e ro gsum ga la gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ smyo nge/khams pa bde legs pa/ gra 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen/ mkhas btsun chos dpal rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsam gtan bzang po/ gter chen rat+na gling pa/ gcen tshe dbang grags pa/ gcung ngag dbang grags pa/ thugs sras ngag dbang nor bu/ gtsug rgyan nor bu yongs grags/ chos gter nor bu dbang rgyal/ gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ rje tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rig 'dzin chen po gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang dar gyi rtags yod pa rnams kyi brgyud lugs gcig ni/ nor bu dbang rgyal nas/ bya btang nor bu chos brtan/ rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang nye brgyud lugs gcig ni/ shākya thub pa/ lha'i bu kun dga' snying po sems lhag can/ dga' rab rdo rje/ sha wa ri pa/ mai tri pa/ shrī sidha/ lo chen be+e ro/ rgyal mo g.yu sgra/ gnyis ka la gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra/ de nas a ro ye shes 'byung gnas/ khams pa ya zi dbon ston/ gru gu glog 'byung / kong rab 'tsho/ bla ma kon pa ba/ bla ma spor la ba/ dam pa gru sgrogs/ zhang zhal dkar ba/'gos dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ de la sras bsam grub 'phel dang dge slong gnyis kyis zhus/ gnyis ka la dngos grub kyis gsan pa man gong dang 'dra/ yang na khams pa ya zi dbon ston/ des gtsang pa cog ro zangs dkar/ kha rag gi bri sha rgyal bu/ dbus pa grub seng / shes rab smon lam bzhi la bshad/ yang na ya zi dang cog ro gnyis gas gru gu blo gros 'byung gnas/ brag zangs phug gi skyong rab 'tsho la gnang / de nas lha lcam lha dar/ lha lcam sgom pa/ gyi mkhar mchin yul du tshim mi byang chub rdo rje/ stag tshal gyi spo gam lo grags/ yang lte (230na〉skom gyi brag dkar/ yang lce zhes pa gnas kyi ming la yang na'i don min no/ /kha rag gi ban+de grags pa dpal/ rngog ston rgyal ba bkra shis/ 'gos ri khrod dbang phyug /'gos dngos grub rgyal mtshan man gong bzhin no/ /'di rnams kyi brgyud rim la khamasapa ya zi dang cog ro sogs yod pas rdzogs chen khams lugs dang cog ro lugs zhes pa'i tha snyad kyang snang ngo / /—347—

las 'das pa gnyis pa'o/ /de'i don gyi 'grel pa le'u gsum pa byas so/phun sum tshogs ldar/pa'i mdo la/ kye 'dus pa'i tshogs chen da nyon cig /kun bzang rgyal ba mchog gi lha/ sogs ston 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'i le'u rtsa ba/ de'i don gyi 'grel pa gsum pa rdzogs so can/ bye brag 6re/'byed pa'i mdo la/ kye 'dus pa'i tshogs chen nyon/ chos kun yo ga bzhir 'dus te/ sogs yo ga bzhi'i bye brag 'byed pa'i le'u rtsa ba/ de'i don 'grel mdo bzhi pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ khyad par 'phags 'ar)pa'i mdo la/ kye 'dus pa'i tshogs chen da nyon cig /khyad par 'phags pa'i mdo 'di la/ /sogs khyad par 'phags pa'i che ba lnga bstan pa'i le'u rtsa ba/ de'i mdo (231na 'grel rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ skyon yon gsal bar byed pa 'a re/gol sgrib bstan pa'i mdo rtsa ba/ kye 'dus pa'i tshogs chen da nyon cig /nges par thob pa'i theg pa drug /sogs de'i mdo 'grel bstan pa'o'i mtha' can/ gtan la 'bebs pa'i 9re/mdo la/ kye kun bzang gnyen po rdo rje khyod/ khyod ni gsung gi seng ge ste zhes sogs lung gsum dang man ngag bzhis chos thams cad gtan la 'bebs par byed pa rtsa ba dang / de'i 'grel pa gnyis so/ /nges par ston pa'i mdo 6re/kye 'dus pa'i tshogs chen da nyon cig /nges par ston pa'i mdo 'di las/ /sogs rtsa ba dang de'i man ngag rnam pa brgyad bstan pa dang 'grel ba/ theg pa yas 'bubs lta dang de theg dgu'i mdo la/ kye 'dus pa'i tshogs chen da nyon cig /chos nyid rang bzhin sems nyid de/ /sogs rtsa ba dang de'i 'grel pa gnyis so/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i 6re/mdo la/ kye 'dus pa'i tshogs chen da nyon cig /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams ni/ /sogs rtsa ba dang de'i 'grel pa gnyis so/ /chos thams cad tshig
