bar ston pa/ mjug bstan pa yongs su gtad pa'i le'u'i mtshan 'doms dang bcas pa/—349

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nge)tshogs chen po nyon cig /gnyis ni rnam pa'i bye brag de sogs 'jig rten pa'i theg pa bstan pa'i le'u dang po dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis pa'o/ /de'i don gyi 'grel pa le'u gsum pa byas so/phun sum tshogs 'a re/pa'i mdo la/ kye 'dus pa'i tshogs chen da nyon cig /kun bzang rgyal ba mchog gi lha/ sogs ston 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'i le'u rtsa ba/ de'i don gyi 'grel pa gsum pa rdzogs so can/ bye brag 6re/'byed pa'i mdo la/ kye 'dus pa'i tshogs chen nyon/ chos kun yo ga bzhir 'dus te/ sogs yo ga bzhi'i bye brag 'byed pa'i le'u rtsa ba/ de'i don 'grel mdo bzhi pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ khyad par 'phags 'ar)pa'i mdo la/ kye 'dus pa'i tshogs chen da nyon cig /khyad par 'phags pa'i mdo 'di la/ /sogs khyad par 'phags pa'i che ba lnga bstan pa'i le'u rtsa ba/ de'i mdo (231na 'grel rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ skyon yon gsal bar byed pa 'a re/gol sgrib bstan pa'i mdo rtsa ba/ kye 'dus pa'i tshogs chen da nyon cig /nges par thob pa'i theg pa drug /sogs de'i mdo 'grel bstan pa'o'i mtha' can/ gtan la 'bebs pa'i 9re/mdo la/ kye kun bzang gnyen po rdo rje khyod/ khyod ni gsung gi seng ge ste zhes sogs lung gsum dang man ba dang de'i man ngag rnam pa brgyad bstan pa dang 'grel ba/ theg pa yas 'bubs (dar/theg dgu'i mdo la/ kye 'dus pa'i tshogs chen da nyon cig /chos nyid rang bzhin sems nyid de/ /sogs rtsa ba dang de'i 'grel pa gnyis so/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i 6re/mdo la/ kye 'dus pa'i tshogs chen da nyon cig /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams ni/ /sogs rtsa ba dang de'i 'grel pa gnyis so/ /chos thams cad tshig dang yi ges gtan la dbab tu med pa ste don 'grel lnga zhes pa tsheg par 'bru'i 'grel pa/ dpe don rgyu 'bras 'grel pa/ gtan tshigs don gyi 'grel pa/ 'byed pa dang sdud pa'i 'grel pa sogs skyon yon gsal bar ston pa/ mjug bstan pa yongs su gtad pa'i le'u'i mtshan 'doms dang bcas pa/—349

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 'del zlo gsang ba'i 'khor lo/ dgongs gleng nas shar ba'i ma rig mun sel zhes bya ba'i rgyud la/ de nas sems dpa' chen po la byang chub sems dpa' kun byed rgyal pos chos thams cad la nges pa dang dmigs su med par dgongs nas zhes sogs phun sum tshogs pa lnga rang (231ba)du la zla ba'i le'u dang po/ bcos su med pa la zla ba drug pa/ yongs grol du la zla ba bcu pa/ rgyud gtad gsal ka med kyang don gyi le'u bcu gcig pa'o/ /bshad rgyud chen po bzhi la byang chub kyi sems rdzogs pa chen po 'khor ba rtsad nas (dar/gcod pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa yi ge med pa'i rgyud la/ paṇa ོ sku mar kyi gsan yig zur du bris 'dug kyang brgyud pa 'dren lugs kun byed dang mthun pas don gyi sems sder bzhed do/ /'di skad rtog pa'i dus gcig na/ /mkha' klong rnam dag chos kyi dbyings/ /kun bzang yangs pa skye med klong / /ye shes lnga sogs 'od zer 'phro/ /zhes sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ bde chen gsal ba bdun pa/rnam rtog ye shes su 'bar ba brgyad pa/ rgyud gtad pa la le'u ma byas kyang don gyis bcu bzhi pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ chos thams cad byang chub kyi sems rdzogs pa chen po 'khor ba brtsad nas gcod pa rgya mtsho dang mnyam pa rnyog po/ sgom pa'i le'u bzhi pa/ bstod par le'u ma byas kyang don gyi le'u brgyad pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ chos thams cad byang chub kyi sems rdzogs pa chen po 'khor ba rtsad nas (dar)gcod pa nyi zla dang mnyam pa dri ma med pa'i rgyud la/ 'di skad bshad pa'i dus gcig na/ /chos nyid mkha' dbyings nyid kyi klong / /ye shes dri ma med par dag /chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang na/ /zhes sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ chos kyi dbyings kyi thig le bdun pa/ lhun grub thig le bcu gcig pa rjes su yi rang bstod pa dang bcas pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ chos thams cad byang chub kyi sems rdzogs pa chen po 'khor (232na)ba rtsad nas 'ar)gcod pa rin po che dang mnyam pa skye ba med pa'i rgyud la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po 'og min —350

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nganachos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang na rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas zhes sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang kun 'dus rig pa bdun pa/ srog gi 'khor lo brgyad pa/ khams gsum sgron ma'i le'u bcu bzhi pa bstod pa'i mjug dang bcas pa 'gyur gong dang 'dra ba rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/rgyal po dha na tā la/ sras thu bo rā dza/ pra hasti/ sras mo sa ra ni/ yig rnying rnams su sa ra dang pa ra gnyis nges med du 'ong bog pa yig nor min pa'i go don so sor yod skad/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo/ 'jog po'ang zer/ gnod sbyin byang chub ma/ smad 'tshong ma sa ra ni/ kha che'i mkhan po rab snang / smad 'tshong ma bzhi sa ma rnyi/ sras mo go ma de sa/ ā tsarla a lo / khyi'i rgyal po ku ku rā dza/ drang srong bha ṣi ta/ gzugs 'tshong ma bdud rtsi ma/'gags pa nā gā rdzu na/ ku ku rā dza phyi ma/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen phyi ma/ lha'i mkhan po ma hā rā dza/ bu d+dha kunā/ slob dpon shrī sidha/ dge slong ma kun dga' mo/ lo chen be+e ro tsa na/ dpang sangs rgyas mgon/ sbas ra lha ta/ ya zi dar ma shes rab/ nyang stod smra mnga' gsol bar brten sngags 'chang rnams lha rjer grags par gtsang smyon pas ma go bar rje mi la'i rnam thar du lha rje gnubs chung la sman dang sngags gnyis ka shes pa zhes dag mdog byed pa ni bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /bshes gnyen ston snying / glan shākya byang chub/ glan rdo rje 'od/ sras bsod nams rgyal (232ba)mtshan/ 'gos dngos grub mgon/ bla ma shākya rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal bzang po/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ gnyal pa bde legs dpal/ bla ma mtshams pa ba 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen/ ar dge ba chos dpal rgyal mtshan/ phyam dgon pa bsam gtan bzang po/ sprul pa'i gter ston rat+na gling pa/sras tshe dbang grags pa/ rje ngag dbang grags pa/ mnyam med ngag dbang nor bu/ rje nor bu yongs grags/ gtsug rgyan nor bu dbang rgyal/ drin chen gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang dar gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rje nor bu dbang rgyal nas/ bya btang nor bu chos brtan/—351 —

tsa na man 'dra/ yang na be+e ro tsa na nas/ rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po/ gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra/ a ro ye shes sting gnas/ khams kyi la zi bon ston/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal/ brum shing klag gnyis la gnang / de gnyis ka la 'gos dngos grub mgon gyis gsan pa man gong ltar ro/ khams lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/lha'i bu sems lhag can/ rigs 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje/ sha wa ri dbang phyug /rje mi tri pa/ mkhas pa shrī sidha/ be+e ro tsa na/ rgyal mo g.yu sgra/ gnyags la ye shes gar+sha ne nu/ a ro ye shes 'byung gnas/ ya zi bon ston/ gru gu klog 'byung / kong rab 'tsho/ bla ma yan gong ltar la/ cog ro zangs dkar pa/ gru gu blo gros 'byung gnas/ rag zab phu'i kong rab 'tsho/ ldan dar ma ba/ lce sgom nag po/ bla ma brag dkar ba/ kha rag brag dpal/ rngog rgyal ba bkra shis/ 'gog ri khrod dbang phyug /'gos dngos sdi/ba rgyal mtshan man 'dra/kun byed rgyal po phyi ma phyi ma'i phyi ma dang bcas pa'i le'u gya bzhi pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/gsung sprul yan gong ltar la/ khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na 'jam dpal bshes gnyen yan gong dang 'dra ba la/ shrī sidha/ lo chen be+e ro/ dpang sangs rgyas mgon po/ sbas rak+ta ta/ ya zi dar ma shes rab/ zer mo dge slong ma bde gsal/ de nas pho brgyud mo brgyud gnyis su gyes pa'i mo brgyud ni/ zer mos mar pa khrom rgyal la gnang / pho brgyud ni/ ya zi nyang ston pra bha la gnang/ de nas sa khrig tu 'dres te dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nga)la gnang ba dang gsum gyi gras su rgya rdo rje dpal bgrangs 'dug kyang / paṇa chen sku mched gnyis ka'i gsan yig tu 'di bzhi byung /des dbus kyi na rog ston pa/ gtsang gi sum pa dbang tshul/ lho brag gi mar chung shes rab mdog gsum la gnang / de gsum ga la lang za dar ma bsod nams kyi zhus/ de nas 'ug bya lung pa bde legs shākya 'byung gnas/ zur chung shes rab grags/ gom po'i skyo ston shākya ye shes/ slob ma ka bzhi gdung brgyad las man ngag rdzogs 'a gyi ka ba/ nya ri ba zur shākya seng ge /zur chung ba'i sras mda' tsha hor po'am rje sgro phug bar grags/ dam pa shāka rgyal/ wang shākya bla ma/ rig 'dzin chen po'i gsan yig tu dkyus ltar byung zhing paṇa chen gyi gsan yig tu ye shes bla ma zhes snang / gnyis ka la lce (233ba〉ston zung de/ de nas zhabrul zhig bya ru pa chen po/rgya ston rdo rje dpal/ rgya ston ngo gzung / bla ma spang rtsa ba/ lce ston grub pa pa/ zur byams pa seng ge /rta nag sgrol ma ba 'jam dbyangs bsam grub rdo rje/ zur mo mkhas pa sras btsun/ zur hā ma chos rje/zur shāka 'byung phyir ma dang zur thams cad mkhyen pa'ang zer/ zur shākya bzang po dpal/ zur shākya bshes gnyen/sog po dpal gyi ye shes/ sprul kun bzang dpal/ lho ka thog pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ka thog pa rnam grol ye shes bzang po/ ka thog pa chos kyi seng ge /lha bro sprul sku chos kyi dbang po/ gu ru ga rma chos skyong / yar 'brog do nang pa bla ma bkra shis lhun grub/ rigs kun khyab bdag sman lung pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na a ro ye shes 'byung gnas nas/ grub thob dpal gyi ye shes/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gnubs khu lung pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ bla ma nyang chen sku mched/ zur chen shākya 'byung gnas man 'dra/ yang na zur chung shes rab grags nas/ glan sgom shākya bzang po/ mkhas pa mda' tig chos shāka /'gro mgon gsang bdag gnyis pa/ skyo ston shāka ye/ dam pa shāka rgyal/ bla ma lha rje chen po/ bde gshegs mtshan ldan zhig po/ sangs rgyas gnyos ston/ gnyos ston shākya 'bum/ skye med dam pa sangs rgyas/ skyes mchogo sprul sku chen po/ mnga' ris paṇa chen/ rig 'dzin chen po'i gsan yig tu/ 'dum pa dga' ldan pho brang du/ chos sku mnga' ris paṇa chen la/ zhes byung /des dbus kyi na rog ston pa/ gtsang gi sum pa dbang tshul/ lho brag gi mar chung shes rab mdog gsum la gnang / de gsum ga la lang za dar ma bsod nams kyi zhus/ de nas 'ug bya lung pa bde legs shākya 'byung gnas/ zur chung shes rab grags/ gom po'i skyo ston shākya ye shes/ slob ma ka bzhi gdung brgyad las man ngag rdzogs 'a gyi ka ba/ nya ri ba zur shākya seng ge /zur chung ba'i sras mda' tsha hor po'am rje sgro phug bar grags/ dam pa shāka rgyal/ wang shākya bla ma/ rig 'dzin chen po'i gsan yig tu dkyus ltar byung zhing paṇa chen gyi gsan yig tu ye shes bla ma zhes snang / gnyis ka la lce (233ba〉ston zung de/ de nas 'khrul zhig bya ru pa chen po/rgya ston rdo rje dpal/ rgya ston ngo gzung / bla ma spang rtsa ba/ lce ston grub pa pa/ zur byams pa seng ge /rta nag sgrol ma ba 'jam dbyangs bsam grub rdo rje/ zur mo mkhas pa sras btsun/ zur hā ma chos rje/zur shāka 'byung phyir ma dang zur thams cad mkhyen pa'ang zer/ zur shākya bzang po dpal/ zur shākya bshes gnyen/sog po dpal gyi ye shes/ sprul kun bzang dpal/ lho ka thog pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ka thog pa rnam grol ye shes bzang po/ ka thog pa chos kyi seng ge /lha bro sprul sku chos kyi dbang po/ gu ru ga rma chos skyong / yar 'brog do nang pa bla ma bkra shis lhun grub/ rigs kun khyab bdag sman lung pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na a ro ye shes 'byung gnas nas/ grub thob dpal gyi ye shes/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gnubs khu lung pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ bla ma nyang chen sku mched/ zur chen shākya 'byung gnas man 'dra/ yang na zur chung shes rab grags nas/ glan sgom shākya bzang po/ mkhas pa mda' tig chos shāka /'gro mgon gsang bdag gnyis pa/ skyo ston shāka ye/ dam pa shāka rgyal/ bla ma lha rje chen po/ bde gshegs mtshan ldan zhig po/ sangs rgyas gnyos ston/ gnyos ston /zhes sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ thams cad de bzhin nyid du bstan pa gnyis pa/ bsam gtan mthar phyin pa'i tshad bstan pa bcu bzhi pa/ sgom chags kyi nad bsal ba bstan pa bco lnga pa/ 'di don kun gyi thun mong ma yin par bstan pa nyer dgu pa/ kun la bstan pa min par gsungs pa le'u sum cu pa'o/ /'di'i mjug tu/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen bla ma dang / /bdag 'dra be+e ro tsa na yis/ /sgra skad bstun te mchan la phab/ bod kyi yul du rmongs pa chen gsum 'byung ba cha mchis na 'dir drangs mnga' bdag rgyal po (236na)nyid kyi phyag tu phul/ rmongs pa tshan gsum dus na dar bar shog ces snang la/ lo chen be+e ros bsgyur te lho brag mkho mthing lha khang du gter du sbas pa gu ru ye shes khyung grags dang sba shrī rat+na spyan drangs so/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' che brag bram ze rgyas pa'i rgyud la/ 'di skad bshad pa'i dus na 'og min gyi gnas chos nyid kyi mkha' dbyings nyid kyi klong sems nyid kyi gnas ye shes sgrib pa mi mnga' ba'i gzhal yas na nyid kyi rang bzhin dang nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyi thugs rjes sprul pa'i 'khor 'di lta ste/ rang bzhin gyi 'khor chos kyi sku zhes bya ba dang ngo bo nyid kyi 'khor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes bya ba dang thugs rje chen po'i 'khor sprul pa'i sku zhes bya ba dang / zhes sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ dam tshig gi bsrung du med pa'i le'u bdun pa/ 'phrin las btsal du med pa'i le'u brgyad pa/ rgyud yongs su gtad pa bcu drug pa'o/ /bde ba chen po byang chub kyi sems rmad 'a re/du byung ba'i rgyud la/ med byung byang chub sems 'di gnas/ /de yi gzhal yas yon tan gyi/ /don de bstan pa 'di yin no/ /zhes sogs chos kyi gleng gzhi lda le'u dang po/ byang chub kyi sems med du byung ba gnyis pa/ spros pa med pa gsum pa/gsang ba dam pa'i rmad du byung ba nyer gnyis pa/ btsal ba dang bral ba nyer gsum pa/ slob ma snod ngan la mi bstan pa zhe gcig pa/ slob ma snod bzang po la lobs par bya ba'i yon tan thun mong ma yin pa zhe gnyis pa'o/ /—357—

gyi thun mong ma yin par bstan pa nyer dgu pa/ kun la bstan pa min par gsungs pa le'u sum cu pa'o/ /'di'i mjug tu/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen bla ma dang / /bdag 'dra be+e ro tsa na yis/ /sgra skad bstun chen be+e ros bsgyur te lho brag mkho mthing lha khang du gter du sbas pa gu ru ye shes khyung grags dang sba shrī rat+na spyan drangs so/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' che brag bram ze rgyas pa'i rgyud la/ 'di skad bshad pa'i dus na 'og min gyi gnas chos nyid kyi mkha' dbyings nyid kyi klong sems nyid kyi gnas ye shes sgrib pa mi mnga' ba'i gzhal yas na nyid kyi rang bzhin dang nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyi thugs rjes sprul pa'i 'khor 'di lta ste/ rang bzhin gyi 'khor chos kyi sku zhes bya ba dang ngo bo nyid kyi 'khor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes bya ba dang thugs rje chen po'i 'khor sprul pa'i sku zhes bya ba dang / zhes sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ dam tshig gi bsrung du med pa'i le'u bdun pa/ 'phrin las btsal du med pa'i le'u brgyad pa/ rgyud yongs su gtad pa bcu drug pa'o/ /bde ba chen po byang chub kyi sems rmad 'a re/du byung ba'i rgyud la/ med byung byang chub sems 'di gnas/ /de yi gzhal yas yon tan gyi/ /don de bstan pa 'di yin no/ /zhes sogs chos kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ byang chub kyi sems med du byung ba gnyis pa/ spros pa med pa gsum pa/gsang ba dam pa'i rmad du byung ba nyer gnyis pa/ btsal ba dang bral ba nyer gsum pa/ slob ma snod ngan la mi bstan pa zhe gcig pa/ slob ma snod bzang po la lobs par bya ba'i yon tan thun mong ma yin pa zhe gnyis pa'o/ /—357—

ldan 'das longs spyod chen po phyogs bcu dus bzhi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid ces sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ gleng bslang gnyis pa/ don dam pa dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nga)pos lha'i bu grags ldan mchog skyong / de nas lha rin chen 'od 'bar/ tshangs pa skye rgu'i bdag po/tshangs pa kun sgrol/ tshangs pa gtsug phud 'dzin/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin/ des lha'i rig 'dzin tshem bu 'bum rjes su bzung ste rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis klu rgyal mgrin nag /klu mo kha 'dul/ klu mo 'dul tshangs ma/ klu yid 'ong dga' ma/ klu rgyal 'jog po/ des klu'i rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum rjes su bzung ste rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob/ phyag na rdo rjes gnod sbyin kun bzang sogs gnod sbyin gyi rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum rjes su (253ba)bzung ste rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob par mdzad/ de nas 'gro ba mi dang mi min gnyis gar brgyud tshul ni/ gsang ba bdag pos ri ma la ya'i rtse mor byon nas lha grags ldan phyogs skyong / gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong / srin po laṅka mgrin bcu/ blo gros thabs ldan yang zer mdo lang gshegs zhu ba po blo gros 'a po dang don gcig go /klu rgyal 'jog po/li tsa byi dri ma med par grags pa ste dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga la bshad/ de dag gi nang nas srin po blo gros thabs ldan gyis glegs bam du bzhengs pa'i tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad kyi char rgyal po dza'i pho brang gi rtser babs/ bcom ldan ral gri'i rgyud sde rgyan du klu sgrub kyi gzhung las sangs rgyas 'das nas lo nyer brgyad na o rgyan rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi'i khang par phyi nang gsang ba'i rgyud phyag na rdo rjes snang bar byas te yul chen po ma la ya'i dbus na dge slong ku ku ra dza ā tsarla zhes bya bas rgyud thams cad lar shes pa'ang des byin gyis brlabs shes pa snang ngo / /po ti rnams rā dza nyid kyis ma rtogs de dge slong ku ku rā dza zhes bya ba tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin grub cing byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang gi sprul pa zhig gis brtags pas/ gsan yig phyi ma phal cher na don 'di dang rgyal po go ldog 'dug pa mdo'i shan shor ba yin la/ paṇa chen sku mched kyi gsan yig na dkyus ltar byung bas lo rgyus dang yang mthun zhing khungs btsun pa'o//dang po rdo rje sems dpa' grags pa/ glan shākya byang chub man 'dra/ yang na zur chung pa nas/yang kheng bla ma chen po/ sgrol phug pa shāka seng man 'dra/ yang na zur po che nas/ thugs sras ka ba bzhi/ gsang bdag sgrol phug pa man 'dra/ yang na ku ku rā dza nas/ da na lu kri sha da ma hā rā dza/ ro langs bde ba/ nam mkha'i snying po sogs lo tsā ba drug man gong dang 'dra/ nam mkha'i snying po nas 'di labargyud gsan yig rnams su mi gsal yang gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la brgyud pa 'dra'o/ /khra'i rtags sku1da pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje gsung sprul nas/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ cing skad gsar bcad kyis bcos/ slar 'jam (258na)dpal bshes gnyen gyi slob ma yang rab shi len ta burnya gar+bhas khu byin btsun pa shes rab la 'di stsal to/ /yon tan gyi rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal bdud rtsi rol pa la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na longs spyod chen po'i gnas dam par gyur pa de nyid phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid du gyur te nyid kyi snang ba yongs su ma 'gags pa zhes sogs le'u dang po nas bzung 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par 'phrul ba'i tshul le'u lnga pa bsdoms par rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po byang chub sems kyi de kho na nyid bstan cing dkyil 'khor kun tu 'phrul pa ste rim par phye ba dang po/ dngos grub kyi dkyil 'khor nye bar sgrub pa'i tshul te rim par phye ba lnga pa/ nye bar bsdus pa'i tshul bstan pa ste rim par phye ba brgyad pa'o/ /rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la mi tra dang bod kyi lo tsā ba gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra'i 'gyur/ phur pa bcu gnyis 'byung ba'i rgyud (dra)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i yang gsang ba theg pa chen po'i mdo la/ dkon rgyud bskyoganyis kyi sgang phywa/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na bcom ldan 'das gsang ba gsum gyi bdag po spros pa med pa'i byang chub kyi sems rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)bod kyi lo tsā ba khu byin btsun pa mchog gi 'gyur/ slar rgya gar gyi lo tsā mkhas par lobs pa bal bo shrī gī rtis gtan la phab dpal bdud rtsi rol pa la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na longs spyod chen po'i gnas dam par gyur pa de nyid phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid du gyur te nyid kyi snang ba brgyad pa'o/ /rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la mi tra dang bod kyi lo tsā ba gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra'i 'gyur/ phur pa bcu gnyis 'byung ba'i rgyud (dra)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i po de nyid yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ltar gnas pa rgyud dag pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar dbyer med par rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba zhes sogs gsang —390

ldan/ ku ku rā dza/ rgyal po dza/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ go ma de khyi/ shākya su tri/ rā dza hasti/ hūṃ chen ka ra/ bu d+dha ku smi/pra bha hasti/ rdo rje bzhad pa/ snyi ra ma ti/ ra gi nā ga /bram ze nyi ma/ gti pad+ma/ bram ze tshangs pa spu —391

gnyisagacig tu mdzad 'dug kyang rat+na'i gsan yig na so sor snang ngo / /rgyal ba'i snying po/ glan grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glan rdo rje 'od/ gsung sprul gyi gsan yig na rdo rje rgyal mas zhes snang ba dbang phyug /lha lung dpal rdor/ sog po rgyal ba'i semasadapa'/ yang dgon lhun grub rdo rje/ 'gos rgyal ba'i snying po/ she ston dpal gyi rin chen/ bla ma 'dan ston pa/ meng ge rgyal ba'i rdo rje man bshad ma thag pa ltar la rje khra tshang par zhug pa'o/ /dri med bshags rgyud kyi sgos brgyud ni/ sras mo go ma de khyu yan gong ltar las/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ bi mā la mi tra/ rma rin chen mchog ma/ dpal ldan bzang po/ pha la shrī/ zur shākya bshes gnyen/ sog po dpal ye/ kun bzang dpal/ ka thog pa bsod rgyan/ rnam grol bzang po/ chos kyi seng ge /chos kyi dbang po/ ga me chos skyong / bkra shis lhun grub/ rje khra tshang pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na so ye shes dbang phyug nas/ khu lung pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ gnubs ye shes rgya mtsho/ nyang shes rab mchog /shing ye shesa'abyung gnas/ zur po che/ thugs sras rtse mo bzhi/ zur chung pa/ thugs sras ka ba bzhi/ sgrol phug pa/nyi ston chos seng / gtsang nag 'od 'bar/ zur pa le/ zur he sa g.yung ston sangs rgyas/ rgya gab gong ba/ g.yung dbang phyug /lha lung dpal rdor/ sog po rgyal ba'i semasadapa'/ yang dgon lhun grub rdo rje/ 'gos rgyal ba'i snying po/ she ston dpal gyi rin chen/ bla ma 'dan ston pa/ meng ge rgyal ba'i rdo rje man bshad ma thag pa ltar la rje khra tshang par zhug pa'o/ /dri med bshags rgyud kyi sgos brgyud ni/ sras mo go ma de khyu yan gong ltar las/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ bi mā la mi tra/ rma rin chen mchog /gtsug ru rin chen gzhon nu dang gye re mchog skyong gnyis la bshad/gnyis gas khyung po dbying 'od/ de nas zhang rgyal ba'i yon tan/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ so ye shes dbang phyug /ngab thung byang chub rgyal mtshan/ skor thung shes rab ye shes/ ra thung ye shes tshul khrims/ nyang shar mchog /nyang ye 'byung / zur che chung / bla ma bsod nams grags pa/ glan shākya byang chub/ (261na〉sgrol phug phyi ma/ dpal ldan bzang po/ pha la shrī/ zur shākya bshes gnyen/ sog po dpal ye/ kun bzang dpal/ ka thog pa bsod rgyan/ rnam grol bzang po/ chos kyi seng ge /chos kyi dbang po/ ga me chos skyong / bkra shis lhun grub/ rje khra tshang pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na so ye shes dbang phyug nas/ khu lung pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ gnubs ye shes rgya mtsho/ nyang shes rab mchog /shing ye shesa'abyung gnas/ rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)ngag bstan pa bcu pa/ kā la ru pa'i le'u gnyis (263ba)byung ba las bcu gcig pa/ gsang ba'i las gnyis dang ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u bcu gnyis pa/ man ngag gsang ba'i las dgu pa'i le'u bcu gsum pa/ 'khor gyis bstod pa so gsum pa/ dbu zhabs su don bsdus pa dang dam bcas pa'i le'u so bzhi pa'o/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gsang ba rgyud kyi rgyal po pra khog (gnubs)snang ba'i rgyud phyi ma'i rgyal po sgrub pa'i lung khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud phyi ma'i yang phyi ma la/ gsung sprul gyis ga༅ yig na bar le rnams ma tshang bas nor ram brtag ces pa 'dug kyang / paṇa chen sku mched kyi gsan yig na le grangs kyi gsal kha ma mdzad cing sngags gsar rnying gi rgyud 'ga' zhig tu 'di rigs yong 'dug pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges/ pra khog bslang ba slad pa snang ba sogs zer kyang kun mkhyen dga' gdong pa'i bka' 'gyur gyi gsan yig na snang ba 'dug cing rang lugs bka' shog rgya bo che na yod/de nas 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis ni/ khro bo'i ming ni gshin rje'i gshed/ /mtshon cha me ltar 'bar ba 'khrigs/ /drag la mthu rtsal drag ldan pa/ /de mthong nas ni khro bo g.yin/ /thams cad kun gyi lag cha shor/ /zhes sogs 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i rtog pa khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud 'byung zhes bya ba'i skabs te le'u dang po/ yi dwags phal pa'i dkyil 'khor du gtogs pa gnyis pa/ khro bo brtul zhugs su gtogs pa bdun pa/ 'di nas le'u'i nges bzung med pa la/ phyi ma'i yang phyi ma las gshin rje rab tu 'joms pa'i yi ge 'bru gcig pa rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor dgod pa'i rtog par gtogs pa dang po/ de nas rtog pa bzhi pa'i bar mthar chags la/ de nas rtog pa bco lnga par snang mchangs/ de rjes rtog pa bcu drug pa dang sngags dang sngags kyi phan yon las tshogs phyag rgya (264na)bstan pa'i mthar thug pa le grangs ma byas pa rdzogs tshig can/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtsa ba'i rtog pa las/ gsang ba'i rtog par gtogs pa dang po/ de rjes khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa las gsang ba'i rtog par gtogs pa bcu dgu pa/ 'di'i mjug tu rtog pa nyi shu pa/ de rjes rtog pa bzhi pa byas pa/ khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o'i mtha' can/ dpal tshe bdag nag po 'phrin las kyi dgongs pa thams cad rdzogs pa'i rgyud chen po la/ se ston r+ṣa pos/ dgongs rgyud ma phyungs—398—

bcu gnyis pa/ man ngag gsang ba'i las dgu pa'i le'u bcu gsum pa/ 'khor gyis bstod pa so gsum pa/ dbu zhabs su don bsdus pa dang dam bcas pa'i le'u so bzhi pa'o/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gsang ba rgyud kyi rgyal po pra khog (gnubs)snang ba'i rgyud phyi ma'i rgyal po sgrub pa'i lung khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud phyi ma'i yang phyi ma la/ gsung sprul gyis ga༅ yig na bar le rnams ma tshang bas nor ram brtag ces pa 'dug kyang / paṇa chen sku mched kyi gsan yig na le grangs kyi gsal kha ma mdzad cing sngags gsar rnying gi rgyud 'ga' zhig tu 'di rigs yong 'dug pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges/ pra khog bslang ba slad pa snang ba sogs zer kyang kun mkhyen dga' gdong pa'i bka' 'gyur gyi gsan yig na snang ba 'dug cing rang lugs bka' shog rgya bo che na yod/de nas 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis ni/ khro bo'i ming ni gshin rje'i gshed/ /mtshon cha me ltar 'bar ba 'khrigs/ /drag la mthu rtsal drag ldan pa/ /de mthong nas ni khro bo gzhan/ /thams cad kun gyi lag cha shor/ /zhes sogs 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i rtog pa khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud 'byung zhes bya ba'i skabs te le'u dang po/ yi dwags phal pa'i dkyil 'khor du gtogs pa gnyis pa/ khro bo brtul zhugs su gtogs pa bdun pa/ 'di nas le'u'i nges bzung med pa la/ phyi ma'i yang phyi ma las gshin rje rab tu 'joms pa'i yi ge 'bru gcig pa rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor dgod pa'i rtog par gtogs pa dang po/ de nas rtog pa bzhi pa'i bar mthar chags la/ de nas rtog pa bco lnga par mchongs/ de rjes rtog pa bcu drug pa dang sngags dang sngags kyi phan yon las tshogs phyag rgya (264na)bstan pa'i mthar thug pa le grangs ma byas pa rdzogs tshig can/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtsa ba'i rtog pa las/ gsang ba'i rtog par gtogs pa dang po/ de rjes khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa las gsang ba'i rtog par gtogs pa bcu dgu pa/ 'di'i mjug tu rtog pa nyi shu pa/ de rjes rtog pa bzhi pa byas pa/ khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o'i mtha' can/ dpal tshe bdag nag po 'phrin las kyi dgongs pa thams cad rdzogs pa'i rgyud chen po la/ se ston r+ṣa pos/ dgongs rgyud ma phyungs—398—

gyi 'khor lo lnga pa/ 'phrin las rdzogs par brjod pa dgu pa'o/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dgongs don zhes bya ba dgongs pa spyi dril gyi rgyud bal yul gyi rgyal po ba su dha ra dang rdo rje yang dbang gter gyis bha ra sa'i brag phug tu bsgyur ba/ gnod sbyin gdong gsum pa (5)chu thig sngon mo brgyud la/ rin po che sman lung pa sogs kyi gsan yig na chu tig sngon po le'u bco brgyad pa de 'di'i gong du 'os zhes mi gcig pa'i phyogs mdzad/ gsung sprul gyi gsan yig na gcig pa ri(266ba)phyogs dang le'u bco brgyad snang / paṇa chen sku mched kyi gsan yig na gnod sbyin gdong gsum pa'i rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa zhes snang bas gcig pa 'dra'o//'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na sngon gyi dus na byang chub sems dpa'i shing drung rab tu dga' ba'i gnas na bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te bdud dang lha sbyin gyis mu stegs log lta'i sbyor ba byas pa'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyi 'od zer las sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ bsrung ba'i le'u brgyad pa/ zlog pa'i le'u dgu po/ bskul pa pho nya'i le'u bco brgyad pa'o/ /'jam dpal nag po bzlog pa'i rgyud las 'char ka nag po bzlog pa'i rgyud dang / 'chi bdag be was to'i rgyud dang / rā hu nag po rngams byed kyi rgyud dang / gshin rje 'char ka nag po gnod sbyin gdong gsum pa'i rgyud rnams rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can dang 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur zhes snang ngo / /zur gyi mthu byung nas 'gos slob dpon bshal rims kyi bsnyun par bzlog pa'i ched du slar 'di / skad do/ /de'i rgyud phyi ma 'am 'dus rgyud rtog)du grags pa ngan sngags phyir bzlog gi rgyud le'u bdun pa/ 'char ka nag po'i skye rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga lta:)pa rgyal bu sprin gyi shugs can gyis rdo rje gdan gyi 'og nas rnyed pa 'gos kyi thugs dam/ mon pa nag po sku khros pa'i rgyud (6)le'u bcu bzhi pa rgyal bu sprin gyi shugs can gyis bsnams byon pa paṇ+ḍi ta ā tsarla dang lo tsā ba 'gos kyis bsgyur ba/srin po sgo brdung gi rgyud (6)le'u bcu pa/ gdong zor nag po 'am gshin rje sngags khwa'i bzlog gi rgyud le'u bdun pa/ 'joms rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)gsung thugs lhun gyis grub ba zhes sogs bde gshegs dgongs pa 'dus pa bshad pa le'u dang po/bsrung bzlog gsad mnan dbang dbye bral gyi 'khor lo lnga pa/ 'phrin las rdzogs par brjod pa dgu pa'o/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dgongs don zhes bya ba dgongs pa spyi dril gyi rgyud bal yul gyi rgyal po ba su dha ra dang rdo rje yang dbang gter gyis bha ra sa'i brag phug tu bsgyur ba/ gnod sbyin gdong gsum pa (5)chu thig sngon mo brgyud la/ rin po che sman lung pa sogs kyi gsan yig na chu tig sngon po le'u bco brgyad pa de 'di'i gong du 'os zhes mi gcig pa'i phyogs mdzad/ gsung sprul gyi gsan yig na gcig pa ri(266ba)phyogs dang le'u bco brgyad snang / paṇa chen sku mched kyi gsan yig na gnod sbyin gdong gsum pa'i rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa zhes snang bas gcig pa 'dra'o//'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na sngon gyi dus na byang chub sems dpa'i shing drung rab tu dga' ba'i gnas na bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te bdud dang lha sbyin gyis mu stegs log lta'i sbyor ba byas pa'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyi 'od zer las sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ bsrung ba'i le'u brgyad pa/ zlog pa'i le'u dgu po/ bskul pa pho nya'i le'u bco brgyad pa'o/ /'jam dpal nag po bzlog pa'i rgyud las 'char ka nag po bzlog pa'i rgyud dang / 'chi bdag be was to'i rgyud dang / rā hu nag po rngams byed kyi rgyud dang / gshin rje 'char ka nag po gnod sbyin gdong gsum pa'i rgyud rnams rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can dang 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur zhes snang ngo / /zur gyi mthu byung nas 'gos slob dpon bshal rims kyi bsnyun par bzlog pa'i ched du slar 'di bsgrur skad do/ /de'i rgyud phyi ma 'am 'dus rgyud (6)du grags pa ngan sngags phyir bzlog gi rgyud le'u bdun pa/ 'char ka nag po'i skye rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga (6)pa rgyal bu sprin gyi shugs can gyis rdo rje gdan gyi 'og nas rnyed pa 'gos kyi thugs dam/ mon pa nag po sku khros pa'i rgyud (6)le'u bcu bzhi pa rgyal bu sprin gyi shugs can gyis bsnams byon pa paṇ+ḍi ta ā tsarla dang lo tsā ba 'gos kyis bsgyur ba/srin po sgo brdung gi rgyud (6)le'u bcu pa/ gdong zor nag po 'am gshin rje sngags klo'i bzlog gi rgyud le'u bdun pa/ 'joms byed 'bar (6)ba'i rgyud le'u nyi shu pa gnubs (267na)kyis bsgyur ba/—402

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ khongana'aphags pa 'jam dpal ma ru rtse mched bzhi rtsa ba'i sngags rgyud la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na 'og min gyi gnas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog na bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po 'gro ba rnams ji ltar 'dul ba bzhin dgongs nas zhes sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs shing byin gyis brlabs pa sngags kyi le'u lnga pa/ rjes su yi rang ba'i le'u dgu pa'o/ /de'i rgyud phyi ma la/ de nas de'i tshe de'i dus na lha ma yin g.yog 'khor dang bcas nas bcom ldan 'das ya man+ta ga'i thad du 'dus te de dag gi nang du gshin rje'i rgyal pos 'di skad ces gsungs so sogs dbang bskur ba dang 'khor lo'i le'u dang po/ smon lam dang thun dang rjes su yi rang ba bdun pa/ mjug tu dbang phyug chen po yi rangs te bstod pa phyi ma'i phyi ma dang bcas yod pa/ ma ru rtse ro langs gsang ba'i rgyud dpa' bo gar mkhan mchog gi rgyud la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na ri bdun gyi byang phyogs kyi ngos la gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po ma ru rtse zhes bya ba gnas te lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pa thams cad g.yul 'gyed pa sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/sgrub pa dang srog sngags bstan pa bzhi pa/ 'khor lo dkrug pa brgyad pa'o/ /mjug tu bstod pa dang dmyal ba'i las rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ ma ru rtse'i sngags rgyud la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na dpal phyag na rdo rje chos kyi sku las longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs te 'gro ba'i (267ba)don mdzad pa sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ rdzas dang thun dgod pa brgyad pa/ spyi'i ngo bo bstan pa dgu pa/ 'khor rnams rjes su yi rang nas bstod pa bcu bdun pa'o/ /dregs pa pho mo 'dus pa'i rgyud la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo bde ba chen po'i ngang las sprul pa rnam pa gsum byung ba ni zhes sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ gshin rje las la gzud pa brgyad pa/ ma mo las la gzud pa dgu pa/ las mtha' sdud pa bcu bdun pa'o/ /de ltar legs par thob pa'i rtags med yongs rdzogs dang dar gnubs ā'i rtags can —403—

pa/ bal po ba su dha ra/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ soye shes dbang phyug /dan yon tan mchog /ngab thung byang chub rgyal mtshan/ skor thung sangs rgyas shesarab/ rngog ston tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ 'bre gtsug tor gzhen nu/ glan shākya dbang phyug /gnyos chu bo ri pa/ glan rdo rje 'od/ 'gos dge slong / 'gos dngos grub mgon/ bla ma shākya rgyal mas/ rje dpal bzang po/ gu ru rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ gnyal pa bde legs pa gra 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen/ar dge ba chos dpal rgyal mtshan/ me sgom bsam gtan bzang po/ sprul sku rat+na gling pa/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa/ thugs sras ngag dbang grags pa/ mtshungs med ngag dbang nor bu/ (268na)rig 'dzin nor bu yongs grags/ rgyal sras nor bu dbang rgyal/ sprul sku tshul khrims rdo rje/ gar dbang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ gnyos kyi rig 'dzin sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o//dar gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rje nor bu dbang rgyal nas/ bya btang nor bu chos brtan/ rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ de sras gter bdag gling pa/ gong ltar ro/ /'jam dpal zla gsang skor gyi sgos brgyud ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / dpal zla gsang rin chen/ rgyal ba rigs lnga/ dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga/ li tsa byi dri ma med pa/ rgyal po dza/ ku ku rā dza/—404

'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje nas/ 'bri ma grags/ 'dis bsgyur ba'i tshe bdag gi las byang yang yod/ gnubs chos seng / gnubs bkra shis/ gnubs dar ma seng ge /ye shes rgya mtsho/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ gzhon nu tshul khrims/ zur lha chos rje man 'dra/ yang na gnubs chen nas/gter ston rgya zhang khrom/ gnubs lcags gtun nag po/ gnubs stobs chos grags/ gnubs bye bral ba skal ldan rdo rje rgyal po man 'dra/ yang na kun tu bzang po/ gshin rje gshed/ phyag na rdo rje/lha bu tshangs pa/ lha bu nyi ma/ bde ba mchog ldan/ mkha' 'gro ma zla ba'i 'od zer/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ sgro rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ rgyal po ba su dha ra/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston rgya zhad khrom/ dral te sa sto ṭa/ gangs ban bkra shis dar/ rngeg ston 'bum legs/—406

'dra/ yang na gangs ban bkra shis dar (270na)nas/ gangs pa ri dkar ba/ gangs pa shākya 'bum/ g.yung ston rdo rje snying po rtsal/ bag ston shāka mgon man 'dra/ yang na ga kho ston nas/ 'u zangs 'od 'bar/ thang ban sang thub/ thang ston jo rdor/ shus ston ring mo/ thang ston kun dga'/ phag ston jo kun/ phag ston kun don/ phag ston shākya mgon man 'dra/ yang na rdor gling chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas/ gu ru gdung 'dzin/ sgrub pa lha mo/ byang chub rgyal mtshan/ rnal 'byor mgon po/ brag ltag pa rdo rje rin chen/ sngags 'chang zil gnon rdo rje/ chu shur brag ston so legs ldan rdo rje/ mnga' ris rig 'dzin ོ po dang mi r+sāg /dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal man 'dra/ zur dang dha'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gong du smos pa'i nub dgon pa byams pa chos rgyan la dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis gsan pa rnams dang gcig /dha'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rje legs ldan rdo rje la 'bri gung zur pas gsan pa sor bzhag go /ā'i rtags can gyi brgyud lugs gcig dang tshe'i rtags yod pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje gshed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/slob dpon ro langs gsang ba/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba/ slob dpon shākya pra bha/ slob dpon li tsa shad chen/ slob dpon nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rdo rje thogs med/ slob dpon sto ko sha /o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa/ bal po ba su dha ra/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston rgya zhang khrom/ dral te sa sto ṭa/ gangs pa gzhen nu snying po/ gangs pa bal po seng ge /gangs pa ri dkar ba/ gangs pa shākya (270ba)'bum/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal ba/ sngags 'chang dpal ldan bzang po/ zur shākya mi tra/ rgyal sras chos rje/ brgyud 'dzin legs pa dpal bzang /'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ pad+ma dbang rgyal rdo rje/ rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ sngags —407—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 'da'achang tshe ring dbang po/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /pad+ma gsung gi rgyud kyi skor/gnyis pa pad+ma gsung la/ dpal rta mchog rol ba'i rgyud 'a re/chen mo la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na bcom ldan 'das dbang gi rgyal po dus gsum ma lus mi lus lus pa med pa'i ngo bo pad+ma dang rdo rje 'khor lo dang rin po che dang las kyi rigs kyi rang bzhin rigs dang ye shes kyi bdag nyid rol pa'i rdzu 'phrul la mnga' brnyes pa des zhes sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/byang chub kyi sems de kho na nyid kyi le'u gnyis pa/ ma dad pa'i sems can chen po de zhi ba 'dul bar gzigs pas ma thul ba'i le'u gsum pa/ bde bar gshegs pa bgros pa bzhi pa/ hu lu'i don bstan pa brgya dang gnyis pa/ lha dbang bskur ba brgya dang gsum pa/ gsung 'gag pa med pa dbang gi le'u brgya dang bzhi pa/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang brgya dang lnga pa/ gsang ba tshe sgrub pa brgya drug pa/ tshe bskul ba brgya dang bdun pa/ 'jug sgo bstan pa nyis brgya drug pa/ 'khor rnams la chos gnyen po dang gnyis su med pa'i don bstan pa nyis brgya bdun pa/ 'khor rnams bcom ldan 'das dbang gi rgyal pos gsungs pa la yi rang nas bstod pa nyis brgya dang brgyad pa/ yongs su gzung zhing gtad ba'i le'u nyis brgya dgu pa'o/ /lo tsā ba rag (271na〉sho sirnyi dang lce ku ku rā dzas bsgyur/ dbang rgyas rta mchog rol ba'i 'ar)rgyud chen mo la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na bcom ldan 'das phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las gsang ba'i bdag nyid che mchog dbang mchog dam pa zhes sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ lta spyod rnam gnyis kyi le'u gnyis pa/ byang chub sems kyi le'u gsum pa/ tshangs pa dbyangs kyi glu drug gi le'u so gcig pa/ngan song gnas kyi bro so gnyis pa/ rta bro'i le'u so gsum pa/ khrag 'thung rol ba'i bro'i le'u so bzhi —408—

gcig pa'o/ /sgyur byed kyi lo paṇa gong 'dra/dpal pad+ma dbang chen dregs pa 'ar)dbang sdud kyi rgyud la 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus —409

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyang zer/ le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa pad+ma'i thugs dam rtsa ba dbang chen gsang ba 'dusapa'i chos sder gnam skas brag la sbas pa sprul sku rat+na gling pas spyan drangs pa'o/ /phyir bzlog stobs chen rta mgrin gyi rgyud la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na bcom ldan 'das bdud thams cad rdo rje dang 'bor los rnam par 'joms par ting nge 'dzin la ri bo tā la'i spo la khro bo'i rgyal po bdud las rnam par rgyal ba la (273ba)sogs pa dang thabs cig tu snyoms par zhugs te zhes sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ bstod pa'i le'u drug pa'o/ /o rgyan chen po dang 'dan ma tsen mang gi 'gyur/ rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul zhes bya ba'i rgyud la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dusagacig na gdugs pa can gyi gnas rgya mtsho chen po'i slong dkyil klu chen po brgyad kyi gnas sbrul nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang shin tu 'jigs pa'i gnas de na klu'i rje bo ha ya shrī wa dang zhes sogs klu 'dul srog gi snying po phul ba gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ zhus pa dang gleng bslang ba'i le'u gnyis pa/dgug cing brdung ba bco brgyad pa/ klu mchod cing 'phrin las 'chol ba so drug pa/ lung bstan dam bca'i le'u so bdun khyung po dbyug 'od/ khyung po dpal gyi rdor grags/ zhang rgyal ba'i yon tan gsum la bshad/ zhang nas gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ so ye shes dbang phyug /ngab thung byang chub rgyal mtshan/ skor thung shes rab ye shes/ ra thung ye shes tshul khrims/ nyang ye shes mchog /nyang ye shes 'byung gnas/ zur shākya 'byung gnas/ zur chung shes rab grags/ ka bzhi gdung brgyad/ nya ri shāka seng / thag ba'i yang brjod kyis mi lang ba'i 'khor la 'di lta ste zhes sogs gleng gzhi'i le'u dang po/ rnam par dag pa bstan pa lnga pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi sgrub pa le'u dgu pa'o/ /o rgyan gyi mkhan po pad+ma sam bha wa dang lo tsā ba dge slong nam mkha'i snying po'i 'gyur/ nub phyogs o rgyan gyi gnas nas hūṃ kā ras btan no/ /khrag 'thung gal rtod re)po che rgyud lung thams cad kyi rgyal po la/'di skad bdag gi lung du bstan pa'i dus gcig na/ rang snang bkod pa med bkod pa/ 'og min nyams dga' gnas kyi mchog /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs can/ /zhes sogs dam pa'i chos byung khungs kyi brtag pa dang po/ gzhi dmigs par bya ba'i yul rang bzhin 'khor 'das kun sangs rgyas par bstan pa brtag pa gnyis pa/ ru lu spros pa'i brtag pa bcu gnyis pa/ bsam gtan gyi brtag pa nyer gsum pa/ he ru ka gal po chen po zhes bya ba lung thams cad kyi rgyal po gsang ba'i man ngag go /pad+ma sam bha was ba su dha ra la gnang / des sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che la'o/ /dpal he ru ka gal po po'i khro bo rnams dang yang thabs cig tu bzhugs so sogs gleng gzhi gleng bslang dang gsang ba'i 'khor lo zhus pa'i le'u dang po/ sku'i me long bzhi pa/ yongs su gtad pa bdun pa'o/ /lo ma'i rgyud kyi nang tshan rgyud kyi rgyal po ltad re/dpal 'jig rten snang byed la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)snying tig bkol ba'i rgyud la/ de nas 'jigs byed he ru gas/ /snying tig rgyud 'di bzhag pa ste/ /lug pa'i gdong can zhes grags/ bde 'gro'i thun dang gzhi'i snying tig ces sogs srid pa bde 'gro mi'i mthun dang ma gzhi'i snying tig dang srog gi le'u dang po/ sbyin sreg dang mnan pa lnga pa/ ma mo dam tshig bstan pa dgu pa/ byung khungs dha na sang shi ta dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du dgongs pa mdzad pa las/ pa ri ta ga'i khang pa'i nang nas ya mtshan che ba'i dharma 'od kyis bskor ba 'di byung ngo / /(297na)srid pa'i ma mo 'du ba dang / mchod pa dang phyag byed pa byung bas slob dpon la'ang bar chad btang ngo / /de nas slob dpon gyis kyang mchod rten bde byed brtsegs su byon nas ma mo sha khrag gis brid dbang du 'dus par mdzad pa las/ nang pa dro khar ma mo rnams byung bas khyed rang gi srog snying khyer la shog byas pas/ ma mos der 'ongs so/ /de nas ma mo rnams dbang du 'dus so/ /de nas dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du slob dpon gyis sbas pa las btsan po la dgra langs nas blangs so/ /yang tig bkol ba'i rgyud la/ srog smi dang snying tig gi rgyud kyang zer/ de nas ma mo 'dul mdzad pa/ /'jigs byed he ru ka yis ni/ /ma khungs dha na sang shi ta dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du dgongs pa mdzad pa las/ pa ri ta ga'i khang pa'i nang nas ya mtshan che ba'i dharma 'od kyis bskor ba 'di byung ngo / /(297na)srid pa'i ma mo 'du ba dang / mchod pa dang phyag byed pa byung bas slob dpon la'ang bar chad btang ngo / /de nas slob dpon gyis kyang mchod rten bde byed brtsegs su byon nas ma mo sha khrag gis brid dbang du 'dus par mdzad pa las/ nang pa dro khar ma mo rnams byung bas khyed rang gi srog snying khyer la shog byas pas/ ma mos der 'ongs so/ /de nas ma mo rnams dbang du 'dus so/ /de nas dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du byi dri ma med pa/ za gad skya rim pa/ khye'u ma ti chu rgyud/ slob dpon ro langs bde ba/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ bi mā la mi tra/ dha na so: ta/ 'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes/gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra/ rma rin cen mchog /gtsug ru rin cen gzhen nu/ gye re mchog skyong / dar rje dpal gyi grags pa/ zhang rgyal ba yon tan/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ so ye shes dbang phyug /ngab thung byang chub rgyal grags pa/ de gcung ngag dbang grags pa/ rje ngag dbang nor bu/ mtshungs med nor bu yongs grags/ gtsug rgyan nor bu dbang rgyal/ sprul sku tshul khrims rdo rje/—445

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khridagar dbang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang dar gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rje nor bu dbang rgyal nas/ rang grol nor bu chos brtan/ rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag go /yang na sangs rgyas gsang ba nas/ 'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes/ sras zla 'od nyi shar/ khyung po byang chub rgyal mtshan/ gru gu byang chub 'byung gnas/ 'dan ma dbyig gi tshul khrims/ zur tsha dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/zur chen shākya 'byung gnas man gong ltar ro/ /yang na zur chung pa nas/ sras sgro phug pa shākya seng ge /rgya ston blo gros snying po/ ram ston thub pa rdo rje/ 'gos dngos grub rgyal mas man 'dra/ma mo mkha' 'gro spyi 'dus kyi gsang ba'i 'tsho/ budha gup+ta/ badz+ra sirnyi/ sprin gyi shugs can/ pa tshab nyi ma grags/ dpal chen rgya lo/ zhang g.yu brag pa/ rje mi bskyod rdo rje/ bla ma lce sgom pa/gru gu smon lam seng ge rje/ shākya pha la shrī/ shākya mi tra/ sog po dpal ye/ sprul kun bzang dpal/ ka thog pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rnam grol ye shes bzang po/ bla ma chos kyi seng ge /sprul sku chos kyi dbang po/ gu ru rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)bsod nams don grub man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang / sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ ḍā zhi ma skal ba bzang po/slob dpon lwa ba pa/ bzhi la tai lo pas gsan pa man 'dra/pha'i rtags kyi brgyud lugs ni/ rdo rje 'chang / paṇ+ḍita sangs rgyas gsang ba/ lce 'byung gnas bzang po/ gzhubs rgyal ba ye shes/ zhang lo pradzha gu sa zhang sang gha bha dra/ zhang dpal chen 'od po/zhang rdo rje rtse mo/ yod ding ri ba nyi ma 'od/ zhang bstan bzang pa rin chen rnam rgyal/ bsam gling pa sangs rgyas khrung ba/ 'khon ston thugs rje rin chen/ byang sems rin chen mgon po/ gshen nyi ma bshesagar+sā/ rtog ge pa nam mkha' rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po dpal ldan rdo rje/ rin po che chos bzang pa/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ yab rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ lha btsun lha dbang rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /(300na)bdun pa bstan srung mchod bstod drag sngags la/ /dregs pa 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud (zugele'u bcu gcig pa slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam bha dang lo chen be+e ros bsgyur mtshan/ gnyal pa lung gi dbang phyug /'on chos sdings pa 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen/ gra ar dge ba chos dpal rgyal mtshan/ phyam dgon pa bsam gtan bzang po/ rgyal ba'i sras po rat+na gling pa/ thugs sras tshe dbang grags pa/ mtshungs med ngag dbang grags pa/ chos rje ngag dbang nor bu/ btsug rgyan nor bu yongs grags/ chos gter nor bu dbang rgyal/ gsung sprul tshul khrimasardo rje/ gar dbang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /dar gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rje nor bu dbang rgyal nas/ bya btang nor bu chos brtan/ rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na 'gos 'bum grags nas/ pho rog mdo sde mgon po/ zhang zhal dkar ba/ 'gos dngos grub rgyal mtshan man gong ltar ro/ /khra'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gsung sprul nas/ rdo rje 'amang nyang ston blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na khrag 'thung 'jigs byed/ rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po/ phung byed shin+ti gar+bha/ slob dpon pad+ma khrag 'thung / gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho/gnubs ston khro rgyal/ lha rje bdud 'dul/ drag po rngams byed/ ras pa bdud 'dul dbang phyug /zur pa shi shāka 'od/ grub thob hūṃ wo/ sngags la4 khro bo rgyal po/ slob dpon mgon po seng ge /zur hā ma chos rje/ dpal ldan bzang po/ shākya bshes gnyen/ bla ma rgya mtsho/ bla ma drung rgyal ba/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ ka thog pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rnam grol (303na rdzi shes bzang po/ ka thog pa chos kyi seng ge /sprul sku chos kyi dbang po/ gu ru ga rma chos skyong / bla ma bkra shis lhun grub/ nyang ston blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /zur gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum/longs sku rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas/ sprul sku rdo rje chos/ dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti/ rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)mtshan/ sras dge slong / 'gos dngos grub mgon/ bla ma shākya rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal bzang (302ba)pa/ sman rgyal rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ gnyal pa lung gi dbang phyug /'on chos sdings pa 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen/ gra ar dge ba chos dpal rgyal mtshan/ phyam dgon pa bsam gtan bzang po/ rgyal ba'i sras po rat+na gling pa/ thugs sras tshe dbang grags pa/ mtshungs med ngag dbang grags pa/ chos rje ngag dbang nor bu/ btsug rgyan nor bu yongs grags/ chos gter nor bu dbang rgyal/ gsung sprul tshul khrimasardo rje/ gar dbang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /dar gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rje nor bu dbang rgyal nas/ bya btang nor bu chos brtan/ rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ sprul sku gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na 'gos 'bum grags nas/ pho rog mdo sde mgon po/ zhad zhal dkar ba/ 'gos dngos grub rgyal mtshan man gong ltar ro/ /khra'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gsung sprul nas/ rdo rje 'chang nyang ston blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na khrag 'thung 'jigs byed/ rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po/ phung byed shin+ti gar+bha/ slob dpon pad+ma khrag 'thung / gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho/gnubs ston khro rgyal/ lha rje bdud 'dul/ drag po rngams byed/ ras pa bdud 'dul dbang phyug /zur pa shi shāka 'od/ grub thob hūṃ wo/ sngags la4 khro bo rgyal po/ slob dpon mgon po seng ge /zur hā ma chos rje/ dpal ldan bzang po/ shākya bshes gnyen/ bla ma rgya mtsho/ bla ma drung rgyal ba/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ ka thog pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rnam grol (303na rdzi shes bzang po/ ka thog pa chos kyi seng ge /sprul sku chos kyi dbang po/ gu ru ga rma chos skyong / bla ma bkra shis lhun grub/ nyang ston blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /zur gyi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum/longs sku rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas/ sprul sku rdo rje chos/ dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti/ mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo che/ rgya gar gyi rig 'dzin brgyad/ de'i nang nas paṇa chen shan+ti gar+bha/ rom bu gu spo de wa tsan+d+ra/ slob dpon dha na saṃ hū/ kun gyi bcud bsdus pad+ma 'byung gnas te mkhas —452

bsod nams/ yol mo sprul sku shākya bzang po/ rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje/ rgyal sras pad+ma chosargyal/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ snang gsal ba ngag dbang ye grub/ (304ba)zur kun mkhyen chos rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)gsang sngags phyi 'gyur gyi rgyud kyi skor/gnyis pa gsang sngags phyi 'gyur gyi rgyud la/ 'dul mdo sher phyin skor go rim tshal pa bka' 'gyur gyi rjes su 'brangs pa yin na'ang rgyud 'bum gyi brgyud pa phal cher ngor lugs shas che zhing /sngon chad rgyud rnam par ma dag pa mang du 'dres pa rnams snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches dag ther mdzad pas de nyid kyi dkar chag khungs btsun par snang zhing / kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa dang rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs gnyis kyang de'i rjes su 'jug par mdzad pa sogs nas yid brtan du bzung ste bkod par/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ bya ba'i rgyud dang bzhi/ dang po la gnyis (305ba)su med pa'i rgyud/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa r+ṣa po gnyis med kyi rgyud logs su mi bar kyang da lam bu ston rje'i dkar ma gagatso bor byas pa yin no/ shes rab rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud/ thabs rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud dang gsum/ dang po ni/ ka pa la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las byung ba rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dum bu dbang mdor bstan zhes bya ba kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta so ma nā tha dang 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags kyis bsgyur ba dus phyis 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu shong ston lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis dag par bcos pa/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i bsdus pa'i rgyud le'u lnga pa paṇ+ḍi ta so ma nā tha dang lo tsā ba 'bro lo shes rab grags kyis bsgyur ba las dus phyis 'jam mgon sa skya paṇa chen gyi mtha' ma'i gsung bzhin chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bdag rkyen la brten nas shong lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pa/ slar yang lo tsā ba blo gros rgyal mtshan dang blo gros dpal gnyis kyis rgyud dang 'grel ba'i rgya dpe mang po la gtugs nas dag par bcos pa/deng sang grags che'ang ha cang zhe sa mi dgos par ma nges pas shong 'gyur rang bzang zhes mkhas pa rnams gsung / 'di la spyir —456

rje bka' 'gyur ba'i bar sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor bzhin las/ zur rtsa ba'i bla ma/ des bdag la'o/ /nges brjod bla ma'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rje bka' 'gyur ba nas/ rab 'byams chos rje/ khyab bdag khra mo mngon par byung ba zhes bya ba'i bshad pa'i rgyud rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nyā na ka ra'i zhal snga nas dang zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba khu ston dngos grub kyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la dkyil 'khor gsum yod/brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / dz+nyā na ḍā gi /tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta/ me ñdza gling pa thugs rje chen po/rwa lo rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa dharma seng ge /rwa dkon mchog seng ge /rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/glo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon po/ dar ma bzang po/ grags chen pa/ spang khang pa/ sa bzang ma ti man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang gcig /yang na rdo rje 'chang / dz+nyā na ḍā gi /bi —464—

gsan yig phyi ma tshor brtag gnyis dang brgyud pa gcig par mdzad kyang ngor chen gyi gsan yig na dbye ba 'di ltar phye 'dug cing rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig nas stong zhig bzhag 'dug pas brgyud pa zur lo tsā ba/ rje btsun yab sras/ chos rje khu dbon/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ blo chen (316ba)sangs rgyas sras/ lha sdings pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ gangs khrod pa grags pa dpal/sa bzang paṇa chen man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang gcig /yang na blo chen pa nas/ bag ston gnyon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul rgyal ba dpal ldan chos she/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ ri khrod pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ yongs 'dzin dkon cog 'phel man bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra/ yang na ba ri lo tsā ba nas/ sum pa lo tsā ba/ bum lnga lo tsā ba/ ko nag ral gri grags seng ge /khang ston pa man gong ltar ro/ /yang na khang ston pa nas/ dkon cog ye shes/dkon cog bla ma/ bag ston man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che nas/ rgya lo yab sras gnyis/bag ston man gong bzhin no/ /yang na ba ri ba nas/ mchims brtson 'grus seng ge /mchims don ne/mchims blo gros brtan pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan man 'dra/yang na rdo rje 'chang / seng ge rtsal/ ḍom+bhi pa/ gser gling pa/ dharma kirti/ jo bo chen po a ti sha /'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ sne'u zur pa/ bya yul ba gzhon nu 'od/ bal po puṇ+ḍa sidha/ mgon po gragasapa/ dbang phyug mgon po/ sangs 'bum/ lo mchog pa/ blo chen man 'dra/ brgyud pa 'di la thar rtse/ sgrub khang /shar pa/ rje bka' 'gyur ba bzhi'i gsan yig na phyag na rdo rje'i brgyud pa dang 'dres pa'i yig skyon shor 'dug /'di ni gong dkar ba —472

'dra/ yang na sa paṇa nas/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyan/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bdag po kun dga' rin chen/ bla ma rdo rje rin chen/ zur shākya mi tra/ man 'dra/ yang na rdo rje 'chang / badz+ra pā ṇi/ sar ha/ mgon po klu sgrub/ ma snya gi pa/ bi khyu ta de wa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ su ga ta shrī/ rje sa paṇa man gong dang 'dra/ yang na kun bzang / rgyal ba rigs lnga/ phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ za hor rgyal po pra hasti/ slob dpon pad+ma man 'dra/ yang na gsang ba'i bdag po/ dam pa'i gas can dra ma lnga/ ku ku rā dza/ rgyal po dza/ in+d+ra bhū ti man gong dang 'dra/ nag po chen po mgon po mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po le'u lnga bcu pa paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī dang rwa chos rab kyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la mngon rtogs kyi phye na dkyil 'khor drug tu 'gyur ro/ /brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ klu sgrub/ pen pa che ba/ chung ba/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pra dz+nyā rak+ṣi ta/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ mañdzu kirti/ sa man+ta shrī bha dra/ rwa chos —476

khyu ta de wa/ kha che paṇa chen/ su ga ta shrī/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta/ skyobs pa dpal/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug /lo mchog pa (321na sgos chen pa/ rgyal bzang dpal/ gangs khrod pa/ ma ti man nga yand ma thag pa dang 'dra/ 'di'i 'og tu 'phags pa gnyis med rnam rgyal brtag pa nyer gnyis pa bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas bsgyur ba 'di la lung rgyun med kyang gnyis med rnam rgyal le'u don bdun pa de brdzus ma yin par shes pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /mi bskyod pa'i rigs su gtogs pa khro bo phyag na rdo rje'i skor la/ nya par gos sngon gosasngon can drag po rnam gsum 'joms pa zhes bya ba slar 'tshol rgyu zhes gsan yig na 'dug pas rgyun med/ can gyi bshad rgyud drag po gsum 'dul zhes bya ba le'u gsum pa paṇ+ḍi ta de wa puṇ+ḍa ma ti dang 'gyur chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba/ 'di la dza wa ris dkyil 'khor bzhir bkral lo/ /brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma sidha mu kha/ sa wa ri pa/ dza wa ri pa/ de wa pu rna ma ti/ 'gar lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po/ gshen rin chen dngos grub/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dmar shes rab rdo rje/ 'di man gyi bla ma gsum ngor phyogs kyi gsan yig snga phyi tshor go kyang rje mkhyen brtse'i ngor snang ngo / /dmar thub pa shes rab/ dmar brtson 'grus rdo rje/dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ gan chag pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ 'dzims pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang /kun spangs chos grags dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang gcig rdo rje gdengs pa'i rgyud khams gsum rnam par (321ba)rgyal ba'i le'u paṇ+ḍi ta a ṭa ma shrī ma ti dang lo tsā ba chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur ba/ 'di le'u gcig logs su phyung bar snang zhing dkyil phyung pa/ 'byo sgom/ zangs ri rgya ras/ rlung ring / rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig 'di ltar snang zhing ngor phyogs kyi gsan yig na gcig tu mdzad 'dug go/'bum —480

chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dmar shes rab rdo rje/ 'di man gyi bla ma gsum ngor phyogs kyi gsan yig snga phyi tshor go kyang rje mkhyen brtse'i ngor snang ngo / /dmar thub pa shes rab/ dmar brtson 'grus rdo rje/dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ gan chag pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ 'dzims pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang /kun spangs chos grags dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang gcig /'phagasapa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi cho ga rdo rje be con can gyi rgyud le'u bco lnga pa/ 'di la dkyil 'khor gcig go /de'i bshad rgyud/ yan lag gi rgyud phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can rdo rje gdengs pa'i rgyud khams gsum rnam par (321ba)rgyal ba'i le'u paṇ+ḍi ta a ṭa ma shrī ma ti dang lo tsā ba chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur ba/ 'di le'u gcig logs su phyung bar snang zhing dkyil 'khor zur tsam zhig bstan no/ /gong gsal gnyis ga'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ ye shes dbang phyug /las kyi rdo rje/ thang lo pa/ shing lo pa/ ga rje ri pa/ wa la tsan+d+ra/ ras phyung pa/ 'byo sgom/ zangs ri rgya ras/ rlung ring / rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig 'di ltar snang zhing ngor phyogs kyi gsan yig na gcig tu mdzad 'dug go/'bum —480

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ (nge/grags/ shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bya rin chen 'od/ slo chen pa/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ spang khang pa/ sa bzang po man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor sor bzhag go /yang na glo chen pa nas/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon po/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ gar thig pa bsod rgyan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ mkhan chen grags rdor ba/ rje grags don pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/rdo rje gdan pa/ rngog shes rab grags/ khams pa sman chu ba brag po che/ thugs sras kun dga' rgya mtsho/rngog dpal 'byor don grub/ chog ston 'jam dbyangs 'od zer/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rab stims chas rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ rje blo gros mchog gi rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /'di'i rjes su gtum po gsang rgyud phyi ma phyi ma'i phyi ma dang bcas pa/ rmi lam mthong ba zhes bya ba rnams 'dug kyang lung ma rnyed do/ /gos sngon can gnod sbyin drag po chen po me lce'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa/ le'u bcu gnyis pa gzhir snang zhing lung yang ma thob bo/ /gnyis pa rnam snang gi rigs su gtags pa'i rgyud la/'phags pa sgyu 'phrul dra ba stong phrag drug cu pa las ting nge 'dzin dra ba'i le'u logs su phyung ba 'jam bkral/brgyud pa ni/ dang po'i sangs rgyas/ rigs ldan sum cu rtsa gnyis/ seng ge rnam par rgyal ba/ dus zhabs pa che chung / rgyal sras nā las pa/ paṇa chen zla ba mgon po/ 'bro lo tsā ba/ brab sgom dkon cog bsrung / sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ yu mo mi bskyod rdo rje/ sras chos kyi dbang phyug /mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od/ se mo che ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam gsar shes rab 'od/ bo dong rin chen rtse mo/ 'dzims pa rin chen shes rab/ 'dzims pa blo chen sangs rgyas sras/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/—481 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)spang khang gangs khrod pa/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ ri khrod pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ bya 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge /rje rdo rje (322ba)rgyal mtshan/ ru thog pa mnga' risabla chen/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mchod dpon kun dga' legs pa/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na 'jam gsar ba nas/ chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ mkhas grub yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen dol bu ba/ ma ti paṇa chen man gong dang 'dra/ yang na 'jam dbyangs/ slob dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ nā ro pa/ slob dpon shes rab bzang po/ rab tu gsang ba/ paṇ+ḍita su badz+ra/ lo tsā ba shes dkar chos kyi shes rab/ skal byang chub blo gros/ 'gar ston rdo rje snying po/ nyang stod lce 'bar/ lo mchog pa/ skya gzhod pa/ lug mgo ba/ rkyang po grags dar/ khro ston kun dga' 'od zer/ mkhan chen chos rin chen/ bla ma chos sku 'od zer/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ shes rab rgyal mtshan/ ma ti paṇa chen man gong ltar ro/ /yang na mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje yan gong ltar la/ de nas rje dkon cog 'phel man dbang mdor bstan dang gcig /yang na mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje nas/ rwa chen yon tan dpal/glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ yang na bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge /dbang po'i gtsug rgyan/ pad+ma'i rje/ mkhas pa'i rje/ sangs rgyas ye shes legs (323na〉skyes/ bkra shis blo brtan/ phyogs kyi thar pa/ chos kyi bsrung ba/ ye shes rgya mtsho/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ srid pa'i gsung gcig /grags po'i rdo rje/chos kyi grags pa/ sangs rgyas dbyangs/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta shrī wā na rat+na/ rgya gar shar phyogs pa nags kyi rin cen/byang pa rigs ldan chen po rnam rgyal grags pa bzang po/ shangs ston kun dga' dpal ldan/ ru thog —482

'dra/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa paṇ+ḍita bha ro phyag jum dang rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/ gong dkar ba'i gsan mig na rwa chos rab kyis bsgyur zhes snang ba yig skyon yin nam brtag /'di la dngos su dkyil 'khor gcig /paṇ+ḍita 'gas gsum du dgongs pa bkral (324na)lo/ /'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa gsum pa dang / rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na 'di nyid o ḍi ya shrī dang rong zom gyis bsgyur zhes snang ngo / /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi rgyal po'i las dngos grub kyi rtog pa zhes bya ba rtog pa bzhi par grags pa gnyis paṇ+ḍita a mo gha dang mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur la/ slad kyi grub thob chen po sa rje shrī zhal snga nas dang nyang stod thar los bcos pa/ gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa gcig pa dang / las mkhan te'u lo pa chu byi'i rtog pa gnyis bha ro phyag rdum gyis 'bum pa la gtugs te rgya dpe las bsgyur ba/ de rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ la lī ta badz+ra/ ye 'byung sbas pa/pad+ma badz+ra/ bal po bha ro/ rje bun rwa chen/ rwa lo chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge /rwa 'bum seng / rgya lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ de sras shes rab seng ge /bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang / rgya lo gnyis pa dge ba rgyal mtshan/ gra thang pa shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /de la mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ de nas rigs kun bdag po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang rtog bdun dang rtog gsum gnyis kyi brgyud (324ba)lugs gcig ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/dz+nyā na ḍā ki /la khyi ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra che chung gnyis/ skyo 'od 'byung / skyo 'jam dpal/ skyo pad+ma/ skyo khams pa/ gnyan rin chen brtan pa/ gnyan 'od srungs/ gnyan chas rgyal/ glo chen sangs rgyas sras/mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ spang khang pa/ ma ti paṇa chen man dbang mdor bstan dang gcig /yang —484

kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur la/ slad kyi grub thob chen po sa rje shrī zhal snga nas dang nyang stod thar los bcos pa/ gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa gcig pa dang / las mkhan te'u lo pa chu byi'i rtog pa gnyis bha ro phyag rdum gyis 'bum pa la gtugs te rgya dpe las bsgyur ba/ de rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ la lī ta badz+ra/ ye 'byung sbas pa/pad+ma badz+ra/ bal po bha ro/ rje bun rwa chen/ rwa lo chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge /rwa 'bum seng / rgya lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ de sras shes rab seng ge /bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang / rgya lo gnyis pa dge ba rgyal mtshan/ gra thang pa shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /de la mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka la rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ de nas rigs kun bdag po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /yang rtog bdun dang rtog gsum gnyis kyi brgyud (324ba)lugs gcig ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/dz+nyā na ḍā ki /la khyi ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra che chung gnyis/ skyo 'od 'byung / skyo 'jam dpal/ skyo pad+ma/ skyo khams pa/ gnyan rin chen brtan pa/ gnyan 'od srungs/ gnyan chos rgyal/ glo chen sangs rgyas sras/mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ spang khang pa/ ma ti paṇa chen man dbang mdor bstan dang gcig /yang —484

dam pa'i chos kyi gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa/ khonganan skyo 'od 'byung / gtsang yang dag 'bar/ gtsang yang dag rdo rje/ rngog rdo rje rgyal po/ gze pa don grub ye shes/ khams pa shākya rdo rje/ sras chos grags/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo mchog pa/ glo chen pa man bshad ma thag pa ltar ro/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i 'khor lo las thams cad sgrub par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po sdom tshig gsum gyis bsdus pa paṇ+ḍi ta bha ro phyag sdum dang rwa lo rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig na yig skyon yin nam rwa chos rab kyis bsgyur zhes snang / 'di la dngos su dkyil 'khor gcig yod/ bla ma dag gsum du mdzad do/ /brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang 'jam dpal/ burnya dz+nyā na/ ngor phyogs kyi gsan yig na dz+nyā na badz+ra shrī zhes snang ba 'di dang gcig gam brtag /di pa dhi pā ya/ la lī ta badz+ra/ so su ra pa/ she na pa/ a ba li na pa/ gu ṇa bha dra/ wā gī shwa ra kirti/ de wa ka ra tsan+d+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ shad lo tsā ba pradz+nyā gu sa sras saṃ gha bha dra/ zhang gtsang 'od po che/ gcen/ zhang rdo rje rtse mo/gceng / zhang rtsi ba ri ba nyi ma 'od/ ding ri ba zhes pa'ang snang / bstan bzang pa rin chen rnam rgyal/ zhang g.yul las rnam rgyal byang chub/ 'dzims pa rin chen shes rab (325na)bla ma sangs rgyas bzang po/ glo chen po/ gnyis ka la mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal gyis gsan/ de nas spang khang pa/ sa bzang paṇa chen man dbang mdor bstan gyi brgyud tshul sngon ma dang gcig /yang na rdo rje 'chang / ḍā ki ma/ tai lo pa/nā ro pa/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta/ me lja gling pa/ rwa chen rdo rje grags/ de dbon chos rab/ de sras dharma seng ge /rwa dkon cog seng ge /rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ khams pa byang chub dpal/ lo mchog pa/ blo chen pa man bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra/ dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u bcu dgu pa paṇ+ḍita rā hu la shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba shong blo gros brtan pas bsgyur/ gzhan yang dge slong tsan+d+ra shrī zhal snga nas kyis zhus shing paṇ+ḍi ta tsan+d+ra kirti dang yar klungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis yam bu'i grong khyer du bsgyur ba/ 'di la dkyil 'khor bcu yod/ brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje gshed/ bram ze'i dpal 'dzin/ bi ra ḍi pa/ ga sdi ra ma ti/ ni ska lo ka de wa/ re wen+t+ra pra bha/ chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/bla ma dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ klog skya pa/ don ri ba grags pa dpal/ spang khang pa grags pa dpal/—485—

/rwa dkon cog seng ge /rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ khams pa byang chub dpal/ lo mchog pa/ blo chen pa man bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra/ dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u bcu dgu pa paṇ+ḍita rā hu la shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba shong blo gros brtan pas bsgyur/ gzhan yang dge slong tsan+d+ra shrī zhal snga nas kyis zhus shing paṇ+ḍi ta tsan+d+ra kirti dang yar rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khrinas bzang ma ti paṇa chen man dbang mdor bstan gyi brgyud pa sngon ma sor bzhag go /'di'i 'og tu tshod dmar gyi rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa thams cad kyi mkhyen pa bu ston gyis 'gyur mdzad pa zhig 'dug kyang lung rgyun ma rnyed do/ /gsum pa rin po che rigs kyi rgyud ni ma rnyed do/ /bzhi pa pad+ma rigs kyi rgyud ni/ bcom ldan 'das (325ba)ral pa gcig pa'i rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po paṇ+ḍi ta shrī dza ga ta mi tra ā nan+da bka' drin las rje btsun de nyid kyi thugs kyi sras rgya gar nub phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī kha la ru tra dang khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la dngos su dkyil 'khor gcig gsal/ mi pham sbas pa'i bshes gnyen gyis gnyis su bkral lo/ /brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ jo bo khar+sā pā ṇi/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ tai lo pa/ ni ska lo ka shrī/ grub chen mi tra dzo gi /khro lo gnubs byams pa'i dpal/ bla ma dpon ston pa/ yang rtse bar rin chen seng ge /thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ khyung lhas pa gzhen nu bsod nams/ bla ma rin chen don grub legs pa/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ dka' bzhi ba rin chen mchog grub dpal 'bar/ rgyal yum tshul khrims bzang mo/ mnga' ris gter chen chos kyi rgyal po legs ldan rdo rje/ bla ma o rgyan rgyal po/paṇa chen kun dga' bkra shis/ rab 'byams chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag blo gros mchog gi rdo rje/ des bdag za hor ban+de la'o/ /lnga pa las kyi rigs kyi rgyud ni ma rnyed do/ /drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi rigs kyi rgyud la/ zla gsang thig le'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po shin tu dgyes pa rdo rje gdon mi za ba'i dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor chen po rgyas pa mchog tu gsang ba'i rgyud lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ 'di la dkyil 'khor lnga yod do/ /brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor sor bzhag go /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la/ thabs (326na)gtso bo ston pa dang / shes rab gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud gnyis/ dang po la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ 'phros pa'am cha mthun gyi rgyud dang gsum/ dang po ni/ ta pa la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa zhes bya ba rigs lnga rigs bzhir bsdus pa zhes bya ba rigs lnga rigs bzhir bsdus nas mnyam par ston pa rtsa —486

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ slong)rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ de'i slob ma lnga ni/ pad dkar ye shes/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ nyi ma'i snying po/ rgyal rigs sa ra ha dang lnga/ de lnga ga la slob dpon kun dga' snying pos gsan/de nas ta thā ga ta badz+ra/ grwa d+dha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa paṇ+ḍita/ 'phags pa rin po che/ glo chen sangs rgyas man de nyid bsdus pa bzhin no/ /yang na (327na)rtsa rgyud de nyid bsdus pa'i brgyud pa yongs rdzogs kyang drangs chog go /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa rma lo tsā ba rin chen mchog gis bsgyur ba/ 'di la dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa drug yod/ 'di dum bu gnyis pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje'i rigs gtso bor ston pa'o/ brgyud pa ni/rtsa skya shāka 'bum yan rtsa rgyud de nyid bsdus pa dang 'dra ba las/ 'dzims pa rin chen bshes gnyen/slo chen pa/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ rdor gling pa mgon po 'bum/ ri phug pa bram nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang ma ti man rtsa rgyud dang gcig /gsum pa cha mthun gyi rgyud ni/ dum bu gnyis pa'i ngan song dgug cing sdig pa bral ba las 'phros pa'i rgyud dam cha mthun pa'i rgyud ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī n+ti gar+bha dang lo tsā ba ban+de dza ya rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba/ slar ā tsarla rin chen mchog gis skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos te gtan la phab bo/ /'di la dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis yod/ rgyud 'di'i zhabs na mngon spyod kyi las lo paṇa bshad ma thag pas bsgyur ba snang / brgyud pa ni/ shākya'i rgyal po/ phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ rab 'byor bskyangs/kun dga' snying po/ shes rab bskyang / zhi ba snying po/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ dad byed go cha/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mar lo tsā ba/ rje btsun sa chen/ gnyags ston dbang rgyal/ rje btsun (327ba)grags pa/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa blo brtan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / yongs 'dzin dkon chog 'phel/ rje lha —488—

po/ rgyal rigs sa ra ha dang lnga/ de lnga ga la slob dpon kun dga' snying pos gsan/de nas ta thā ga ta badz+ra/ grwa d+dha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa paṇ+ḍita/ 'phags pa rin po che/ glo chen sangs rgyas man de nyid bsdus pa bzhin no/ /yang na (327na)rtsa rgyud de nyid bsdus pa'i brgyud pa yongs rdzogs kyang drangs chog go /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa rma lo tsā ba rin chen mchog gis bsgyur ba/ 'di la dkyil 'khor pa'i ngan song dgug cing sdig pa bral ba las 'phros pa'i rgyud dam cha mthun pa'i rgyud ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī n+ti gar+bha spyod kyi las lo paṇa bshad ma thag pas bsgyur ba snang / brgyud pa ni/ shākya'i rgyal po/ phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ rab 'byor bskyangs/kun dga' snying po/ shes rab bskyang / zhi ba snying dbang / yongs 'dzin dkon chog 'phel/ rje lha —488—

khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs skyed pa khwa)/ be+eḍūr+ya'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍita (333na)dzi na mi tra/ 'di man la rtags yod kyang sgo brgyud drangs pa dang bsgos brgyud med par spyi brgyud kyi go bcad sogs sna tshogs yod pa zhib mos dpyod/ dwa na shī la/ su ren+d+ra bodhi/ ban+de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa las phyis paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o/ /sman la lta lhan(dhi)(6)sngags kyis gdab pa/ 'di nyid sman bla'i snying po logs su phyung ba yin pas rgyud tha dad du mi bgrang ngo / /nor bu zab mo rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab lta'i)yo bun(6)tu gnas pa gsang ba dam pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po le'u bdun pa paṇ+ḍi ta bi du ka ra pra bha wa dang lo tsā ba dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur ba la skad kyi paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/ 'di'i sgos brgyud ni/ rje rdo rje gdan pa yan sman mdo'i brgyud tshul dang po ltar la/ de nas rig pa'i slog 'phreng / bstan pa rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang chos rgyal/ ngag dbang grogs rgyan/ ngag dbang nor bu/ ngag dbang bzang po/ kun dga' blo gros/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ rab snams chas rje/ khra tshang pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog ces bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta bi sdi ka ra pra bha wa dang lo tsā ba —496

'gyur yod par 'dug pas btsal bar bya'o//gsang ba ring bsrel dang byang chub rgyan 'bum gnyis kyi brgyud pa 333ba ) ni/sangs rgyas/phyag na rdo rje/dze tā ri/rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ba ri lo tsā ba/sa r+ṣa kun dga' snying po/slob dpon rin po che/rje bas rin po che/chosarje sa paṇ+ḍita/'phags pa rin po che/rgya lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/sras shes rab seng ge/bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/bla ma mgon po 'bum/spu ston bsod rgyal/mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/chos sgo ba chos she/slob dpon bsod seng /dbus gling grags don pa/rat+na kirti/bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/rgya gzhon tshul/ mgon po 'bum/ spu ston/ mkhan chen sher rdor/chos dpal shes rab/ bsod nams seng ge /grags don pa/ rat+na kirti/ bka' 'gyur ba/ rdo rje gdan pa/ chen po jo rgyan/ 'bum ram pa man rten 'brel snying po'i brgyud pa dang gcig /yang na sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ gong ma lnga/ rga lo yab sras/bag ston pa man gong ltar ro/ /yang na chos thams 'di'i rjes su sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa'i mas brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang yos pa ma rnyed do/ /cad kyi yon to bkod pa'i rgyal po'i gzungs rgyud yongs rdzogs ltar ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan khwa)sgo ge(phe)kho ) brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'di gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gzungs chen po zhig yod par bshad pa las phyung ba yin pa 'dra ste 'di nyid las gzhan gyis mi thub gzungs gsan nas zhes gsungs pas so/ shwakya thub pa'i snying po'i lta'i)sgo sdi)(phe)gzungs/ 'phags pa rnam khwa)po ce/'a)par snang mdzad kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'di'i 'og tu snang ba mtha' yas rjes su dran pa'i gzungs ga kyang pad+ma'i rigs kyi skabs yod pas 'dabs par mja/ zla 'od kyi mtshan rjes su (zhi)(khu)'a)dran pa'i gzungs 'gyur gong 'dra/ de bzhin gshegs 6)(/ du lo3)pa (336na skyo'i snying po rjes su dran pa'i gzungs 'gyur gong 'dra/ sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug shwe)sgo du/'a)tor can gyi mas rjes su dran pa'i gzungs 'gyur gong 'dra/ mar pa'i sprin gyi 6)'a)gzungs/ 'di'i sgos brgyud ni/sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri ba/ sum pa lo tsā ba/ 'bum lnga lo tsā ba/ ko nag pa/ grags seng / zhang ston yab sras/ dkon mchog ye shes/ dkon mchog bla ma/ bag ston pa/ mgon po 'bum/ rje chos dpal shes rab/ grags rdor ba/ grags don pa man rten 'brel snying po'i brgyud pa rje sman lung pa bzhugs pa dang gcig /yang na rdo rje gdan pa gsum nas/ puṣ+ṭha shrī/steng lo/ so kun mkhyen/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ ko nag pa/ jo stan zas gtsang /—500
