ro/ /yang na rdo rje 'cha / phyag rdor/ sar ha/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ dad byed go cha/ lo chen pa/ rkyang po chos blo/ bra'o lha 'bum/ bra'o chos tshul/ bra'o mi mnyam rdo rje/ thang ston ye rdor/ zhang byang chub/ glo chen pa/ seng rgyan pa/ gar thig pa/ sher rdor ba/ chos dpal shes rab/ grags rdor ba/ grags don pa man bshad ma thag pa bzhin no/ /phyag dang bstod pa dang mchod pa la lta zhin(khu)rtod)sogs pa'i gzungs/ 'di'i rjes su pad+ma'i spyan zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'dug pa ma thob/ su rū pa'i ḍūr)gzungs/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad shwe)sgo ce)lda)las sgrol ba'i gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgyad pa/ gong gsal gnyis kyi sngon ma'i (336na)sgos brgyud dang phyi ma'i brgyud pa ni/gsang ba ring bsrel gyi brgyud tshul gsum po sor bzhag go /khyad par can 6)sgo bye)'a)gyi gzungs/'di la rgya gar na sprul lo stag lung du/ bi kra ma la shrī la'i paṇ+ḍita maṅga lo shrī dz+nyā phyag bris gzungs 'dus kyi rgya dpe 'dug pa na nā ga bste zhes rgyud kyi gleng gzhi'i rgya dpe na snang ba rgya dpe tshad ma 'dug /ces gsan yig rgya mtshor snang ba nā ga klu la la jug pa grangs kyi brgyad du byas te thub pa sangs rgyas nas lo brgyad pa la gsungs pa lo tsā bas sprul lor bsgyur zhes chag lo gsum pa bzhed cing rgya gar shar phyogs rgya nag dang nye ba'i mi rnams lo skor bcu gnyis kyi rnam gzhag byed ces thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa gsung ngo / /la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag med pa la de'i rnam gzhag byas pas the tshom gyi gzhi gcig tu snang mod kyi/ rat+na rak+ṣi tas mdzad zer ba'i gzungs spyi'i cho ga kun snang gsal ba las/ 'jam dbyangs gzhen nus gsungs pa yi/ khyad par can gyi gzungs la bstod/ /ces 'dug go /gnyis pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bdag po 'khor lo sgyur ba la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i rtog pa sum cu rtsa drug pa paṇ+ḍi ta gzhon nu 'bum pa dang lo tsā ba shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la dkyil 'khor gsum yod/ brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ rab gsal zla ba/ bram ze rā hu la/ su ste pha la/ dz+nyā na badz+ra/ pradz+nyā sirnyi/ ā nan+da gar+bha/ pra bhū ti pū la/ pra dz+nyā wa li ta/ngor chen gyi gsan yig sogs phal cher na rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na snang ngo / zhes gar+bha/ ka phywa na mi tra/ su kha badz+ra/—501 —

gar na sprul lo stag lung du/ bi kra ma la shrī la'i paṇ+ḍita maṅga lo shrī dz+nyā phyag bris gzungs 'dus kyi rgya dpe 'dug pa na nā ga bste zhes rgyud kyi gleng gzhi'i rgya dpe na snang ba rgya dpe tshad ma 'dug /ces gsan yig rgya mtshor snang ba nā ga klu la la jug pa grangs kyi brgyad du byas te thub pa sangs rgyas nas lo brgyad pa la gsungs pa lo tsā bas sprul lor bsgyur zhes chag lo gsum pa bzhed cing rgya gar shar phyogs rgya nag dang nye ba'i mi rnams lo skor bcu gnyis kyi rnam gzhag byed ces thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa gsung ngo / /la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag med pa la de'i rnam gzhag byas pas the tshom gyi gzhi gcig tu snang mod kyi/ rat+na rak+ṣi tas mdzad zer ba'i gzungs spyi'i cho ga kun snang gsal ba las/ 'jam dbyangs gzhen nus gsungs pa yi/ khyad par can gyi gzungs la bstod/ /ces 'dug go /gnyis pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bdag po 'khor lo sgyur ba la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i rtog pa sum cu rtsa drug pa paṇ+ḍi ta gzhon nu 'bum pa dang lo tsā ba shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la dkyil 'khor gsum yod/ brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ rab gsal zla ba/ bram ze rā hu la/ su ste pha la/ dz+nyā na badz+ra/ pradz+nyā sirnyi/ ā nan+da gar+bha/ pra bhū ti pū la/ pra dz+nyā wa li ta/ngor chen gyi gsan yig sogs phal cher na rje mkhyen brtse'i gsan yig na snang ngo / zhes gar+bha/ ka phywa na mi tra/ su kha badz+ra/—501 —

sngags kyi rgyal mo so sor 'brang ma zhes bya ba :sto ka bzhi brgya dang bzhi bcu pa paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang dā na shī la/ lo tsā ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo bsil ba'i gi rgyud rdzogs so/ /zhes dang / de ma thag oṃ a kro te ka sogs nas khro bo rnam par rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed kyi rtog pa phyi ma'i yang phyi ma gsang ba'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa rdzogs so dang skabs dang rim par phye ba dang le'u sogs ming sna tshogs yod pa bcu bdun pa gnyis 'dabs pa'i bar dang / de nas ma mi mā mi sogs nas khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa las gsang ba'i rtog pa ste dang po zhes sogs nas rtog pa bzhi pa'i bar dang / lnga pa'i tshab tu rjes su yi rang ba'i le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ /zhes sngon ma'i mjug yin rgyu ba zhig nas khro bo khams gsum rnam par —5/0

rgyan/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ko nag pa/ shangs pa grags seng / zhad kun dga' 'bum/ phag khur pa dkon ye/ bag ston man 'dra/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can (zhi)sgo du)'a)( 5 )gyis zhus pa'i gzungs/ gza' yum 'gyur rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)rgyas 'bum man gong ltar ro/ /yang na sgrol ma/ ḍā gi so ma pra bha/ shrī ā warta/ bram ze dharma shrī/ 'gar lo tsā ba chos bzang man 'dra/ yang na 'gor lo tsā ba nas/ gshen rin chen dngos grub/ dmar (353ba)chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ snang ston yab sras/ khu ston shes rab 'bum/ gru rdo rje seng ge /rong pa chos mgon/ lo mchog pa man 'dra/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i mdo/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma/ klu sgrub/ ba kla ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ mar me mdzad/ shrī su kha/ bi mā la gup+ta/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ban+de pa chen po/ gnyan lo dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje sa paṇa/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/dka' bzhi pa grags pa ga'o rna nu/ mkhan bsod nams grags pa/ mkhan grags pa tshul khrims/thog ston shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan chen rgyal bzang pa/ mkhan byang chub seng ge shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ drin chen bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na dkon mchog 'phel nas/ lha mchog seng ge /dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen nas/ gu ge paṇa chen/ glo bo legs 'byung /'jam dbyangs sa lo/ dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na lha mchog seng ge nas/ sangs rgyasaseng ge /thar rtse pa man 'dra/yang rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa sgrol ma mchog ces bya ba'i gzungs cho ga dang bcas pa 'phags pa gzungs 'a mo yo zer/'phags ma sgrol (354na〉pa'i gzungs/ sgrol ma rang gis dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ gong gsal gsum gyi brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ a wa sgru ti pa/a dh+wa gup+ta/ a shwa ka shrī/ dharma shrī/ 'gar chos bzang / glan shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sbas shes rab rdo —526

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)lha mo dung can ma'i snying po rnams/rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud sogs kyi lung brgyud skor/gsum pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud kyi skor la/ rigs kyi gtso bo/ rigs kyi bdag po/ rigs kyi yum/ rigs kyi khro bo khro mo/ rigs kyi pho nya phyag brnyan pho mo lnga/ dang po la/ las kyi sgrib pa thamasacad sbyong ba zhes bya ba mi 'brugs pa'i gzungs/ 'di bla ma dag rdo rje rigs kyi gtso bor bzhed do//brgyud pa ni las kyi sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba sor bzhag gam/ yang na gsang ba ring bsrel ji lta ba'o/ /gnyis pa rigs kyi bdag po la/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa paṇ+ḍita de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal dang chos rje sa skya pa'i 'gyur/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'ams / phyag na rdo rje/sar ha/ klu sgrub yab sras/ ma rta gi pa/ bi khyu ta de ba/ kha che paṇa chen/ su ga ta shrī/ sa skya paṇa chen/skyob pa dpal/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ lo mchog pa/ glo (355na)chen pa/ rgyal bzang dpal/ spang khang pa/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen man sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor sor bzhag go /yang na sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ dze tā ri/ mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ gong ma gsum/ chos rje sa paṇa man gong dang 'dra/ yang na ba ri lo tsā ba nas/ mchims brtson seng / mchimasadon ba/ mchims chos seng / blo gros brtan pa/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo mchog pa man gong bzhin no/ /dza pa la phyag na rdo rje rig pa mchog gi rgyud le'u med pa paṇ+ḍi ta bi sdi ka ra pra bha dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'di'ang cung ma rdzogs pa 'dra'o/ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa yan rdo rje sa 'og gi brgyud lugs bar pa ltar la/ de nas slob dpon pad+ma mgon po/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo mchog pa/glo chen pa/ bag ston pa/ mgon po 'bum/ bram nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ ma ti paṇa chen man sangs—528—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khrinalegs bshes gnyen/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse pa khu dbon gnyis/ bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rje bka' 'gyur ba nas/ khyab (356na)bdag rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ des bdag la'o/ /de'i bshad rgyud rdo rje'i ri rab chen po'i rtse mo khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs paṇ+ḍi ta shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang dz+nya na sirnyi/ lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ klu sgrub/ 'phags sa pa lha/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ shān+ti pa/ so ri pa/ a bha yā ka ra/ dge ba'i 'byung gnas/ rdo rje gdan pa gsum/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje btsun yab sras gsum/ chos rje khu dbon gnyis/rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ sras shes rab seng ge /bag ston/ thag ston/ mkhan rin pa/ rgya ma ba/ grub pa shes rab/ rgya ston zla ba'i lha/ ri khrod pa bsod rgyam/ 'jam dbyangs shar rgyam/ dpal ldan rdo rje nas/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba'i bar rdo rje rnam 'joms dang 'dra ba las/ rab 'byams chos rje/khyab bdag khra tshang pa/ des bdag go /yang na sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung /ba ri lo tsā ba man gong bzhin no/ /gsum pa rigs kyi yum ni/ rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar 'bar ba rab tu rmongs byed ces bya ba'i gzungs paṇ+ḍita dzi na mi tra/ dwa na shi la/ ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di phyag rdor dbang bskur ba'i rgyud nas yum du bshad do/ /brgyud pa ni/ bag ston yan rnam 'joms kyi bshad rgyud kyi brgyud pa phyi ma ltar la/ de nas sher rdor ba/ chos sgo ba/ grags rdor ba/ tshal grags don pa man mi g.yo ba'i gzungs le'u dgu pa'i brgyud pa dang gcig go /bzhi pa rigs kyi khro bo khro mo la/ rdo rje phra mo thogasamed/ lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po/ rdo rje thabs sbyor te gsum 'dug pa ma thob/ lnga pa rigs kyi pho nya dang bka' nyan pho mo la/ sme rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 'demakhan chen shes rab rdo rje man gong ltar ro/ /yang na tshal grags don pa nas/ rngog byang chub dpal/mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sman rgyal chos rje nam mkha' dbang phyug /'bum ram pa rin chen chos dbang / bla ma bstan pa rgya mtsho man 'dra/ khu'i rtags can rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ khu ston ngag dbang rnam rgyal nas/ rab 'byams chos rje man 'dra/ lha'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'bum ram pa rin chen chos dbang nas/ lha lung chos rje tshul khrims dbang phyug /mang thos chos rgyal don grub/spyan snga dkon mchog 'bangs/ sems dpa' grags pa don grub/ sdom brtson tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ nyi lde sprul sku 'jig rten dbang phyug /khyab bdag sman lung pa blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /waṃ gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ba ri lo tsā ba nas/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ de la rgyal tsha lung mang po dang rgya lo rnam rgyal rdo rje gnyis gas gsan/ de gnyis la rong pa shes rab seng ge /de nas bag ston gzhen tshul man gong ltar ro/ /yang na 'bum lnga lo tsā ba nas/ spang khang pa grags pa rgyal mtshan/ grags pa seng ge /zhal snga bsod rin/ mkhan po gzhen ye/ rong pa sher seng man 'dra/ ya'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ kun dga' bo/ dgra bcom pa rak+ṣi ta/ spo dzi'i gos can/ sha na'i gos can/nyi ma gung pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen/ (359na〉kru sgrub/ ārla de wa/ mañdzu kirti/ dharma ka ra shān+ti/ rdo rje gdan pa/ bi khyu ta de wa/ kha che paṇa chen/ dpyal lo tsā ba chos bzang / dpyal a mo gha/ mkhan po gzhen nu ye shes/ rong pa sher seng / bag ston man gong dang 'dra/ dz+nyā rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bag ston gzhen tshul yan gong ltar la/ de nas thog ston shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan rin chen 'phel/ rgya ma ba yon tan 'od/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ rgya ston tsan+d+ra de wa/ ri khrod pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ bya 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge /'gos ston rdo rje seng ge /ru thog bla chen nam mkha' gzi brjid/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mchod dpon kun dga' legs pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab —534

mtshan/ sman rgyal cho me rje nam mkha' dbang phyug /'bum ram pa rin chen chos dbang / bla ma bstan pa rgya mtsho man 'dra/ khu'i rtags can rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ khu ston ngag dbang rnam rgyal nas/ rab 'byams chos rje man 'dra/ lha'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'bum ram pa rin chen chos dbang nas/ lha lung chos rje tshul khrims dbang phyug /mang thos chos rgyal don grub/spyan snga dkon mchog 'bangs/ sems dpa' grags pa don grub/ sdom brtson tshogs gnyis dpal grub/ nyi lde sprul sku 'jig rten dbang phyug /khyab bdag sman lung pa blo mchog rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /waṃ gi rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ba ri lo tsā ba nas/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ de la rgyal tsha lung mang po dang rgya lo rnam rgyal rdo rje gnyis gas gsan/ de gnyis la rong pa shes rab seng ge /de nas bag ston gzhen tshul man gong ltar ro/ /yang na 'bum lnga lo tsā ba nas/ spang khang pa grags pa rgyal mtshan/ grags pa seng ge /zhal snga bsod rin/ mkhan po gzhen ye/ rong pa sher seng man 'dra/ ya'i rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ kun dga' bo/ dgra bcom pa rak+ṣi ta/ spo dzi'i gos can/ sha na'i gos can/nyi ma gung pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen/ (359na〉kru sgrub/ ārla de wa/ mañdzu kirti/ dharma ka ra shān+ti/ rdo rje gdan pa/ bi khyu ta de wa/ kha che paṇa chen/ dpyal lo tsā ba chos bzang / dpyal a mo gha/ mkhan po ga'on nu ye shes/ rong pa sher seng / bag ston man gong dang 'dra/ dz+nyā rtags yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bag ston gzhen tshul yan gong ltar la/ de nas thog ston shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan rin chen 'phel/ rgya ma ba yon tan 'od/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ rgya ston tsan+d+ra de wa/ ri khrod pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ bya 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge /'gos ston rdo rje seng ge /ru thog bla chen nam mkha' gzi brjid/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mchod dpon kun dga' legs pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab —534

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)can du'ang gzhal bar bya ba'i gnas la mchog tu spro ba 'phel lo/ /dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i sgo nas mthug bsdu ba/lus can kun la rjes chags mkha' dbyings bder gshegs kun gyi ye shes zla ba rang gzugs rtag tu legs 'char yang / /sngon goms bzang po'i skal bar spyod pa'i snod ldan gdul bya dwangs pa'i klung las kun la 'char ba'i skabs bral phyir/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags zad par spangs kyang sgrib pa'i lus can tshul gyis ches cher snyigs ma lnga bdo'i 'gro 'dren pa/ /nam yang bslu med gtan gyi skyabs mchog rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor legs bzhugs dam pa'i bka' drin gzhal du med/ /so thar rin chen them (363na skos la brten thub bstan sgo ru 'jug mdzad mkhan chen blo bzang chos rgyan rje/ ༷spyab mtha' rnam bzhi bzhed pa'i gzhung dang 'dus pa'i rgyud don ston mkhas 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog chos 'phel zhabs/ /sgra snyan sdeb sbyor mngon brjod rtsis sogs gtsug lag kun la bka' drin zla med paṇa chen smon 'gro pas/ /legs mtshon smin grol gzhung bshad rig pa gcig gis mtha' brten ston rnams a ho bka' drin bla na med/ /rang rgyud tha rgod snying nas dam pa'i chos su sgyur mdzad dpal 'byor lhun grub rdo rje 'chang / /pha rol phyin dang snga phyir 'gyur ba'i chos kyi gan mdzod chos dbyings rang grol 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /ma nub dbang gi chu bo kun 'dus grol ba'i lam ster bsod nams mchog ldan 'khor lo'i mgon/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs pad yun du nye bar bsten 'di sngon bsags legs byas zong gis nyos/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon dbang gis smin mdzad rin chen bsod mchog rdo rje sems/ /thub gsung bka' gter gdams pa'i char 'bebs blo mchog rdo rje rig 'dzin gtso/ /pad ma'i zhal lung drod rlang ster nus gter bdag gling pa sprul pa'i sku/ /nges gsang theg mchog 'chi med zil dngar snying dbus gtams 'di skal ba bzang mang thos —540

dam pa rnams las bdag 'dras min/ /'on te gzig shun bcings pa'i bung rgan gyi/ rnam thar rigs mthun deng 'dzin chen po'i khyur/ /spyi 'dre'i brtul zhugs dor nas smra ba'i mgrin/ /mthon por 'degs 'di med pa'i ljon/ rnam dag smon lam chus bsrings lung rtogs 'bras/ /byang chub mchog gi srid rtser snyeg par shog /gcig tu snying rje'i yul gyur ma rgan 'gro'i/ /phan bde'i rtsa lag zas gtsang sras kyi bstan/ /nam mkha' rang gi ngo bo mi gtong ba/ skye rgu'i bsod nams zhing du (365na)gnas par shog /tshul 'chos gzhan bslu'i phub zol ma 'dres pa/ rnam 'dren ring lugs 'bru yi phan bde'i lto/ 'geng mdzad bstan 'dzin tsho gos rnams dpag yas tshe'i/ dbang phyug ji bzhin zhabs pad brtan par shog /khrims ldan dur smrig 'chang ba rab byung gling / /gos dkar lcang lo g.yo ba'i rig 'dzin khyu/ /mdo sngags bshad sgrub sde rnams 'gro kun gyi/ mgon du dbyar gyi chu bo ltar 'phel shog /las shugs btsan po dar drags sa spyod rnams/ /rang rang mnga' ris tsam gyis chog shes shing/ /drang thig khrims kyi ra bar rje 'bangs kun/ /rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i rtse dga' rgod par shog /dal 'byor don yod sgrub bdag 'tsho ba'i tshe/ /g.yung drung sa srungs gtsug tor khog yangs por/ /srog gi muk+ki brgya phrag bgrang bya yi/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i srad bur brgyu bar shog /grangs med sngon goms sdig pa'i mtshan mun khrod/ /duḥkha'i mal nas gnyid las slong byed pa'i/ /legs byas skya rengs kyis drangs bde skyid kyi/ /nyin mo'i snang ba rtag tu 'bar bar shog /thos bsam byed la rdul gyi cha phras kyang / /phan par sgrub kun rang nyid theg chen lam/ /zhugs tshe chos kyi mched dang slob bu sa gyur nas yang dag
